name: « Les secrets de Rodez » : partez pour une aventure avec l’escape-bag
description:
"Some time ago, a passionate archivist, Cédric Matta, overheard a strange conversation about a treasure hidden in the streets of Rodez. His curiosity led him to an isolated cabin? The secret lair of a mysterious organization: the Vautours Noirs. Since getting his hands on their plans and equipment, Cédric has disappeared without a trace. It's up to you to pick up where he left off."  
With family or friends, set off in search of the lost treasure by solving riddles and exploring the city's nooks and crannies, with your escape-bag on your back! A fun and mysterious adventure for everyone aged 7
tldr: Résolvez des énigmes dans les rues de Rodez pour découvrir un trésor caché, une aventure immersive.

name: "Au cœur de soi", séances de bien-être
description:
Sessions for physical, mental and emotional well-being, balance and harmony: relaxation with a few yoga postures, breathing, meditations, sound relaxation (relaxing vibratory instruments), intuitive dance: let your body speak for itself, let go, then metamorphic massage: very relaxing and rebalancing, not forgetting the little ones: share a moment of complicity and gentleness with baby massage and baby yoga!
These sessions are for everyone. Accessible to all, no level required.
Don't hesitate to contact me for more information?
tldr: Séances de bien-être mêlant yoga, méditation et relaxation sonore pour retrouver équilibre et harmonie.

name: "Ferme Bêle & Bio", produits laitiers de brebis
description:
The quality of our ewes' milk, combined with our know-how, gives us a yogurt that's recognized for its smoothness and creaminess.
Our tome is an uncooked pressed cheese made from raw milk. This is a real commitment on our part, as it requires us to produce high-quality milk. Maturation lasts a minimum of 12 weeks in our cellars. Each week they are rubbed with salt water (morgeage) to form a characteristic "orange" rind.
tldr: Dégustez des produits laitiers de brebis bio, fromages et yaourts onctueux issus d’un savoir-faire artisanal.

name: "Les Conserves Traditionnelles" - Canards
description: Duck rearing pens. Force feeding rooms. Processing room. In the summer on Thursdays from 11am to 1pm from the 1st of July to the 31 of August, tastings at the farm: toast and foie gras, pâtés, cou farci, dried duck sausage, cheese, dessert, coffee, wine.
tldr: Découvrez l’élevage de canards et dégustez foie gras, pâtés et confits lors de dégustations estivales à la ferme.

name: 28 juillet 1944, les 6 fusillés de La Bergerie d’Ourtiguet
A la croisée des Arbres : Grimpe d'arbres
description:
Tree climbing is a unique and sensory activity that allows participants to discover the tree and its environment by exploring it from the roots to the top in complete safety, by learning different climbing techniques and by using specific standardized equipment called PPE (personal protective equipment).

Unlike tree climbing courses, tree climbing is an ephemeral and itinerant activity, the ropes used are removed at the end of each activity in order to limit our impact as much as possible.

You are supervised throughout the session by a qualified instructor.

We also evolve in small groups, i
tldr: Grimpez aux arbres en sécurité pour une exploration sensorielle unique, des racines aux cimes.

name: A la croisée des Arbres : Grimpe d'arbres (groupes)
description:
You are a group of friends, a company or a professional of the event industry and you are looking for an original outing in the middle of nature, which will stimulate your taste for adventure, team building, appeasement, escape and more...?

Bachelorette party : EVJF, EVG ?

Do not hesitate to contact me to organize with you an outing to climb trees.

Different formulas are possible.
tldr: Team-building original en pleine nature : grimpe d’arbres pour stimuler l’aventure et la cohésion.

name: A LA FERME ARMAND ET MARIE
description:
Agriculture, a passion.
A family farm since 1730, we are located in Hyelzas, Lozère.
Between the Gorges du Tarn and the Gorges de la Jonte, our ewes and Angus graze on the heights of the Causse Méjean.
Our family has always strived to maintain local, high-quality production, with respect for the environment, animals and people. They have passed on their love of the land to us. Now organic, we'd like to pay tribute to our grandparents through our range of desserts and ice creams, naming them "Armand et Marie".
The Armand et Marie farm ice-cream parlour brings you organic ice creams made with ew
tldr: Ferme familiale depuis 1730 : dégustez fromages de brebis et viandes Angus entre gorges du Tarn et de la Jonte.

name: Abbatiale Sainte-Foy de Conques
description:
DESCRIPTION
The abbey church of Sainte-Foy was built between the 11th and 12th centuries. On its facade is the Tympanum of the Last Judgment from the same period. It is illuminated from May to October during the "Nocturnes de Conques" to discover a revisited polychromy.
The interior of the church houses 250 Romanesque capitals spread over two levels: the lower part and the Tribunes. The latter are accessible during the Nocturnes to be closer to the medieval capitals and the contemporary stained glass windows of Pierre Soulages.
Self-guided or guided tour with the Heritage Department - Conques
tldr: Admirez le tympan roman du Jugement dernier et l’abbatiale illuminée, joyau de l’art médiéval.

name: Abbaye de Bonneval
description:
The nuns earn their living by working with their hands, and make an excellent chocolate: the famous Bonneval chocolate.
What to see and do at Bonneval Abbey?
- the entrance pavilions and their listed Madonna and Child (12th century),
- the ramparts, the church,
- the valley, the forest, the typical Cistercian site,
- the store, where you'll find Bonneval chocolates, books, children's albums and a variety of monastic products.
- a 25-minute film on the history and life of the community is shown.
The chocolate factory and the community's living quarters are not open to the public.
tldr: Dégustez un chocolat artisanal unique fabriqué par les sœurs de l'abbaye, dans un cadre historique paisible.

name: Acrobi Parapente
description:
Learn to fly on your own in our school, or come and discover free flight easily and enjoy the unique view and feeling of freedom that paragliding tandem flight will bring you. An unforgettable experience, guided by an instructor just for you, without vertigo, because you don't jump, you take off. It changes everything!

-morning discovery flight in calm conditions: 6 to 8 minutes (from 20 to 75kg max.): €65

20-minute afternoon ascents (from 40 to 120kg max): €95

20-minute afternoon flight (from 40 to 120kg max): €120

tldr: Tentez le parapente en tandem au-dessus des Gorges du Tarn pour une vue à couper le souffle et une sensation de liberté inoubliable.

name: Aigue Vive (groupes)
description:
3 canoe/kayak courses :

* Les Vignes - le Rozier 11 km: The course begins with a toboggan, and the whole descent is a succession of rapids and calm waters. Halfway down, you'll see the village of La Sablière on your left, and a little further down on the right, the troglodyte villages of Saint Marcelin and Eglazine. At your own pace, you'll arrive at the base where your vehicle is waiting.

* Le Rozier - Peyrelade 7 km (easy) : A pleasant, leisurely family descent. Accessible from age 6 (provided you're in good physical condition and can swim at least 25 m underwater).

* Les Vignes - Peyrela
tldr: Descendez les Gorges du Tarn en canoë-kayak, entre rapides et paysages époustouflants, pour une aventure sportive et immersive.

name: Aigue Vive canoe kayak

Le Rozier - Peyrelade 7km (without any difficulty): family course, quiet and calm. Available from 6 years old (it is important to know how to swim and to be able to swim on a distance of 25m). 
Les Vignes - Peyrelade 18km: about 5h of sailing, mix of sensations and calm for a sporty day.
tldr: Choisissez votre parcours en canoë-kayak : des rapides aux eaux calmes, pour une descente adaptée à tous les niveaux.

name: ARCS DE SAINT-PIERRE
description:
The site of Les Arcs de Saint-Pierre is located at the south-western tip of the Causse Méjean, between the Tarn and Jonte valleys. It is
a ruiniform and chaotic landscape of natural vaults, prehistoric caves and dolomitic rocks.
The site is rich in flora and fauna due to the presence of dolomitic sands within a mosaic of dry grasslands, cliffs and dolomitic rocks. This dolomitic substratum allows the development of particular and determining species.
The Grey Fox, a remarkable southern bat, frequents the site of Les Arcs as much in open or semi-open environments as in the karstic environment.
tldr: Admirez un paysage ruiniforme et chaotique de voûtes naturelles, entre les vallées du Tarn et de la Jonte.

name: BAOUSSE DEL BIEL
description:
The formation of the Tarn gorges has created magnificent monuments, such as this impressive arch, "la baousse del biel", in Occitan, "the bump of the old man".

This natural arch is 40 meters high, the opening is 27 meters high and 25 meters wide.
tldr: Admirez l'impressionnant arche naturel de 40 mètres de haut, la 'baousse del biel', sculptée par les gorges du Tarn.

name: Baptême de plongée à la piscine de Réquista
description:
Why not join us? Every Thursday from 2pm to 5pm, the "Les Grenouilles Carmausines" diving club offers you a first dive. An aquatic experience for all, from 8 years upwards.  Although the "bottom of the pool" may not be as deep as that of the deep blue sea, this scuba diving experience is an easy way to get to grips with diving and the feeling of weightlessness.
The activity is supervised by qualified instructors from the diving club. All equipment provided, no registration necessary. For minors, parental authorization signed by both parents is required. Baptism is free of charge, except for ad
tldr: Initiez-vous à la plongée chaque jeudi à la piscine de Réquista, encadré par un club local.

name: Barrage EDF de Castelnau- Lassouts
description: Enjoy a remarkable view of the last meander of the lake, the dam and its power station, and discover the history of the construction of the structure, its role in the electricity system and water management. The proximity of the lake, renowned for its fishing resources and biodiversity, invites you to contemplate or practice one of the many outdoor activities available. The lake is 32 km long.
tldr: Découvrez l'histoire et le rôle du barrage de Castelnau-Lassouts, avec une vue imprenable sur le dernier méandre du lac.

name: Base canoë Broquiès - Les Chemins de Traverse
description: On an exceptional site: initiate yourself to the simple joys of sunshine and nature! At the heart of the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses discover the wild flora and fauna of the southern Aveyron. Along the waters of the Tarn from the Pont de Navech to Broquiès, under the buttresses of the château de Brousse at the aire de Connac, we offer you two possibilities: a relaxed family trip of 7KM (2h) and an adventurous descente of 14km (4h). from the 15/06 to the 10/09, departures every 15 minutes from 10am to 5pm, everyday. Out of season trips by reservation or multi activity stays with ha
tldr: Initiation au canoë au cœur des Grands Causses, entre nature sauvage et paysages préservés.

description: By canoe, kayak or paddle for a moment of escape and tranquility from Ambialet, come with your family, friends or group to navigate along the Tarn for a day, half day or 1h30.
tldr: Naviguez sur le Tarn en canoë, kayak ou paddle depuis Ambialet, pour une escapade nature en famille ou entre amis.

tldr: Découvrez les émotions du canoë sur des parcours adaptés à tous les niveaux, encadré par des professionnels.

name: Base de Loisirs à Lincou
description: Canoe, kayak, paddle and pedalo rentals just a stone's throw from Château de Lincou and mini-golf.

description: Pedal boats, canoes, paddles, boats for rent. Supervised water park with lots of fun.
tldr: Base de loisirs avec location de bateaux et parc aquatique surveillé pour des heures de détente en famille.

description: Come and relax and refresh yourself at the leisure center La Chaussée du Lapin. You can enjoy the swimming pool and its water slides, the refreshment bar, the petanque and volleyball courts. Picnic area and barbecue, children's playground, shaded areas and possibility to fish.
tldr: Piscine, toboggans, pétanque et volley : un espace de loisirs complet pour se rafraîchir et s'amuser.

tldr: Activités variées au bord du Tarn : randonnée, sports collectifs, canoë et jeux gonflables pour tous.

name: Base nautique du mas de la Nauc : Location d'embarcations
description:
Sail along the emerald waters of the Tarn: in a canoe (2 to 3 places), in a river or sea kayak (1 place) or in an electric boat without a licence (7 places maximum).
2 routes are proposed to you: Discovering the wild Raspes or heading for the Cascade des Baumes.
Take advantage of a stretch of water accessible to all and of sumptuous and inaccessible landscapes.
Water sports base with supervised swimming, bar/restaurant by the water, entertainment/concerts, and departure of a cruise on the Tarn with Le Héron des Raspes.
In September, enter the Raspes on board an electric boat or canoe BY APPOIN
tldr: Glissez sur les eaux émeraude du Tarn en canoë, kayak ou bateau électrique, entre falaises vertes et paysages préservés.

Between the green cliffs and emerald waters of the Raspes du Tarn, come aboard for a refreshing break! The nautical base, managed by the restaurant La Table des Deux Frères, has pedal boats at your disposal, ideal for sharing a convivial moment with family or friends.

name: Basilica of Notre-Dame de Ceignac
description:
We are told by the legend that...
On his way to the Limousin region, St Martial founded this sanctuary and donated a piece of the Virgin Mary's veil.
Besides, a dignitary of the Hungarian Court is supposed to have recovered his sight thanks to the Virgin Mary, here, in Ceignac.
Its history from the beginning to its splendor: 
The basilica is born from the union of two 13th-century religious monuments: the church dedicated to St Mary Magdalene and the Notre-Dame des Monts chapel dedicated to the Virgin that already was a prized place of pilgrimage. The 2 Romanesque bays date back from that time
tldr: Découvrez une basilique médiévale liée à une relique de la Vierge, nichée dans un village auvergnat chargé d’histoire.

Aboard this boat, you'll discover the secrets of Lac de Pareloup, seated in the covered area or on the "terrace". During the cruise, we offer ice creams and drinks on board.
You can also enjoy an aperitif with friends (Licence IV).
From 01/07 to 31/08: departures at 4pm. Please arrive 15 minutes before departure.
April, May, June, September, October: please consult us
Possibility of privatizing the boat for your receptions, birthdays, company parties...
Special excursions
tldr: Embarquez sur le Papillon Jaune pour une croisière sur le lac de Pareloup et explorez ses paysages et secrets.

The senses are stimulated by going barefoot on the moss, touching the trees blindfolded, or taking the time to listen and contemplate. Treat yourself to this essential moment of reconnection!

name: Bosc Castle - House of Toulouse-Lautrec
description:
Former keep built by Bérenger du Bosc in 1180, it became a medieval fortress with moat and drawbridge, pepper-pot towers, arrow-slits and bombards, until the painter's grandmother, Countess Raymond de Toulouse-Lautrec born Gabrielle d'Imbert du Bosc, decided, in the middle of the 19th century, to turn the austere defensive castle into a welcoming family home, while preserving the Renaissance parts of the building.

Even if he died in 1901, the artist is still here through a collection of child's drawings, personal items, posters, lithographs and photographs. This family's castle is also rich i
tldr: Château médiéval transformé en musée : explorez l’histoire des Toulouse-Lautrec et leur héritage architectural.

name: Centrale hydroélectrique de Pinet
description:
The Pinet dam, commissioned in 1929, is a concrete gravity dam 175 m long and 41 m high. The dam holds back a vast reservoir of over 10 million m³, which forms Lac de Pinet, a narrow but spectacular lake stretching over 12 km and offering a multitude of water sports activities.
The dam is set in deep, narrow gorges, a spectacular setting that regularly experiences impressive flooding.

The downstream hydroelectric power station, equipped with five Francis turbines, generates around 105 GWh per year, making a significant contribution to the local energy supply.

name: Chapelle d'Aurelle
description:
Chapelle d'Aurelle, built in the 14th century, then renovated by a team of volunteers and listed as a historic monument in the 1980s, is home to a colony of the "grand rhinolophe", a protected species of bat.
Today, it is the largest breeding colony for this species in Occitanie.

Under a municipal decree, the Chapelle d?Aurelle will be closed to the public from May 1 to September 30, 2026
to protect a colony of bats (Grand Rhinolophe) during the breeding season, in accordance with article L411-1 of the
Code de l?environnement, which prohibits the destruction or disturbance of protected specie
tldr: Chapelle médiévale abritant une colonie de rhinolophes, chauves-souris protégées, classée monument historique.

name: Chapelle de Bergounhoux
description: An ancient place of pilgrimage to the Virgin Mary, which would have been founded by a Duke of Burgundy, who would have been lost in the woods on his way to Compostela, hence the name Bergounhoux. The success of this place of devotion was considerable: in 1524 there was there the most important brotherhood of the diocese, it is said. The Vezins who protected the place maintained it: in 1431 Vezian de Vezins had a chapel built containing a Piéta from the early 16th century.
tldr: Chapelle liée à une légende de pèlerinage de Bourgogne à Compostelle, nichée dans les bois.

name: Chapelle de Foncourrieu
description:
LEGEND
According to legend, in 1338 a noble lady passed through this bramble- and reptile-infested area. A huge snake was said to have wrapped itself around one of her legs. Frightened, she implored the Virgin Mary to come to her rescue. Mary appeared to her and crushed the snake's head. In gratitude, the noblewoman built a chapel dedicated to the Virgin Mary, near a fountain that gave its name to the place ("fons currens" meaning running fountain, later became Notre Dame de Foncourrieu).

description: Her existence is certified in 1030 by an ancient text which describe Murat as a vineyard. A lateral chapel dedicated to Saint Clair was built during the XIIIth century. We know a little better about her history starting from the XVIIth century with the official reports made by the bishops coming to inspect it. The interior was massively restored by the heritage association: cracks filled, renderings redone and many other renovations that enabled the Chapel to recover her historical charm. name: Chapelle de Salars
description:
Guarded by a wooden recumbent statue of Christ, the interior features a very old Virgin Mary, thanked every year during a pilgrimage for protecting the commune from the Germans during the last war.
Access by car from the RD 911 in the village, follow signs for Ségur and take the 1st turning on the left.

For access on foot, take the road between the village hall and the church for 200 m, cross the bridge and take the Chemin de Croix on the right, which climbs for 15 min.

name: Chapelle de Villelongue - Musée de la Résistance
description:
Let yourself parachute 80 years back in time!
Created to keep history alive, the site is dedicated to the Maquis Antoine, who operated in the area and found refuge there during the Occupation, to the Vény group and to the Resistance in the Ségala Tarn-Aveyron region. Indeed, the former hamlet of Villelongue was ideally located for access to the nearby Lucante parachute drop zone.
This chapel-museum features explanatory panels enriched with archive documents and objects, all under the protective umbrella of a deployed parachute.
A little history
During the Second World War, from May 1944 onward
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire de la Résistance avec le Maquis Antoine, site dédié à la mémoire de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

The miller climbs up a ladder to the indicated place and discovers, in the middle of the box trees, a coarsely carved stone statue representing the Virgin Mary

With the years, the building having deteriorated (statues and altarpiece in bad condition), the idea was born to meet for the mass in the enclosure of the Capelette on August 14th
Under the aegis of Father Cros, the Capelette was entirely renovated both inside and out in the 1980s thanks to the meal organized on August 14.

name: CHAPELLE SAINT-FREZAL
description:
The Saint-Frézal chapel stands in a pleasant green setting, near the Frézal spring. Its waters come from a resurgence of the Causse de Fraissinet. Thus the thick buttresses attached to the chapel serve to support the building during floods

It is a pilgrimage chapel: the main altar is actually a sarcophagus containing the remains of Saint Frézal, bishop of Gévaudan in the 9th century. In charge of putting an end to the idolatrous practices of the inhabitants, he was murdered by his nephew in 828. His relics, as well as the Frézal spring, have been the object of a particular devotion.

name: CHAPELLE SAINT-GERVAIS
description: Twelve means "resurgence" in Occitan: the Jonte River sinks underground 3km downstream from Meyrueis and only comes out 7km further. It was there that a mill was established, and thus the hamlet of the Douzes was created. The inhabitants of the hamlet remain faithful to the chapel of Saint-Gervais. At each death, the inhabitants take turns to carry the deceased by hand to the cemetery next to the small church and its bell tower.

The cirque des Baumes, in addition to being a popular place for climbing enthusiasts, is also a place of piety for the local inhabitants. The water, which comes out of a cavity dug in the rock near the chapel, was considered miraculous for a long time. This building, the Saint-Jean-Baptiste-du-Bedel chapel, has this particular roof shape which reminds the one of an overturned ship's hull, called "Philibert's roof", named after the famous architect of King Henri II, Philibert de l'Orme

A foretaste of what you'll see?
Unlike that of Saint-Clair de Verdun, it has kept its furnishings, some of which date back to the 17th century: a carved and painted wooden altar and tabernacle, an altarpiece depicting a crucifixion, the Virgin and Saint Vincent (martyr and patron saint of winegrowers), and a gilded wooden statue of the Virgin. The furnishings, both Baroque and naive, give the church a very special atmosphere.

name: Chapelle St André de Clauzelles
description:
It contains a statue of the Virgin, a copy of Notre-Dame dite des Embergues (14th century) and a Gothic wooden statue of Saint Stephen. The choir flanked by 4 cylindrical buttresses is the oldest part. The small chapel was then fitted out in 1784 with a colourful wooden country altarpiece.
The chapel is open to the public, each house in the village of Clauzelles has a key (opening on request). Historical details in the building.

name: Chapelle St Ferréol
description:
St Ferréol, a Roman tribune born in Vienne, was martyred in Brioude in the 3rd century. His protection, invoked here in a certain way since 1525, is particularly exercised towards soldiers and children. In the past, people used to come here at the beginning of the season, in order to obtain the right weather for the needs of the land. The chapel apparently had a bell tower. But 'lou clouquier' was the victim of some medieval war, and was sent to the bottom of an abyss. Long afterwards, some people still claimed to have heard the bells ringing from the bottom of the hole.

description:
On the road to Villefranche de Panat, close to the Village du Truel, hidden by a small valley, stands the Romanesque chapel of St Cyrice. Magnificent small building of schist with roofs of lauzes bordered by a small brook. The legends are still very present.
This small church is the ideal place for a nature break with a short walk included!
A small brook, cool in summer, panels and interpretation trail installed by the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses.

tldr: Visitez cette forteresse millénaire restaurée, perchée sur son éperon rocheux dans un village classé parmi les plus beaux de France.

name: CHATEAU DE CANILHAC
description:
The medieval castle of Canilhac is located in the Lot Valley, in the commune of Canilhac in Lozère. Only the ruins of the castle remain, which bear witness to a rich and ancient history.

Belonging to the barons of Canilhac, the castle dates from the 12th century during the dominance of the county of Aragon on the Gévaudan. It was the seat of the oldest barony of the Viscounty of Gévaudan. Today you can see the restored keep built in opus spictum or fishbone. In the current church, the former chapel of the castle is the emblem of the carved coat of arms of Canilhac: a greyhound.

name: Château de Peyrelade
description:
Description 
Built between the 12th and 16th centuries, Peyrelade Castle was one of the most important fortresses in Rouergue during the Middle Ages, thanks to the position of its natural rock keep, which allowed it to command the Tarn Valley. 
Today, the tour allows visitors to discover the history of the site, its unique architecture, as well as the extensive restoration and excavation work undertaken over the past 30 years.

Castle dating from the beginning of the XIVth century, reworked in the XVIth and XVIIth centuries, in the heart of a charming Lozerean village, nested in the circus of Saint Saturnin (Causse de Sauveterre). Former royal fief, the construction of the castle, initiated by the Comtors de Montferrand as of XIIe century, is remarkable and is equipped with the last royal keep of Gévaudan.

name: Château de Taurines
description:
Since 1985, the château has hosted a contemporary art exhibition every summer, making it a veritable artistic showcase. This 13th-14th century château in the heart of the small rural village of Taurines, in the commune of Centrès, Aveyron, has been brought back to life by a volunteer association. From 1981 onwards, the Compagnons du devoir (journeymen) have been creating masterpieces such as the hollow-core spiral staircase, the suspended keystone vault, the monumental door and the fireplaces.

name: Château de Tholet
description:
Summer guided tour of the medieval castle of Tholet, covering the entire structure. This 14th-century fortified castle, which became a manor house during the Renaissance and then a farm in the 19th century, bears witness to the feudal and agricultural past of the Rouergue region, set in a well-preserved environment.
Warning: Please wear appropriate footwear. Make sure you are able to navigate the tour along a narrow, steep staircase.
In case of high visitor traffic, the duration and route of the tour may be adjusted.
In case of inclement weather, tours may be canceled for safety reasons.

name: CHATEAU ET JARDIN DE BOURNAZEL
description:
Situated in the west of the Aveyron département, between Rodez and Villefranche de Rouergue, Château de Bournazel is one of the most remarkable Renaissance châteaux in Occitanie, thanks to its innovative architecture and the quality of its sculpted decoration. After 15 years of exemplary restoration work, crowned by the award of the Grand Trophée Dassault Histoire et Patrimoine, it is now considered to be the finest Renaissance château-museum in the south of France, housing a rich collection of paintings, furniture and objets d'art from the 16th and 17th centuries.

name: CHATEAU ET JARDIN DE BOURNAZEL (groupes)
description:
The château's architecture, sculpted decoration and garden represent one the most beautiful creations from the time of François I, expressing the 16th century patron's intellectual sophistication.
Partially destroyed during the French Revolution then remodelled in the 19th century, this exceptional site is being returned to its former glory thanks to the restoration of its original elements and a faithful reconstruction of those lost to the past using traditional craftsmen.
Guided tours allow visitors to discover the history and architecture of this Historic Monument, as well as its collection
tldr: Découvrez un joyau Renaissance : château sculpté et jardins raffinés du XVIe siècle, témoins d’un mécénat humaniste.

Standing 28 meters high on the Bage stream, it plays a key role in the supply of water to Lac de Pareloup, thanks to the pumping station located at the foot of the dam. This same pumping station is capable of bringing water up to the plateau from an altitude of almost a hundred meters, thanks to 2 "pumps".
The power required for this technical feat is equivalent to that produced by the Alrance hydroelectric plant further downstream.

The village of Conques, classified as one of the Most Beautiful Villages in France and one of the Great Sites of Occitania, nestles in a preserved natural setting. It is a reference in Romanesque architecture (abbey church and tympanum of the Last Judgement), medieval goldsmith's art (Treasure of Saint Foy) and contemporary art (stained glass windows by Pierre Soulages).

Visit of the Museum : The museum is open in high season (winter closure between November and May). The ticket of the Treasury allows the visit of the Museum. tldr: Admirez meubles sculptés, tapisseries anciennes et vestiges du cloître dans ce musée méconnu de Conques.

Duration of the visit: 45 minutes. Accessible from 12 years old. Visit always accompanied for safety reasons.

Departure : in front of the Joseph-Fau Museum
tldr: Explorez le processus créatif de Pierre Soulages à travers ses vitraux contemporains depuis la galerie supérieure de l'abbaye.

DESCRIPTION

The tour also introduces you to the contemporary stained glass windows by Pierre Soulages that adorn the church's openings. Your guide will explain everything from the history of the site to its architecture and Romanesque art. An essential visit to Conques and its thousand-year-old history.

Length of visit: 45 minutes.
Accessibility: inclined planes in the church, tactile and Braille supports and booklets.
tldr: Décryptez le tympan sculpté de 124 figures et admirez l'architecture romane de l'abbatiale de Conques.

The legend says that Saint Andéol undertook to Christianize the local populations to make them abandon pagan customs in this place. However, despite this intervention, these processions were still taking place at the end of the 19th century with clothes and food being thrown into the lake

Plaisance is situated between the Tarn and the Aveyron and our cycling routes take you across a variety of stunning Tarn valley, mountain and forest landscapes. Through the awakening of your 5 senses, I accompany you, in a simple way and at a slow pace, to marvel at a unique sensory experience. A moment out of time, to reconnect with your body, calm your mind and let go, here and now.
Through the subtle, intimate relationship between trees and living things, you'll find the space to gently plunge into the heart of yourself and rediscover greater harmony. By reconnecting with nature, you'll find it easier to cultivate a constructive relationship with your needs and inner nature.

You'll leave with your senses awakened, renewed self-confidence, a sense
tldr: Reconnectez-vous à la nature par un bain de forêt, éveillant vos sens en pleine conscience.

In our hectic world, stress and anxiety predominate and take their toll on the health of our bodies. To change this dynamic, it's essential to take a break, both mentally and physically. It's in this pause that massage becomes an invaluable tool, offering relaxation and harmony.

tldr: Offrez-vous une pause détente avec des massages pour apaiser corps et esprit dans un cadre apaisant.

name: DE ROQUEFORT AUX ROUGIERS MOUNTAIN BIKING BASE
description: The mountain bike base at Roquefort aux Rougiers takes you through a variety of landscapes on the stony, technical paths of the Causses and the playful paths of the Rougiers, enough to satisfy family, technical and sporting enthusiasts all year round.
tldr: Dévalez les sentiers techniques des Causses et les pistes ludiques des Rougiers en VTT.

name: Découverte de la vieille ville d'Entraygues
description: From whatever direction you come in, via charming meandering roads, you arrive in Entraygues. And what a recompense, the beauty of the site amazes you. This town with its numerous mediaeval vestiges lying between the Lot and the Truyère, offers us its old streets, its cantous fireplaces and ganelles, superb timber-framed houses dating from the 15th and 16th centuries, its château and its 13th century bridges... And above the town, the small village of Ginolhac with its vast horizons...
tldr: Flânez dans Entraygues-sur-Truyère, ville médiévale aux ruelles pavées et vestiges historiques.

name: Découverte de la vieille ville d'Espalion
description: L'esplanade du Foirail: a former livestock fairground on the banks of the River Lot; the 8-pin bowling green: an emblematic Aveyron game. From the foirail: breathtaking traditional views of the Renaissance Vieux-Palais, former residence of the Governors of Espalion, listed as a Historic Monument. The Pont Vieux (Old Bridge), built of pink sandstone in the 11th century, is a listed historic monument and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The old tanneries: tanners' houses with covered galleries on the right bank of the Lot. Up the Rue Droite, the oldest street in Espalion, discover the Place du Marc
tldr: Découvrez Espalion, entre esplanade du Foirail et vue sur le Renac, avec ses jeux traditionnels emblématiques.

name: Découverte du village d'Estaing
description:
On the Via Podensis of the Chemins de Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle, Estaing, one of Aveyron's Most Beautiful Villages in France, reveals its secrets on this tour of the village's main buildings: the Gothic bridge - a UNESCO World Heritage Site - the Collège - a Renaissance house bearing the Estaing coat of arms - the Saint Fleuret church with its remarkable altarpieces and stained-glass windows... In the heart of northern Aveyron, in the Lot Valley, the history of the fiefdom of the Counts of Estaing is both short and long!

In July and August, discover the village in a whole new way with nigh
tldr: Visitez Estaing, village médiéval classé, sur la route de Compostelle, et ses monuments secrets.

name: Découverte du village de St-Côme d'Olt
description:
Situated on the route de Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle from Le Puy (via Podensis, now GR65), the village of Saint-Côme d'Olt is home to a number of well-preserved or restored 15th and 16th century houses. The village is also home to a number of well-preserved or restored 15th- and 16th-century houses, including several "Philibert" roofs, named after their designer Philibert Delhormes, architect to King Henri II. A stroll around the grounds reveals a number of fine relics of the past.
The church
Built in the 16th century by architect Jean Salvanh, who also designed the bell tower of Rodez cathed
tldr: Explorez Saint-Côme-d'Olt, étape du chemin de Compostelle, et ses maisons Renaissance préservées.

name: Découverte du village de Villecomtal
description:
A document on visiting the village is available from the Point d'Accueil (and others Information Center) in the summer season and from the Mairie (Head Office) out of season.
Discover more about the history of his castle ((15th century dungeon, with vestiges of curtain walls and towers with arrow slits, and 18th century corps de logis) and the Enfarinés former community.
Selguided tour of the Vihn Luu botanical garden close to the Maison de santé.
tldr: Parcourez Villecomtal, village aux maisons anciennes, et plongez dans son histoire locale.

name: Découvrez le Pont de Cirou
description:
Once a stopover on the pilgrims' route to Santiago de Compostela, the Pont de Cirou is a must-see, with its 6 semi-circular arches spanning the river from the 14th to 15th centuries.
A special feature of this bridge is its access: the roads on both the Tarn and Aveyron sides converged at right angles. As early as the end of the 17th century, plans were made to change this situation and, as everything comes to those who wait, work was carried out to this effect in... 1992.
Discover the village with your family on the "La Magie de la pierre" treasure hunt, or enjoy a picnic by the river at one o
tldr: Traversez le Pont de Cirou, joyau médiéval à six arches, ancien passage des pèlerins vers Compostelle.

name: Découvrez le Pont de Grand-Fuel
description:
Thanks to the intervention of the mountain judge and the 4 châtellenies, the inhabitants of Rodez and Cassagnes-Bégonhès were exempted from the toll imposed by the lord of Salmiech: Arnal de Landorre.
The 55-meter-long bridge is built of schist and sandstone, and now has a paved road. Its existence is mentioned as early as 1302-1305 (it must have been made of wood before then).

Adrenalin and breathtaking views are all part of hang-gliding.
If you like speed and dynamic maneuvers, hang-gliding is for you!
Lying back like a bird, you'll enjoy an aerial escape with a breathtaking view of the spectacular Aveyron countryside.
An experience accessible to all: Enjoy a tandem flight with a state-qualified instructor for a 100% safe adventure.
For an exceptional aerial experience, fly over one of the most beautiful landscapes in France?
Flights take place in July and August with Deltalib.

tldr: Survolez les paysages aveyronnais en deltaplane pour une sensation de liberté et des vues à couper le souffle.

description:
Feel like tasting artisanal ice creams, but with a little particularity... they are made with organic sheep milk. Discover the sweetness and originality of these creamy refreshments that Valerie offers you!
With about twenty flavors and sorbets (chocolate, coconut, caramel, coffee, lemon meringue, chestnuts, elderflowers...), they are real delights made from sheep's milk with a creamy texture...
On the farm located at Maubert, in the commune of Salles-Curan, there is Valérie's laboratory "impeccably maintained" where she is passionate about preparing her desserts, so much appreciated during th

name: DIDRICK VACANCES
description: Multi-activity stays, discovery of the environment, geology, outdoor sports. Other services offered according to the activity: sports challenge (Raid), courses, training course, tourist circuits, discovery day, multiactivities, initiation course and weekend.
tldr: Participez à des séjours multi-activités en pleine nature pour explorer géologie et sports outdoor avec des défis stimulants.

name: Discover the Viaur Viaduct
description:
Let this construction of genious carry you away...
Between Aveyron & Tarn, in the heart of the Ségala, the Viaur Viaduct & its 3,800 tons of steel, seems to lay down, as light as a feather, on the hillsides of the Viaur Valley.
It is a remarkable metal work of the engineer Paul Bodin : steel girders, arches, a million of rivets... This aerial lace is 166m high & 460m long, with a 220m-wingspread central arch.
You will be amazed by the harmony between technique & nature.
... & its innovative technique!
The Viaur Viaduct was subject to an architecture competition in 1887, open to engineers: 8 dr
tldr: Admirez ce géant d'acier de 3 800 tonnes, chef-d'œuvre d'ingénierie ferroviaire suspendu entre deux vallées.

tldr: Marchez sur un tumulus néolithique de 25 m, parmi les plus grands dolmens de la région, chargé d'histoire.

tldr: Dolmen sans dalle de couverture, aux supports latéraux impressionnants, perdu en bordure d'un chemin rural.

tldr: Admirez ce dolmen imposant aux dalles de support et couverture, d'une forme rare et mystérieuse.

Dolmen simple en V, avec piliers, deux dalles de couverture, dalle de chevet et cairn de pierres sèches.

Très dégradé, restes de trois dalles de piliers, au milieu d'un cairn éparpillé long de 20 m sur 11 m orienté au sud-est.

tldr: Ce dolmen très dégradé, au milieu d'un cairn éparpillé, offre une plongée dans l'archéologie et ses mystères.

name: Dolmen de Peyrelevade
description:
The dolmen of Peyrelevade of Salles-la-Source is one of the many dolmens present on the Causse Comtal. A restoration operation has allowed to give it back its original aspect. The furniture found during excavations attests to a long period of use covering practically the entire Copper Age

It should be noted that Homo Erectus was present in the commune of Salles-la-Source as attested by a flint biface dated between 100 and 120,000 years ago found on the Causse. name: Dolmen de Saint-Antonin
description: Tumulus de 25 m sur 15 m, orienté est.
tldr: Découvrez un tumulus de 25 m, orienté est, vestige mystérieux de la préhistoire à explorer.

name: Dolmen de Saint-Antonin ou de Farrals
description: Restes les dalles des piliers, 3 par côté, formant le couloir, le tout dans son tertre envahi par les ronces. Le tumulus mesure 23 m sur 8 m, orienté à l'est. Dolmen simple orienté Az. 109, Dec. -12.
tldr: Découvrez les vestiges d'un dolmen enfoui sous les ronces, vestige énigmatique d'un passé lointain.

name: Dolmen de Saplous (B)

name: Dolmen de Sirandels

tldr: Admirez ce petit dolmen joliment posé sur les restes d'un tumulus, cadre paisible et chargé d'histoire.

name: Dolmen de Surguières (A)

tldr: Un dolmen méconnu, à l'état de ruines, où l'on imagine encore les rites anciens malgré les déchets.

name: Dolmen de Surguières (B)
description: Ce monument est ruiné : les supports sont inclinés et la dalle de couverture est brisée en trois fragments. Le dolmen a été transformé en abri de berger, par l'ajout de murettes de pierres sèches.
tldr: Ce dolmen ruiné, transformé en abri de berger, offre un mélange insolite de nature et d'histoire rurale.

name: Dolmen de Surguières (C)
description:
Ce dolmen un peu ruiné, mais qui possède encore une dalle de couverture, a été aménagé en abri de fortune, et maintenant de poubelle des champs.
Dolmen simple orienté Az. 71, Dec. +15.
tldr: Dolmen ruiné devenu poubelle des champs : trace d'une histoire locale à observer avec curiosité.

name: Domaine de la Cardabelle
description: On the sun-drenched limestone plateau overlooking the Tarn, up and down stream form Millau, the 142 acre vineyard, in bygone years renowned for supplying the Popes of Avignon, is experiencing a real renaissance. The whites associate equal parts of mauzac and chenin grapes, the reds and rosés bring together the freshness of gamay and the power of syrah grapes.

name: Domaine de Méjanassère (Vins d'Entraygues - Le Fel)
description: On the steep slopes,  4 hectares of vines overlook the Lot and Truyère valleys, between Rodez and Aurillac. The great speciality is chenin - called gamet d'Entrygues here - whose difficult acidity is perfectly mastered to give fruity fresh white wines. Reds and rosé agreeably associate mansois and cabernet franc. To discover: visit the winery, tasting and direct sales at the property.

description:
Situated at an altitude of 500m in the north of Aveyron, in Conques en Rouergue, Domaine de Moncles enjoys a beautiful south/south-east exposure on magnificent schist soils.
Charlotte and Auguste take particular care with their vines and walnut trees, in the unspoilt natural setting of the small hamlet of Moncles.
Once no longer part of the hamlet, the vines now stretch out in tight rows on terraces that follow the contour lines and back onto steep hillsides.

Our Franquette and Marbot walnut trees also benefit from this unique terroir.
We take great care to respect our soils and our surroundi
tldr: Découvrez une ferme bio en altitude produisant de l'huile de noix artisanale, dans un cadre préservé du Rouergue.

Situated at an altitude of 500m, in the north of Aveyron, in Conques en Rouergue, Domaine de Moncles enjoys a beautiful south/south-east exposure, on magnificent schist soils.
Charlotte and Auguste take particular care of their walnut trees and vines, in the unspoilt natural setting of the small hamlet of Moncles.
No longer found in Moncles, our vines stretch out in tight rows, on terraces respecting the contours of the land, and backed by steep hillsides.

name: DOMAINE DU CROS
description: Half way between Conques and Rodez, the vineyards cover some 500 acres in the heart of a precious valley. The main grape variety is the mansois, it is only exceptionally mixed and never more than 10%. the soil makes the difference by providing subtle nuances according to the location: limestone on the upper slopes, limestone scree on "rougier" mid-slope and "rougier" lower down.
