name: Explo nature - Canyoning
description: Monkey bridge, walkway, exceptional view, vultures, between acrobatic course and climbing... Come and enjoy a suspended aerial walk, intense moments and taste the pleasure of being up high. 20 minutes from Millau, we offer via ferrata at Le Boffi in the Gorges de la Dourbie with the Millau viaduct as a backdrop and vultures flying over your heads.
tldr: Traversez ponts de singe et passerelles aériennes, entre vultures et paysages vertigineux.

name: Explonature (groupes)
description: Cool off in our rivers, which will warm you up in the middle of winter, or dive into the secret bowels of the Combalou...Guillaume will guide you all year round to share unforgettable experiences.
tldr: Découvrez les rivières cachées du Combalou ou explorez les entrailles secrètes de la région.

name: Explonature Escalade
description: For an introductory course aimed at beginners or for advanced level teaching on long routes, come and climb on the cliffs near to the Millau viaduct, the gorges du Tarn and the gorges de la Jonte.
tldr: Grimpez les falaises près du Viaduc de Millau, encadré par des professionnels pour tous niveaux.

name: Explonature Millau Canyoning
description: Water jumping, swimming, abseiling, water sliding, choose between an easy canyon or a challenging one, its up to you!
tldr: Sautez, glissez et nagez dans des canyons adaptés, entre défis et paysages aquatiques.

name: Explonature randonnée aquatique
description:
River hiking is a softer variation of canyoning where obstacles are not mandatory and any difficult area can be bypassed if necessary. This activity is suitable for all ages from 8 years old.
All participants must be able to swim.
All the necessary technical equipment is supplied (neoprene wetsuit, harness, helmet).
Make sure you have closed sports shoes so that your feet are well maintained.
Several sites adapted to river hiking are available in the Aveyron department.

name: Explonature randonnée pédestre
description: Come and explore our region throughout wonderful hiking circuits. If you are interested in fauna, flora, geology or history then feel free to contact us.
tldr: Randonnez sur des circuits variés, entre faune, flore, géologie et histoire locale.

name: Explonature Spéléologie
description: Come and travel to the centre of the Earth and discover the mineral treasures that are hidden bellow your feet. Whatever is your level of practice come and discover this hidden world.
tldr: Plongez dans les trésors minéraux des grottes, accessibles à tous les niveaux de pratique.

name: Explonature Via Ferrata
description: In a dreamlike setting, make your way along a rock face between earth and sky. There are several routes available of different levels of practice, nearby the Millau viaduct, the gorges du Tarn and the gorges de la Jonte.
tldr: Escaladez les parois rocheuses entre Tarn et Viaduc de Millau, avec plusieurs niveaux de difficulté.

name: Explore Boussac
description:
A church firmly planted on the ground...


Built during 13th century, then fortified by the inhabitants during 14th & 15th centuries in order to protect themselves from the English invasion, its base gives evidence of it, with its 1 metre thick!

Also, crenels & arrow-loops & machicolation witness this defensive purpose. 3 storeys with rooms & accommodations were fit out above the nave in anticipation of prolonged sieges.
Enter the church, admire the strength of its pillars, peer into the magnificent golden altarpiece to identify the various figures represented... & try to locate the pipe inte

name: Explore Calmont - fortified village
description:
Its 15th century keep - private property -: this is all what remains of the castle of Calmont-de-Plancatge, former fief of the Arpajons, a barony who played an important role in the region's life. 


Renowened in the past for its fairs & hemp growing, now the village distinguishes itself thanks to its old half-timbered houses dating back to 15th century. A walk in the alleys will be enough for you to fell under its spell...

You want to go for a bike ride? Pedal along the itinerary "Le Tour des 5 clochers" - description in French - that will give you the opportunity to discover the unmissable

name: Explore Castelmary - fortified area
description:
More than 1,000 years of history...


Named Castrum Marinum in Latin, the hamlet's history can be dated back to 10th century, most probably.
Its nature defences - dense forest, steep land & rocks - & its geographical location - at the gates of the Rouergue region - explain its major military role : remains of the Castelmary Castle still testify to the important role played by this village in the Middle Age.

Owned by the Castelmaries from 11th to 14th century, this place was occupied by several Lords until the last ones : the Puel de Parlan family. These viscounts had bought the barony for exa

name: Explore Castelpers
description:
A moving castle...
Its first castle, built during mid-11th century, is the siege of powerful lords, who rule the area until the crusades era. When the Rouergue is dismantled, the Castelpers Lordship becomes one of the 12 baronies of the Rodez County.
After the 15th-century English occupation and the plunders led by bands of "routiers" (bandits), Castelpers endures the Wars of Religion, Lord Jean de Castelpers being the Calvinist Party leader.
Partially destroyed, deserted by its inhabitants, the old castle settled on the rocky spur overlooking the valley, is used as a quarry to buid the presen

name: Explore Naucelle
description:
To enter this town founded by Cistercian monks during the 12th century, use the Englishmen's Door, classified as an historical monument. Visit Saint-Martin Church with its magnificent organ and, once arrived in rue du Four, look up to admire the half-timbered houses.


What is a “sauveté”? In short: a place where you are safe (“sauf” in French)! 
It was a village or a market town built on seigneurial lands, around a church and its priory. Its territorial boundaries were shown thanks to stone crosses. The inhabitants benefited from a spiritual protection and a plot on which they could build fre

name: Explore Sauveterre de Rouergue
description:
Enter through the Saint-Christophe fortified gate and walk the Medieval alleys. They will drive you to the central square with its 47 arches surrounded by covered passageways. There, are gathered the big and beautiful houses that were owned by shopkeepers, magistrates and other prominent citizens. Prolong your immersive experience with a gourmet break.


What is a “bastide”?

It is a new town built between the 13th and the early 14th centuries. Its map is regular and distributed around a central square. It was founded by a king, a count, a lord, an abbot or a bishop. Want to learn more about t

name: Explore St-Just-sur-Viaur
description:
The St-Just-sur-Viaur District had around 1,700 inhabitants in late 19th century. With the last-century rural exodus, woods replaced hemp growing, fruit trees and vineyards. Today, with some 230 inhabitants, it is an ideal choice for nature and old-stone lovers.
A village that has been around for quite some time...

First mentioned in 1241, this former fortified hamlet hosts beautiful buildings, like the priory overlooking the River Viaur. In the old days, it belonged to the nuns of the "Monastère-sous-Rodez" and, as most of the Church properties, it was put up to auction in 1793. Have a look

name: Explore Taurines
description:
A hamlet built on a legend...


According to a local legend, it is said Taurines's primitive church was founded after a grave containing bones was discovered. Supposedly, its location was indicated by a bull's odd behaviour : it was scratching the ground at that precise spot (hence the name of "Taurines", bull meaning "taureau" in French). The population believed the bones belonged to holy body's remains, what was never confirmed by the Church.

... you can explore & unveil its heritage!
Take time to stroll in the hamlet & try to spot the Gallo-Roman altar or the castle's gate... that is no lo

name: Farm visits in Segala region (Aveyron)
description:
You will be immersed in the breeder's daily life : he will share with you his know-how and all the specifities of this "Label rouge" certified breeding !
You can discuss with him, go and seek for the cows to bring them back to the veals for feeding, give hay, and also learn about the work he does every day... and why not visit the whole farm ?
To plan your visit, get in touch with the IRVA (Interprofession du veau d'Aveyron et du Ségala) 24 to 48h before, dialing +33 (0)5.65.73.78.04. They look for a farm the closest possible to your holiday accommodation.
Have a good experience !
tldr: Visitez une ferme label rouge et échangez avec un éleveur passionné sur son métier.

name: Fed' Ane - Balades et randonnées avec un âne
description:
Nestled in the heart of a listed site on the Causse Noir, the Fed âne farm welcomes you with ?fèdes? (ewes), donkeys and many other furry and feathered animals. I'd be delighted to take you on a discovery tour or a longer adventure with one or more donkeys. An affectionate and hard-working companion, he'll accompany you between causses and rivers, and carry your belongings all the way!
Possibility of bivouacking on site and in surrounding farms (taking advantage of local produce) or staying in a gîte / auberge.
Sale of organic farm products: organic sheep meat products (dry sausage, terrines,

name: Fenaille Museum
description: Museum conserving rich collections of archaeology, art and history. The museum is renowned for its exceptional ensemble of statue-menhirs - sculpted 5000 years ago, they are the oldest monumental statues known in western Europe. The museum's circuit retraces the history of the Rouergue from the first man (300000years ago) to the 17th century. It is organised around four main themes: the statue-menhirs, ancient Rodez, the Rouergue in the Middle Ages, the 16th century and the Renaissance. Numerous tools to help your visit and enable a personalised approach to the collections using models, drawin
tldr: Découvrez les mystérieuses statues-menhirs, sculptures vieilles de 5000 ans, uniques en Europe.

name: FERME AUX MONZIOLS
description: On the Causse Sauveterre, the hamlet of Monziols testifies to a long agricultural activity which still persists today. The breeding, associated with the cereal culture, shaped both the landscapes and the buildings. One of the farms offers a beautiful glimpse of this past: it is located slightly away from the hamlet. Organized around an inner courtyard, the buildings are made of limestone. The main facade is the most elaborate, with its high gallery opening onto the courtyard through five arcades, which serves the dwellings and the wings of the other buildings. The building was connected to a b

name: Ferme beaux regards
description:
As market gardeners specializing in herbs, we choose varieties for their flavor in cooking.
We practice chemical-free farming and encourage biological regulation in our crops.

Our dishes are prepared the same day using our own produce and that of local organic producers. We also prepare the condiments, herbs and spices you'll find in our dishes.
tldr: Dégustez des herbes aromatiques cultivées sans pesticides, expliquées par des maraîchers passionnés.

name: Ferme Bio Cadas Emmanuel
description:
Direct sales of vegetables and meat.
For more information, please contact Mr Cadas on 07.87.12.92.20

name: Ferme d'Alcas
description:
FREE VISIT
Come and meet us every day at milking time, around 5.30pm. You'll be able to chat with us, Emilie and Alexandre, about our work, our values and the world of agriculture, while watching the milking and wandering freely in the sheepfold to see the ewes and their lambs during lambing time. Possibility of buying our products on site (self-service fridge)


EXHIBITION / TASTING TOUR (14/07 to 30/08)
We invite you to discover a biodynamic farm with on-farm processing through a three-part guided tour (sheepfold, yogurt workshop, cheese workshop).

Through a photo exhibition retracing the s
tldr: Assistez à la traite des brebis et échangez avec les éleveurs sur leur métier et leurs valeurs.

name: Ferme d'Alcas (groupe)
description:
Visit at 5pm
Historical presentation of the farm and its place in the community
Discovery of the feeding system
Visit to the sheepfold
Guided tour of the photo exhibition dedicated to the making of our Bleu cheese
Tasting of farm products
tldr: Visitez une ferme historique, découvrez l'alimentation des moutons et explorez une expo photo sur leur quotidien.

name: Ferme de Bouniols
description:
The farm of Bouniols is a small organic farm where we have several activities. The main activity is the breeding of goats and the transformation of cheese. We also have laying hens, 4 donkeys and we produce vegetables. We make conserves (sweet and salty).

You can find us on the market of Saint-Affrique all year long and of Saint-Rome-de-Tarn in summer.

name: Ferme de Gandalou
description:
Come and discover our farm, where we raise Simmental cows that produce milk for our Bleu des Causses PDO cheese. You'll be able to take part in the voluntary milking of the cows, feed them hay, and of course taste our products.
Guided tour of the farm, including a visit to the barn-drying workshop and milking robot.
Access: From Bozouls, take the D20 towards Entraygues. Go through Saint Julien de Rodelle. The Gandalou turnoff is 3 km on the left. In Gandalou, the farm is on your left.

name: Ferme de Gandalou (groupes)
description:
Come and discover our farm, where we raise Simmental cows that produce milk for our Bleu des Causses PDO cheese. You'll be able to take part in the voluntary milking of the cows, feed them hay, and of course taste our products.
Guided tour of the farm, including a visit to the barn-drying workshop and milking robot.
We welcome groups of up to 60 people all year round, by prior arrangement.
Access: From Bozouls, take the D20 towards Entraygues. Go through Saint Julien de Rodelle. The Gandalou fork is 3 km on the left. In Gandalou, the farm is on your left.

name: Ferme de l'Oustal Blanc
description: Small farm of 30 goats with cheese processing, farm on a human scale that produces with respect for animal welfare and nature.

name: Ferme de la Blaquière
description: The "Ferme de la Blaquière" is a family farm where the Castanier family will be happy to welcome you. In the heart of the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses, staying in our gîte or on our campsite, come and discover the activities of the  Ferme de la Blaquière: farm produced cheese sold, rides on dromedaries and numerous activities around the farm, the gîte or the campsite...

name: Ferme de la Borde
description: Discover the farm's animals on foot on the unaccompanied outdoor circuit (booking required).
tldr: Promenez-vous librement parmi les animaux de la ferme, sans guide, sur un parcours en plein air.

name: Ferme de Mayrinhac
description:
Pigs and lambs are raised and fed at Ferme de Mayrinhac. The cereals are grown without fertilizers or pesticides. The products, made in a laboratory that complies with all quality and hygiene standards, are prepared without preservatives or colorants. Fresh products are vacuum-packed to preserve their freshness and quality. Delight your taste buds with a range of farmhouse products: pâté de campagne, sausage, roast pork, leg of lamb, stuffed cabbage, blood pudding, terrines, etc. And eat healthy!
Pierre and Guillaume can be found at local markets:
- thursday mornings in Bozouls,
- friday morni

name: Ferme de Saint-Félix
description:
A family farm nestled in the heart of the Dourdou Valley we have created a cheese processing workshop.

Sale on the markets.
tldr: Découvrez une ferme fromagère nichée dans la vallée du Dourdou et goûtez leurs produits locaux.

name: Ferme découverte de la Borde
description:
Enjoy a day at La Borde farm. Discover and feed the farmyard animals. Visit the village of Bournazel on foot or in the company of the farm's donkeys. Lodging available on site in a bed and breakfast or camping.


Unaccompanied visit of the farm animals on the outdoor circuit from 10:30 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. (fee: 10?) by reservation: tel. 06 74 27 26 12
Guided visit by the owner (on reservation) to discover the animals' way of life, cuddle them and feed them. On request, the outdoor tour can be done on donkeys for children.
Package price for a family (maximum 5 pers.) 20?
For groups of 6 to 20 per
tldr: Passez une journée à nourrir les animaux, visitez Bournazel à pied ou à dos d'âne, et dormez sur place.

name: Ferme découverte du Gazenas
description:
They'll show you around their Simmental and Montbéliard herds, and explain births, feeding, grazing, milking and milk quality.

Welcome - Introduction to the farm - Guided tour.
Visit 3 buildings with distinct functions (bedding - nursery - feeding table) - Presentation of milking, followed by a short film on life on the farm, Bleu Causses tasting and cheese sales.

Visits by appointment.

During school vacations, morning visits for toddlers (under 6) by appointment (duration 1h), at a cost of ?6/child
tldr: Rencontrez les vaches Simmental et Montbéliard, assistez à la traite et comprenez leur élevage.

name: Ferme des Aza Lait
description:
La ferme des Aza lait is an organic farm. We process our milk into yoghurt, faisselle, plain fromage frais and fruit fromage frais. The farm has 17 Montbéliarde cows and 33 ha.
We sell our products in the following stores: Epicerie du Trou (Bozouls) - Epicerie "Localement Bon" (Espalion) - Bio d'Olt (Espalion) - Epicerie "Timatt" (Villecomtal) - Panier Paysan (Nuces) - Epicerie "a2pas" (Pruines).
No farm sales.

name: Ferme des Fleurines
description:
-    Visit to the sheepfold, discover the Lacaune ewes and see the sheep milking process.
-    Flaune tasting (The Flaune is a rolled-out pastry filled with “recuite” obtained by draining off the whey which is gently heated and turns into a slightly grainy cream, eggs are added and it is finally flavoured with orange blossom).
-    For your visit booking is essential.

name: Ferme du Gasquet - Colis de boeuf et veau
description: Farm in organic farming located in Segur on the Levezou.

name: FERME EN VILLE
description:
The Young Farmers of Lozère invite you to La Canourgue for the 2nd edition of “Ferme en ville.” Farm-themed activities await you all day long, culminating in a dance!

Enjoy plenty of activities throughout the day:
Yard sale and flea market with inflatable games organized by the rural community center
Mini farm
Raffle
Horse-drawn carriage rides
Equipment exhibition
Sheep shearing
Pedal tractor race
Refreshment stand

Starting at 12:00 PM:  Local Specialties Lunch
On the menu: Melon and ham, spit-roasted ham from GAEC Durand Francis-Bastien, baby potatoes, cheese from GAEC Ferme de Ressouche an

name: Ferme équestre "Les 2 chouettes"
description:
-Pony and horse rides (beginners welcome)
-2 to 5-day rides on the Lévézou mountains and lakes
-Riding school/ Pony-Club from age 3 - Outdoor riding
-Courses during school vacations / camps with accommodation in summer
-Birthday parties
-FFE-affiliated center: passage de galops Pleine Nature
On site, you can rent a large gîte with 4 rooms for 12 people.
tldr: Montez à poney ou à cheval sur les montagnes du Lévézou, même pour les débutants.

name: Ferme équestre de la Molière
description:
In the foothills of the Aubrac, 15 minutes from the village of St Geniez, come and join us for a relaxing and convivial time at the Equestrian Farm.
The farm offers a range of activities (booking required):
- Pony and donkey rides
- Lessons, introductions, rides and hikes from 1 hour 30 minutes to several days on request.
- Sulky rides for children or people with disabilities.
- Visit the farm with a pony and donkey baptism (grooming and a short ride) every Tuesday during the summer, starting July 15
- Training courses (ask the structure for details of days and themes)
-Sunset walks in summer.
tldr: Profitez d'activités équestres conviviales dans les collines de l'Aubrac, au calme.

name: Ferme équestre de Pomayret
description: Do you feel like simplicity and nature? Near Moyrazès, come for a ride or discover horseback riding with Eric, a state-qualified instructor, his ponies and horses. For all levels !
tldr: Randonnez simplement à cheval ou apprenez les bases avec un moniteur près de Moyrazès.

name: Ferme Equestre du Badour - Balade à Cheval
description: EQUI'ADULT: horse rides or riding lessons (introduction, practice or improvement). Relax in a convivial atmosphere, a real breath of fresh air and exchange with others: 1 hour, 2 hours or all day.
tldr: Échappez-vous à cheval ou en cours pour une balade ou une leçon, 1h à toute la journée.

name: Ferme équestre du Badour - Ecole d'équitation
description: Several activities: dressage, jumping, cross-country, horse-ball, trek, ethnology, pony games, races, circus and équi-fun. Training for the Galops national exams. Activities suitable for everyone.
tldr: Pratiquez dressage, horse-ball ou équi-fun, et préparez les Galops avec des pros.

name: Ferme La borie du Cauvel
description: During the guided, interactive tour, you'll learn all about milk. You'll finish on a gourmet note with a tasting of delicious local and home-made products. Reservations required.
tldr: Plongez dans l'univers du lait avec une visite interactive et terminez par une dégustation gourmande.

name: Ferme La Montagnette
description: Vente directe au détail de bœuf et veaux Aubrac

name: Ferme Les Chèvres de Léa
description:
Léa will explain her work and introduce you to her small flock, which you can get up close to, as well as her hens, whose eggs she also sells.
You can buy Léa's products and soaps on the days she's open, by appointment, or at the Rodez market on Saturday mornings in the town square.
Reservations required by telephone.
tldr: Approchez-vous des chèvres et poules de Léa, et repartez avec ses savons et produits fermiers.

name: Ferme Les Tronques
description:
The farm store:

Friday from 5pm to 7pm
and by appointment

name: Ferme Moulini
description: Ferme Moulini grow organic cereals and make their own flour. They bake sourdough breads, pizzas and other biscuits that can be tasted on site wednesday evenings.
tldr: Goûtez des pains et pizzas au levain cuits au feu de bois, faits avec leur farine bio.

name: Ferme pédagogique l'Arche du Rougier
description:
Self-guided tours are available without reservation.

Enjoy the unusual "Aqui Ba Pla!" experience and find out about the other tours in the "

name: Ferme Seguin / GAEC des Grands Causses
description: Visit the dairy sheep breeding and its lambs (according to the season- July-August-September and March) and milk the sheep. Visit the cheese production: 10 minute presentation video about cheese making on the farm. Tasting, refreshments and sales of cheese and local products.
tldr: Découvrez l'élevage ovin et la fabrication de fromage de brebis en direct, avec traite des brebis et dégustation.

name: Ferme Seguin / GAEC des Grands Causses (groupes)
description: Visit the dairy sheep breeding and its lambs (according to the season- July-August-September and March) and milk the sheep. Visit the cheese production: 10 minute presentation video about cheese making on the farm. Tasting, refreshments and sales of cheese and local products.
tldr: Pour les groupes : traite des brebis, visite fromagère et vidéo sur la fabrication du fromage de brebis.

name: Ferme Vallée du Jaoul
description:
Tasting and direct sales of products made on the farm (goose and duck foie gras, foie gras pâtés, confits, fritons, rillettes, home-made cassoulet with duck confit and many other specialties). Whole duck foie gras 2005 gold medal.
Visit the duck farm and processing plant all year round by appointment.
tldr: Dégustez et achetez foie gras, confits, rillettes et cassoulet maison, produits fermiers de qualité.

name: Fête de la Randonnée Pédestre
description:
Two loops:
10 km: 3h walk
14 km: 4h walk
Loops start at 9am from the village hall.
Refreshments at mid-course.
Arrival at the gourmet market.
Organized by Los Caminaïres de Centrès

name: Fly Millau Parapente
description:
Tandem flight from 3 to 90 years old, from discovery flight to acrobatic flight. We can take 4 people at the same time in a flight! 
Price between €65 and €230.
tldr: Tandem en parapente pour tous âges, du vol découverte aux figures acrobatiques, avec 4 places simultanées.

name: Forêt jardin du Landassou
description:
The garden forest, between nature and culture

Since 2013, a former artificial peerage, very poor in animal and plant species, is the place of a wild garden experiment, where I try with the minimum of interventions to develop a hybrid space, half-spontaneous, half-cultivated. I plant, I maintain the paths to facilitate the walk, but above all I welcome what wants to come. The spirit is that of Eric Lenoir's punk garden and Robert Hart's forest garden. You will discover the pleasure of walking comfortably but in the middle of wild grass, in a landscape that is meant to close in while keeping in
tldr: Explorez un jardin-forêt expérimental où nature et culture se rencontrent depuis 2013.

name: Fort cistercien de St-Jean d'Alcas (groupes)
description:
Built in the 15th century to protect the local population from the turmoil caused by the Hundred Years' War, it remained until the French Revolution the symbol of the power of the Ladies of Nonenque, the neighbouring Cistercian nuns who had administered this territory since the 12th century.
            Guided tours of the Fort des Dames reveal an unusual history that challenges preconceived notions about the medieval period. From the cobbled streets to the ramparts and refuge rooms, visitors will discover more than just a cleverly planned defensive structure. It is also the story of pious, po
tldr: Visitez une forteresse médiévale du XVe siècle, symbole du pouvoir des Dames de Nonenque jusqu'à la Révolution.

name: FORTERESSE DE MALEPEYRE
description:
Between the village of La Canourgue and the Causse de Sauveterre, the rocky wall known as "La Forteresse" is a cliff of limestone rock in shades of beige and grey, several dozen metres high. It is nicknamed because of its position on the slope of a deep valley and its imposing size. The most spectacular view of this rocky formation is from the D46 departmental road,
which winds its way up the hillside to reach the Causse de Sauveterre
Source: DREAL Languedoc-Roussillon, April 2007.
tldr: Admirez une falaise calcaire de plusieurs dizaines de mètres, idéale pour randonnées et paysages grandioses.

name: Fountain of the Mother of God
description: Come and discover the fountain of the Mother of God in the village of Le Dourn. From there, you will have access to a remarkable point of view on the plateau of Ségala.

name: Freemick Aventure - Jeux d'évasion et d'aventure mobiles
description:
Our treasure hunt 2.0 offers you the opportunity to go on an adventure in the heart of the city, simply equipped with your smartphone. The riddles that will guide you along the route will appear in augmented reality on your screen! Fun, modern and open to all, we offer you a different visit of Rodez for about 2 hours
All the information on www.freemicktraque.fr
tldr: Résolvez des énigmes en ville via une chasse au trésor mobile avec votre smartphone pour une aventure urbaine.

name: Freemick Aventure - Jeux d'évasion et d'aventure mobiles (groupes)
description:
From 20 people to over 80, from a 30-minute escape game to a tailor-made treasure hunt, we'll find the right formula to suit your needs and expectations.  
All our services are 100% mobile.
tldr: Organisez un escape game ou une chasse au trésor sur mesure pour groupes de 20 à 80 personnes, 100% mobile.

name: Fromagerie coopérative des Bergers du Larzac
description:
A few years ago, men and women decided to create their own cheese factory to promote their only wealth: sheep's milk.

20 producers from Larzac and the Levezou mountains have come together to create a range of sheep cheeses with character! For this our tommes are matured in a natural cellar with 4 levels underground, which gives them a unique taste and floral crust! These are some 26 cheeses, 9 of which are from organic farming.



 Direct sale.
tldr: Découvrez des fromages de brebis artisanaux fabriqués par 20 producteurs réunis pour valoriser le lait de Larzac.

name: Fromagerie des Cabasses
description: La fromagerie des Cabasses is a traditional family cheese dairy located in Verrières and produces cheeses made from raw ewe's milk such as pérails, tomme and raclette de brebis. You can buy all these products directly at the cheese dairy!
tldr: Achetez des fromages de brebis traditionnels (pérails, tomme, raclette) fabriqués à partir de lait cru.

name: Fromagerie du Griffoul
description:
We offer butter, milk, fromage frais, crème fraîche and faisselle.
For cheese, we offer tome, creamy square and brick.
 You can buy our products directly from the farm, or at the markets in:
- Salles Curan on Saturday mornings,
- Laissac on Tuesday mornings,
- Sévérac d'Aveyron on Thursday mornings
- Millau on Friday mornings
We are also present at the "Pays'en Direct" farm store, 2 rue des Moutiers, Rodez.
tldr: Dégustez beurre, faisselle et fromages de brebis fermiers, vendus à la ferme ou sur les marchés locaux.

name: Fromagerie du Pré Claux
description:
Products processed on site: raw goat's milk specialties, charcuterie and meat products from free-range pork and goats.
Farm sales every Tuesday and Friday from 3pm to 5pm.
tldr: Achetez des spécialités caprines, charcuteries et viandes de porc et chèvre élevés en plein air, le mardi et vendredi.

name: Fromagerie du Salze
description: From January to August, we have for sale plain yoghurt or yoghurt with marmalade, soft curd, fresh cheese, curd cheese (or brousse) and almost all year round, ripened tome (depending on availability)
tldr: Découvrez yaourts, brousses et tomes fermières, produits toute l'année ou selon saisonnalité.

name: Fromagerie Fromabon
description:
Made exclusively from ewe's and goat's milk from the arid, chalky Larzac plateau, our melt-in-the-mouth, creamy cheeses and ripened tommes are crafted with respect and rigor for traditional methods. Fromabon is a family-run business that produces a wide range of artisanal cheeses, including lactic, soft, pressed and washed cheeses.
You can also taste and buy their cheeses:
- in their boutique
- at markets: Nant on Tuesday mornings from June to September, Montpellier (les Arceaux) on Saturdays, Ganges on Fridays, Mauguio on Sundays.
- on their website
tldr: Goûtez des fromages crémeux et tommes affinées, fabriqués exclusivement à partir de lait de brebis et chèvre du Larzac.

name: Fromagerie Jeune Montagne (Groupes)
description: Free visit of the Fromagerie (cheese production). You will see a film that goes back to the origins of Fromage de Laguiole AOC and Aligot de l'Aubrac. From a gallery you will be able to see the fabrication workshops! You will be impressed by the cellar with its generations of Fromages de Laguiole lovingly watched over. In the tasting area you will be offered Fromages de Laguiole at different stages of maturing.
tldr: Visitez la fromagerie de Laguiole, découvrez l'AOC et l'aligot, avec vue sur la fabrication depuis une galerie.

name: Fromagerie Le Vézou - GAEC BOUTET-PUECH
description: You can find our quality products at the farm, in local stores, and at markets: Salles-Curan in July and August, and Rodez on Saturday mornings all year round.

name: Fromagerie Les Artisous
description:
We welcome you to our cheese store in La Cavalerie. You'll find all our products, of course, but also other local products from Aveyron. Local cheeses. Groceries and cakes. Home-made ice creams. Organic sheep's yoghurt

Come and taste our cheeses on site and leave with a taste of local authenticity. Come and discover all our Larzac ewe's milk cheeses: soft, tome or fromage frais.

Home-made; direct sale or at the Gignac and Lodève markets on Saturday mornings
tldr: Dégustez fromages locaux, glaces maison et produits du terroir dans une fromagerie conviviale à La Cavalerie.

name: GAEC d'Ambias
description:
Located in the heart of the Aveyron not far from the Millau Viaduct, La Ferme d'Ambias has been raising dairy sheep, pigs and Aubrac cows in the open air for 6 generations.
They cultivate on their land the food to feed the animals in a natural and autonomous way and they made the choice of a reasoned agriculture. Come to buy the products directly at the farm, at the point of sale of La Cavalerie or on the markets!

name: GAEC d'Azinières
description:
Small farm of 64 ha in total with a herd of 11 cattle, as well as a pig farm. Fresh products available on a daily basis.
Find their products directly at the farm or at the Marché Paysan in Millau

name: GAEC d'Ecausse
description: Production and sale of meat (heifer and cows Aubrac, Limousine and Galloway beef)
tldr: Achetez de la viande bovine Aubrac, Limousine et Galloway, élevée et transformée localement.

name: GAEC de Courtilles
description:
Sale of green lentils in bags of 1kg and 500g. Jars of 750g of lentil sausages and 750g of lentil merguez.

The ewes used to make the sausages and merguez come from our farm, which is subject to the Roquefort PDO. In addition, we feed our animals without GMOs and without silage.
It is an HVE (High Environmental Value) farm.
tldr: Dégustez lentilles vertes, saucisses et merguez à base de lentilles, produites à partir d'agneaux de la ferme.

name: Gaec de Farals
description:
Manufacture of tomes, pérails with ewe's milk
Sale every morning from Monday to Saturday
Products available at Temps d'antan in Salles Curan and at the Roques creamery in Salles Curan.
tldr: Achetez des tomes et pérails au lait de brebis, vendus chaque matin du lundi au samedi.

name: Gaec de la chèvre Blanche (cabécous)
description:
Farm sales.
Present at the Marcoles market on Tuesday mornings, Montsalvy(15) on Thursday mornings and Entraygues on Friday mornings (all year round)
Farm market on July 20 and August 10, starting at 6pm. You'll be able to taste delicious local produce on the farm.
tldr: Dégustez des cabécous fermiers aux marchés de Marcoles, Montsalvy ou Entraygues, produits avec le lait de chèvres locales.

description: Order the products on the website www.loco-motives.fr

name: Gaec de Montredon  - Plats cuisines
description:
GAEC de Montredon offers farmhouse products: potatoes, squash and canned dishes made from meat and vegetables produced on the farm
The meat and vegetables are certified organic, and great care is taken to produce quality food.
The farm has been exclusively organic since 1997.
tldr: Découvrez des plats cuisinés bio à base de légumes et viandes de la ferme, cultivés et préparés sur place à Arvieu.

name: GAEC de Salelles
description: Bread and meet sale and production.
tldr: Achetez du pain et de la viande fermiers directement à la ferme de Saint-Izaire, pour des produits frais et locaux.

name: GAEC de Terre Blanc
description:
We have been farming dairy sheep since 1993 to produce milk for the Roquefort cheese. With 380 sheep of Lacaune breed. In 2010 we chose to work in organic farming.

To correspond to the pastoralism, since 2012 we transhumance the herd on a communal estive above the village of Roquefort for 3 months under the supervision of the shepherd.

Since 2014 we raise organic laying hens. We have an approved packing center which allows us to sell our eggs in local stores and local communities.

Sales in stores: Biocoop, La Vie Claire, Epicerie Del Païs and Lou Passou Bio in between seasons.

name: GAEC des deux Causses
description:
We transform the milk of our Montbeliarde cows into traditional cheeses from the upper Lot Valley. We call them the "Deux Causses" (matured cheeses).
We have expanded our range with lactic, creamy and white beaten cheeses.
During the confinement of 2020, we started the production of small tommes.
Our premises are not intended for visits.

name: Gaec La ferme du Vialaret

description: On the banks of the Lot, in 3 rooms on of which has a vaulted ceiling, the Museum opens its doors in July and August each year to themed temporary exhibitions, free.

name: Galerie Les Capucines
description:
Galerie Les Capucines, inaugurated in 2019, aims to make art accessible to as many people as possible. Paintings, sculptures, photographs and many other forms of pictorial expression are on offer from September to June. Admission is free during normal MJC opening hours.
Abstract and figurative paintings, sculptures, installations, photography, drawing, calligraphy... are just some of the pictorial expressions that punctuate the cultural season. Particular attention is paid to encounters with artists and works of art, through mediation activities for all audiences.
tldr: Admirez des œuvres d'art variées (peintures, sculptures, photos) dans une galerie accessible à Onet-le-Château.

name: Galerie Peyrusse
description: Contemporary and commercial gallery in the center of Peyrusse-le-Roc, with 4 to 5 exhibitions a year. Open Sundays and public holidays from 2pm to 6pm. (free admission).

name: Game off Road - Laser Kart
description:
Discover the Ultimate Thrill of Laser Karting at the gates of Rodez at Game Off Road!

 Immerse yourself in a unique adventure
Game Off Road invites you to enjoy an extraordinary experience just outside Rodez: Laser Karting. Combining the thrill of karting with the intensity of laser gaming, this activity is designed for fans of action, competition and thrills.

 A revolutionary concept
Take control of our high-performance electric karts and engage in thrilling races where every turn counts. But Laser Karting doesn't stop there! Armed with laser guns, you'll need to aim precisely to score poin
tldr: Vivez une expérience intense de laser karting en plein air aux portes de Rodez, pour un jeu d'équipe endiablé.

name: Game off Road - Quad
description: A supervised outing with your quad to discover the emblematic sites of Aveyron. From the rougier to the limestone causse, Marc Molinié, a qualified FFM guide, will take you through the department to make you discover its most beautiful nuggets.

name: Game off Road - Trott-Cross
description:
This outdoor activity is suitable for beginners and experienced sportsmen alike. In complete safety and with the help of an instructor, you'll ride along a defined itinerary through trails of varying relief. Trot-cross is ideal if you want to get away from it all with family or friends during your getaway or vacation in Aveyron.  
To suit everyone, we offer 1h, 1h30 and 2h tours. It is also possible to go for a full-day ride (5h). Safety equipment will be provided so that you can enjoy this unusual excursion in the best possible conditions.
tldr: Testez le Trott-Cross, une activité ludique et sportive en pleine nature, encadrée par des professionnels.

name: Géocaching à Arvieu
description:
To find the caches hidden in our villages, download the free application: www.geocaching.com. You will then be geolocated and will only have to follow the instructions. A dot indicates your position on the map. When you move, the dot also moves and tells you if you are going in the right direction. A clue also helps you in your quest.
In Arvieu park in front of the town hall and continue on foot. Look for a small box that contains a "logbook" on which you will write the date of the day and your nickname. If there are small objects inside (sticky, ball...) you can take one of them provided you
tldr: Parcourez les villages d'Arvieu à la recherche de caches géocaching, une chasse au trésor moderne et gratuite.

name: Goûts d'Absolu
description:
Le Rucher du Lévézou - ORGANIC A.B. certified honey is harvested when ripe, respecting the fundamental bio-dynamic cosmic rhythms of certified organic beekeeping. In the honey house, the utmost care is taken to ensure that the honey is unsealed by hand with a knife, is not pasteurized or heated, and is hand-potted on site at the honey house.
Our honey undergoes no processing whatsoever, to preserve its taste, nutritional and therapeutic (especially healing) properties. Gustatively, it has subtle, intense flavors, with fruity notes.
Production of organic berries and fruit, blueberries and raspb
tldr: Découvrez des miels bio certifiés A.B. récoltés selon les rythmes cosmiques, dans une ferme apicole du Lévézou.

name: HISTORIC TOWN CENTRE
description:
Take a stroll from square to square, making your way along the pedestrian-only streets and make some fine discoveries. A historic area where medieval residences stand side by side with Renaissance-style houses.
In Rodez, the market town and the town centre have grown up together since the Middle Ages.
Once under the jurisdiction of a bishop, the town centre developed around Notre-Dame Cathedral and the episcopal palace (17th century), recognisable through its brick façade, its large, double flight of stairs and fortified terraces.

description: Abseil down the region's dry canyons. The natural erosion of the Causses has produced numerous ravines and dry canyons. Several sites to explore: green canyon at Verrières (first time abseils), a succession of abseils, one of which is 165 feet at the end of the course and zip-line). Other sites close by.
tldr: Descendez en rappel des canyons secs du Causse, une aventure verticale unique et accessible.

name: Horizon - Millau canyoning
description:
Discovery canyon closed on Monday and Saturday / 2h activity
Aquatic hike located in the Tayrac or Mourier rivers, 40km away from Millau. With a neoprene suit and a helmet: this pretty canyon has manu jumps and toboggans (up to 7m for the more audacious... The jumps are optional).
Initiation canyon closed on Tuesday and Thursday / 2hrs 2h30 activity
Located at 40km east from Millau, this canyon has first part in aquatic hike followed by a series of more vertical ways. The basic equipment also includes a harness, some lanyards and a descender. You will cross little waterfalls by abseiling, with
tldr: Canyoning aquatique dans des rivières sauvages, avec combinaisons et casques pour une immersion totale.

name: Horizon - Millau Escalade
description: Come and discover the most beautiful climbs in the region in major sites. For a first approach to the activity or to improve your climbing techniques.
tldr: Grimpez sur des falaises réputées près de Millau, encadré par des professionnels pour tous niveaux.

name: Horizon - Millau spéléologie
description:
Discovery, Sporty or Explo vertical caving.
Discovery: about 2 hours of exploration in a "horizontal" cavity. With an appropriate suit and a helmet with LED lights, explore the underground "caussenard" world. (family and children oriented activity). 
Sporty: about 3 hours of exploration in a more vertical cave with some technical passages: abseiling, a little bit of climbing and some ladders. Half-day activity, convivial and accessible!
Grande Verticale: 100 meters deep cavity exploration with more technical concepts, like descent and ascent with a rope. Guaranteed ambiance!
tldr: Explorez une grotte horizontale avec casque LED et combinaison, une aventure souterraine accessible à tous.

name: Horizon - Millau via ferrata
description:
These courses have bars, cables, monkey bridges and walkways. Discover these beautiful landscapes in little groups with an instructor. These via have two distinct ways: an "easy" one and a more difficult one.
Activity accessible from 12 years old. Group price starting from 5 people, on reservation according to the weather. RC monitor insurance is included. The transport is not included.
Via equipment rental for more experienced people.
tldr: Grimpez une via ferrata avec câbles et ponts de singe, encadré par un moniteur, pour des paysages à couper le souffle.

name: Horizon Millau  Parapente
description: For every age (from 4 years old for the discovery flight) and during every season, discover the magic of flying. Group price starting from 5 people. Activity on reservation from March to late October, every day depending on the weather. Contact us to know the place of your appointment with an instructor. A shuttle will take you to the take-off site and from the landing area (it depends on the location).
tldr: Découvrez le vol en parapente dès 4 ans, une expérience magique au-dessus des paysages aveyronnais.

name: Hospitaler Tower And Commander's Grave
description: In 1392, the people of Martrin made a request to the Commander Pons de Panat for permission to build a defensive tower onto the side of the church to provide the inhabitants with a place of refuge during periods of war and to store their belongings so that they could be kept safe from pillage. You can also visit the Commanders grave, which is set inside the church. It is actually the tomb of Commander Pénavayre of Salèls and is carved out of fine-grained sandstone rock, which was extracted from the surrounding quarries. The lid is ornamented with crosses, coats of arms and gothic inscriptions.
tldr: Visitez une tour défensive du XIVe siècle intégrée à l'église, dernier refuge des habitants pendant les guerres.

name: Hôtel de Bonald
description: Beautiful 16th century tower inside the courtyard. This building was the residence of one of the greatest families of Rouergue.
tldr: Admirez une tour Renaissance du XVIe siècle, ancienne résidence d'une grande famille rouergate.

name: Hôtel de Coignac
description: In 1927, the Chamber of Commerce bought the building to install its offices, which it occupied until the 1990s. Stores on the first floor were occupied until the 1960s. The stained glass windows on the first floor were made after the Second World War. The tourist office has occupied the building since 2013.
tldr: Découvrez un hôtel particulier du XXe siècle aux vitraux remarquables, témoin de l'histoire économique locale.

name: Hôtel de France
description: The Hotel de France was built in the 18th century on land that belonged to the family of a notable, France de Lorne.
tldr: Explorez un hôtel particulier du XVIIIe siècle, symbole du patrimoine architectural aveyronnais.

name: Hôtel de Jouéry (Musée Fenaille)
description: Its limestone facade is in Renaissance style. Inside the museum is preserved the courtyard of this ancient residence, the heart of the museum and an architectural jewel. Next to the Jouéry's hotel, is one of the oldest houses of Rodez dating partially from the XIIth century). Two sculptures can be seen on its façade: a wolf and an acrobat.

name: Hôtel de Lauro
description: Former residence of a canon. Later, it was transformed several times into a school and a presbytery. Today it houses the Compagnons du Devoir.
tldr: Visitez l'ancien presbytère devenu siège des Compagnons du Devoir, un lieu chargé d'histoire.

name: Hôtel de Séguret
description: Bourgeois hotel which belonged to an important family of magistrates. One can admire the portal and the classical inner courtyard.
tldr: Découvrez un hôtel bourgeois aux décors classiques, ancienne demeure d'une famille de magistrats.

name: Hôtel Lenormand d'Ayssènes
description: Built at the beginning of the 18th century by the family of the tax collector. Major transformations took place when the Prefecture moved into this building (1825). On the facade, a medallion recalls the memory of Jean Moulin who was Prefect of Aveyron from 1937 to 1939.
tldr: Visitez un hôtel du XVIIIe siècle marqué par l'histoire de la Préfecture et son médaillon emblématique.

name: House of Jeanne – One of the oldest houses in Aveyron
description:
Discover the House of Jeanne, one of the oldest houses in Aveyron, nestled in the narrow streets of the medieval town of Sévérac-le-Château.

Dating from the 14th century, it stands at No. 10 Rue de Belvezet, at the corner of Passage de l’Hospice. It catches the eye with its typical architecture: half-timbered walls, wattle and daub sections, two levels of overhanging upper floors, narrow openings including an oval window to the south and a mullioned window to the north, and a raised entrance protected by the upper floor.

In July and August, the House of Jeanne hosts medieval-themed activitie
tldr: Découvrez l'une des plus anciennes maisons d'Aveyron, nichée dans les ruelles médiévales de Sévérac.

name: House of the writer Jean Boudou
description:
Reception, shop, garden, outside stage, various events, contemporary exhibitions, etc., are some of the components that give rythm to the life of this house.
For your visit, you will be guided for 1h-1.30h in this playfull route punctuated with interactive terminals, videos, staged dummies, photos, music, sound effects. A whole universe to explore !
Additional services : conferences, temporary exhibitions, shows around the occitan culture (South of France).
Trilingual site : Occitan, French and English. For all types of public.
__________________________________________________________________
tldr: Explorez la maison de l'écrivain Jean Boudou, un lieu culturel vivant avec expositions et événements.

A wooden terrace and a lawned area with relaxing chairs welcome you to enjoy sunbathing.

tldr: Parcourez la Vallée du Tarn avec transport de bagages et accompagnement, pour des randonnées sans contraintes.

name: Jardin Botanique de l'Aubrac
description: Paired visit "Jardin Botanique and Maison de l'Aubrac" to discover the natural and cultural heritage of the Aubrac. Both inside and outdoors, through the seasons. Hundreds of wild plants, a peat bog with insect eating plants, a "protected plants" circuit, a "toxic plants" circuit, a complete programme of shows with visits, slide shows, tastings...
tldr: Découvrez des centaines de plantes sauvages et une tourbière préservée au fil des saisons dans ce jardin botanique de l'Aubrac.

name: Jardin botanique Vinh Luu
description:
This space was created in memory of Vinh Luu, a doctor of physical and mathematical sciences who spent several decades roaming the paths of Villecomtal and the surrounding area, collecting medicinal plants and teaching students from all over the country about their properties.
The garden, planted with more than 150 varieties of medicinal plants, shrubs and trees, can be explored independently thanks to explanatory panels. Embellished with an arbour and a pond, it's the perfect place for a peaceful stroll.
The garden is a 12-minute walk from the village center on the road to Muret le Château.

name: Jardin d'insectes dit du perce-oreille
description: Discover the insects around the vegetable garden, the orchard, the pond, the compost, the wood pile... presentation of their usefulness thanks to explanatory panels.
tldr: Explorez un jardin dédié aux insectes autour d'un potager, d'un verger et d'un étang, avec des panneaux explicatifs sur leur utilité.

name: Jardin de Cantoperlic - le jardin des quatre saisons
description: Cantoperlic is a garden open to visitors one weekend a month. The association also organizes convivial evenings twice a year. These can be country-style meals, concerts, musical walks or workshops (yoga, pottery, watercolor).
tldr: Jardin des quatre saisons ouvert un week-end par mois, avec ateliers et soirées conviviales autour de la nature.

name: Jardin de la Colombie
description:
a first formal garden (box hedges, paths that cross) then a path that passes by the chestnut dryer, a small belvedere to see Brousse, a variety of wet or very dry beds, remarkable trees, then a valley with rosebushes, trees and an underground canal.
many seats and explanatory panels as well as a plasticized plan to follow the visit.
The visit is free but you can always ask for information to Dominique who is present in the garden.

name: Jardin de la Nauze
description:
You will discover, during your wanderings in the garden of Nauze, massifs of perennials, a basin, a metallic cloister, mounds of permaculture, an orchard and an orientation table allowing to observe Lévézou.

Temporary exhibitions of sculptures scattered throughout the garden and paintings exhibited in the floral workshop throughout the summer.
Accompaniment during the visit of the garden if desired, adult and child questionnaire provided to help discover the garden.
tldr: Promenez-vous dans ce jardin aux massifs de vivaces, un bassin, un cloître métallique et des buttes de permaculture à Camboulazet.

name: Jardin des enclos
description: Sloping and terraced garden where themed species follow each other: blue garden, sun loving flower garden, prickly slope, winemaker's corner, three lakes...
tldr: Découvrez un jardin en terrasses aux thèmes variés : jardin bleu, jardin des fleurs aimant le soleil, pente épineuse et coin du vigneron.

name: jardin du château de Bournazel
tldr: Flânez dans ce jardin Renaissance aux parterres géométriques, havre de paix au pied du château.

name: Jardin le Delphinium
description:
Delphine is a producer of Perfume, Aromatic and Medicinal Plants and offers you many products with original flavors to brighten up your taste buds all year long!
> Vegetable plants to prepare the garden in spring
> Herbal salts for your barbecues this summer
> Jams to prolong the flavors in the fall
> Sweet herbal teas for a warm winter
> Flower figs to enhance your meals

Open for Heritage Days from Saturday afternoon
tldr: Dégustez des produits originaux à base de plantes aromatiques et médicinales cultivées et transformées par Delphine.

name: JD'AIR
description: Discover the Lévézou region and its lakes by microlight. Depart from the Vernhes nautical base in Salles Curan, and fly over Lac de Pareloup, Lac de Pont-de-Salars, Villefranche-de-Panat and the wind farm. Flight of 15 to 30 min at most with wind turbines.

name: Jeu de piste "Eliette à Saint-Clair de Verdun"
description:
How do you play the game? Download the game booklet (also available in hard copy from the Sauveterre-de-Rouergue and Naucelle tourist offices), read the first clue and off you go!
This game is only available during the opening hours of the Chapelle Saint Clair de Verdun.
Try our other nearby treasure hunts and treasure trails:
- Mystery at Sauveterre
- The magic of stone
- Mystery in Cassagnes-Bégonhès
- RandoLand in Camboulazet
tldr: Résolvez des énigmes en suivant Eliette à travers Saint-Clair de Verdun avec ce jeu de piste téléchargeable ou disponible en version papier.

name: Jeu de piste "Mystère à Cassagnes-Bégonhès"
description:
On that morning in 1682, his father was to take some of the leathers he had made in his workshop to Rodez, and Begon was to accompany him. As they were about to leave, they noticed that the leathers were missing!
To identify the thief and understand why he did what he did, you'll have to search the village for clues. You'll need to solve a number of riddles, as not everyone in the village will be able to help you. Some of them are highly suspicious...
How to play?
Download the booklet, follow the path indicated on the map, solve the 9 riddles... and unmask the thief among the six suspects!

Tr
tldr: Reconstituez le mystère du cuir disparu en 1682 à Cassagnes-Bégonhès avec ce jeu de piste historique.

name: Jeu Murder au château de Montaigut
description: Petit Meurtre en famille is a game that requires an analytical and deductive mind: 10 letters to read, 2 chests to open, 8 enigmas but only one murderer. Can you find him?
tldr: Résolvez 8 énigmes pour démasquer le meurtrier dans ce jeu d'énigmes familial au château de Montaigut.

name: Journée du patrimoine Site de St Georges de Camboulas
description:
12th-century Romanesque church with fortified arcaded bell tower. Above the portal is a fragment of a tympanum depicting Christ the Judge, which may have come from the former cathedral of Rodez.
Nearby is an oratory dating from the 16th century.
Legend: At the beginning of the Christian era, Saint George, pursued by the Saracens, ordered his horse to jump the Viaur valley in order to flee his pursuers. His horse's hooves left their mark on the rock beneath the church of Saint Georges. In the 12th century, Christians built a church very close to the spot where the miracle occurred. The fortifie

In a relaxed, family atmosphere, we offer a choice of 7kms, 12kms and 18kms routes along the river Tarn, passing under the viaduct, along the sublime semi-troglodyte village of Peyre, the railway bridge near Cerrnon, an old fish farm, all the way to the sumptuous Baumes waterfall at st-Rome-de-Tarn....Routes with no time limit for arrival, guaranteed to make for an unforgettable day. You can also spend a night under the stars at Katalpa thanks to "la grande aventure", a 24-kilometer adventure over
tldr: Pagaiez en famille sur le Tarn avec des parcours de 7, 12 ou 18 km, dans une ambiance détendue et conviviale.

"L'Ancre" is the public reception area of the Pays Ségali arts and crafts center. Dedicated to the promotion of art and creative professions, it welcomes you to its designer shop on the ground floor and offers you a cultural program of exhibitions from April to December.
A person in charge of reception will be able to inform you about the activities of the arts and crafts center and its members. Discover the paths of Bozoulais in the company of donkeys. Choupette, Uron, Calin, Titou and Tango will be delighted to accompany you and motivate the children to go for a walk. Walks are accompanied. We can take groups or families out with the donkeys on marked trails around Bozouls (1-hour, half-day or full-day tours). name: L'Arc en Miel bee farm
description:
A true honey of flowers, is it still possible ?
At Nadia and Bruno, passionate professional beekeepers, the question arises every day. In their organic farm in the Pays du Roquefort, they explore beekeeping that is sensitive to biodiversity equilibrium, and where bees find more autonomy thanks to exceptional ecosystems.
In the face of current challenges, L'Arc en Miel is experimenting with demanding beekeeping practices:
Less CO², thanks to careful selection of preserved local terroirs
Hives at the heart of rich ecosystems, promoting bee resilience

name: L'Église du Cambon ouvre ses portes
description:
Come discover a place rich in heritage, history, and peace.
This church in Le Cambon is dedicated to Saint Julien.
Today, the only remaining traces of this former parish seat are the cemetery and the beautiful priory building, dating from the 16th century.
Until the 17th century, the parish of Le Cambon extended into the territory of the present-day municipality of Castelnau de Mandailles. At that time, it comprised more than a hundred villages and was one of the largest in the Rouergue region.


The layout of the Romanesque church has been preserved: a nave with side aisles and three east-fac

name: L'Enigme France escape game
description:

description:

name: La Ferme des Vézinies (groupes)
