You'll discover the life of our ewes on the farm, the various facilities and equipment we use to ensure their well-being, and our commitment to quality (Organic Farming). Tasting of Roquefort or cheeses made from our ewes' milk and guided tour of the farm on reservation. The tour ends with a film screening: "The 4 seasons at the Vézinies farm".

name: La Ferme du Bêêêz
description:
Visit the goats in the meadow:
nothing to do with the goats but cuddle. Take a stroll with the kids, enjoy the sunshine if it's available, cavort with Müesli, the queen of our herd, chew a blade of grass with Romeo or cuddle our lonely goat Philippines.

Forest walk with the goats:
Spend a morning sharing the daily life of goat herders on a forest trail

Picnic area available
We accept no responsibility for children covered in slime and mud. Any child left behind will be fed on hay until they reach the age of majority.

Closed shoes compulsory, our dog friends are not allowed

Reservations onl
tldr: Câlinez Müesli, la reine de la ferme, et promenez-vous dans les prés avec les chèvres sous le soleil.

name: La ferme du Ceor
description:
The CEOR farm is a member of the network "Invitation à la ferme" which gathers all over France 100% organic and local farms !
Distributes its products to the Aveyronnaise shop and to the Carrefour Contact in Cassagnes Bégonhès, to the POUGET grocery store in Salmiech, to the Supermarket Au temps D'Antan in Salles Curan, to the Intermarché in PONT DE SALARS, among others and to 80 kms around the farm.
tldr: Découvrez des produits 100% bio et locaux issus de la ferme du Ceor, vendus en Aveyron.

name: La Ferme du Froncalou
description:
We (Ismaëlle and Grégory) took over Ismaëlle's family farm in 2018. We decided to transform some of the milk from our 50 cows into fresh products.
We want to make the simplest, most natural products possible. The recipe is simple: milk and ferments. In our jams, which you'll find in some of our products, we use only local or French fruit and sugar. The lemon zest comes from Menton.
Travel with our petit suisse (silver medalist at the Concours Général Agricole in Paris in 2024!), our Greek yoghurt or our skyr! Rediscover the flavors of yesteryear with our crème fraîche!
Don't hesitate to come a
tldr: Goûtez des produits laitiers naturels transformés artisanalement par Ismaëlle et Grégory sur leur ferme familiale.

name: La ferme du Lévézou - Franck Josceran
description:
Under a covered building, you'll see Aubrac cows with their young calves, goats, ewes, rabbits, chickens... Young and old alike can take part in animal care and feeding workshops.
Visits all year round by reservation the day before (check visiting times). The breeding facilities and store are accessible to people with reduced mobility.
Your taste buds will wake up at the end of the day with a tasting of our "Aveyron Vivre Vrai" label products. We offer direct sales of our organic Aubrac duck and veal products (producer-style).
Our foie gras won a gold medal at the 2022 departmental Foies Gras
tldr: Participez aux ateliers d'alimentation des animaux (vaches, chèvres, poules) toute l'année dans un cadre couvert.

name: La ferme du Mas Granet
description: Production and sale of pork and canning.
tldr: Achetez de la charcuterie et des conserves de porc fabriquées sur place à la ferme du Mas Granet.

name: La Ferme les Mamours
description:
Sale of 100% natural farm products: jams, syrups, eggs.

Ecological and natural homemade cosmetics and household products
Local crafts

Located in La Bastide l'Evêque (lieu-dit La Crouzette).
Tours by appointment, 10am-12pm and 3pm-6pm. Maximum 6 people.
Bed & Breakfast and Table d'hôtes.
Camping-car reception
tldr: Découvrez des cosmétiques et produits ménagers naturels, ainsi que des confitures et sirops 100% maison.

name: La Ferme Vachement Fruitée
description:
La ferme vachement fruitée is a 40-hectare farm in Aveyron.
We produce Aubrac cows, fattened ducks, fruit trees and blueberries.
We offer you healthy, tasty farm produce, and are committed to the environment.
New for 2025: on-farm sales outlet!
tldr: Dégustez des produits sains issus de la ferme : vaches Aubrac, canards, fruits et myrtilles cultivés localement.

name: La Forêt de la Vaysse
description:
The Forêt de la Vaysse is a vast expanse populated by robinia (false acacia) trees. Its name comes from the Occitan "vaïssa" meaning hazelnut tree! But make no mistake, if our ancestors named it this way, it's because hazel was originally the predominant species in this area? until the arrival of the industrial revolution and coal mining.


Our forest is in fact a succession of open-cast mines exploited in the 19th century, which were reforested with locust trees when their activity came to an end. Over time, these robinia have colonized the area, and it has to be said that the species is a li

name: La Frégière Équitation
description: Equipped with 20 riding centre horses, 5 ponies, 15 breeding horses, a covered manège, 2 open air arenas and 75 acres of pasture, Benjamin and Nathalie welcome you to share their passion with you. From experienced riders to beginners, from youngster to the not so young, all riders and future riders will take great pleasure discovering this beautiful part of the Aveyron.
tldr: Montez à cheval ou en poney avec Benjamin et Nathalie dans un centre équestre équipé de manèges et de grands espaces.

name: La Galerie
description:
Large showroom of almost 150 m². See the exhibition program HERE.
For further details on the exhibitions, visit the events calendar: All the events calendar | terres-daveyron
tldr: Découvrez des expositions variées dans un grand espace de 150 m² à Bozouls.

name: La Gazonne Leisure Area - Disc-golf and footgolf
description:
Discover these unusual sports in a nature course of the Lézert Valley, close to the Royal Bastide.
You can get in touch with the association Au fil du Lézert for more information about introduction to disc-golf, organisation of trainings or events, if you want to come with a group or simply if you wish to practice regularly.
Concept:
They are multigenerational sports one can play alone or with opponents.
> Disc-golf:
This is a variation of golf you can play with a frisbee. It consists in reaching each basket with a minimum of tries. For more information, you can visit the French website www.di

name: La Gazonne Leisure Area - Swimming Pool
description:
Down below the Royal Bastide, it is located in the heart of a leisure area where you can enjoy outdoor activities in complete freedom, whether you are with your family, friends or on your own: playground, pétanque pitch, picnic area with BBQ, foot-golf & disc-golf course & hiking/mountain bike/horse trail.
In the swimming pool, while the youngest can have fun in the paddling pool, the oldest can enjoy the big pool (20mx8m) to freshen up or do lengths: relaxation lovers or sportsmen & sportswomen at heart, you have been posted!
As for people who want to perfect their suntan, a pool deck with lo
tldr: Profitez d'une piscine en plein air et d'un espace de jeux dans un cadre naturel près de Sauveterre-de-Rouergue.

name: La Gravière outdoor leisure base
description:
During the summer season, discover Saint-Affrique Plage and enjoy the paddling area and the sandy beach which are set on the river Sorgues banks. 
Leisure area: open all year round
Beach patrolled in July and August
Dogs even on a leash are prohibited
tldr: Baignade et paddling sur la plage de la Gravière, au bord de la rivière Sorgues, ouverte toute l'année.

name: La Jasse - Maison du Larzac
description: Situated on the RD 809 between Millau and La Cavalerie, this former sheepfold with its slate roof is dear to the hearts of those who opposed the extension of the military camp. From 1973 to 1989, this ?Jasse? served as an information point and hosted numerous meetings. Once the ?affaire du Larzac? was over, from 1981 to the present day, under the impetus of APAL (Association pour l?Aménagement du Larzac), the Jasse became the ?Maison du Larzac? Today, it is a showcase for Larzac and the surrounding area, with producers selling regional products and local crafts. A bookshop run by APAL awaits y
tldr: Ancien bergerie transformée en lieu de mémoire, symbole de la lutte contre l'extension du camp militaire.

name: La Liane de Rose
description:
La Liane de Rose is a climbing park in Espalion.
Are you looking for a sporting and outdoor activity? Then you've come to the right place!
With 6 tree-climbing courses, zip-lines and fun activities, there's something for everyone from daredevil sports enthusiasts to beginner adventurers.
Here, every course is an invitation to explore, challenge your limits and reconnect with the environment!
tldr: Tentez un parcours aventure dans les arbres avec tyroliennes et activités ludiques dans un parc de grimpe à Espalion.

name: La Ligne Verte
description: Selfguided walking and cycling holidays in Grands Causses Régional Natural Park, Tarn valley, Gorges du Tarn and Pays de Roquefort.
tldr: Randonnez ou faites du vélo en autonomie sur des itinéraires balisés dans les Grands Causses et les Gorges du Tarn.

name: La Maison de la Cerise
description: The "Maison de la Cerise" is situated in an old peasants house in the heart of the village of Paulhe. The ground floor of the museum is dedicated to the growing and harvesting of cherries through the ages and the first floor has an exhibition and sales of regional products. This museum informs visitors on the economy of the Vallée des Gorges du Tarn linked to the growing of "red gold". In June, July and August, guided hikes between the cherry trees happen every Thursday at 4 PM. They are followed by a tasting of the products from the "Maison de la Cerise" (€5 per adults, free for children of l
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire de la cerise : culture, récolte et traditions locales à Paulhe.

name: La Maison de la Cerise (groupes)
description: Open: from mid MayAt the heart of the Tarn valley, a few minutes from Millau, come and discover the secrets of  the "red gold":  Pauhle cherries and 200 years of tradition and aveyronnais savoir-faire. The "Maison de la Cerise" is situated in an old peasants house in the heart of the village of Paulhe. The ground floor of the museum is dedicated to the growing and harvesting of cherries through the ages and the first floor has an exhibition and sales of regional products. This museum informs visitors on the economy of the Vallée des Gorges du Tarn linked to the growing of "red gold" as say cer
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire de la cerise de Paulhe et ses 200 ans de savoir-faire local au cœur du Tarn.

name: La Maison de la Truffe
description: Window displays and information panels. Sales of truffles in jars, products containing truffles, regional products and saffron.
tldr: Découvrez l'univers de la truffe noire avec des panneaux explicatifs et achetez des produits à base de truffe.

name: La Maison de la Truffe (groupes)
description: In an atmosphere bathed in the scent of black truffles, information panels give pride of place, among mushrooms and truffles, to the black truffle (tuber melanosporum). The intimate relationship between the mushroom and its tree (symbiosis) is explained, as is the annual cycle of the truffle. A short 15-minute film shows the work of truffle growers in Aveyron and how truffles are harvested using flies or dogs. An interactive terminal allows everyone, especially children, to playfully take in the exhibition's contents.  Ask for recipes for truffle dishes (free). You can buy truffles in verrines
tldr: Explorez l'atmosphère envoûtante de la truffe noire à travers des panneaux et des expositions dans un cadre intimiste.

name: La Maison des Accompagnateurs - Randonnée
description:
Rando découverte: Get off the beaten track and enjoy a privileged view of the exceptional!
During the summer season, let us guide you on themed hikes:
Sous les ailes des Vautours, (a walk in the heart of the Jonte gorges to meet the vultures)
Soirée avec les Vautours (a hike on the corniches to meet the great gliders)
Hiking and canoeing in the Tarn gorges,
And many more: Vino-rando, Rando Larzac, Rando-roc qui à du fort...
Accompanied hikes are available all year round on request!
tldr: Suivez des randonnées guidées thématiques pour observer les vautours et profiter de paysages exceptionnels.

name: La Maison des Accompagnateurs - Raquette
description: Day hikes on reservation.
tldr: Parcourez des sentiers en raquettes l'hiver avec des accompagnateurs expérimentés dans les Grands Causses.

name: La Maison des Dolmens
description: The Sites de Découverte (discovery sites) of the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses are places which welcome you and help you understand the Parc. Here you will find the "key" to this area that is full of contrasts and innumerable and diverse riches! The Maison des Dolmens promotes this heritage that is emblematic of the Causse de Sévérac: information panels, children's quiz, open everyday, free... and above all a 9 kilometre family walk enabling you to discover the Dolmens or a car circuit to see the 9 dolmens present in the area. An invitation to discover the Parc Naturel Régional des
tldr: Comprenez les paysages et l'histoire des Grands Causses grâce à ce musée interactif.

name: La Maison des Dolmens (groupes)
description: The Sites de Découverte (discovery sites) of the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses are places which welcome you and help you understand the Parc. Here you will find the "key" to this area that is full of contrasts and innumerable and diverse riches! The Maison des Dolmens promotes this heritage that is emblematic of the Causse de Sévérac: information panels, children's quiz, open everyday, free... and above all a 9 kilometre family walk enabling you to discover the Dolmens or a car circuit to see the 9 dolmens present in the area. An invitation to discover the Parc Naturel Régional des
tldr: Comprenez l'histoire des dolmens et des sites mégalithiques des Grands Causses grâce à des outils de découverte.

name: La Maison des Vautours
description: At the Maison des vautours, come and discover and observe these majestic birds and their fabulous history!
tldr: Observez les vautours en vol libre dans leur milieu naturel, au cœur des Gorges de la Jonte.

name: La mine à ciel ouvert et le chevalement de mine de Decazeville
description: Exploited from 1832 to 2001, the open cast coal mine, called the "Découverte", is now restored. Near the mine shaft, information about the operation of the mine shaft and work of minors.

name: La muse du Verger
description: In an old vaulted cellar, along the GR62 (ancient Roman road), the Muse du Verger workshop is located in the heart of the medieval village of St Beauzély. Around the copper Charentais still, we'll share with you the ancestral know-how of distillation. 1h30 guided tour.
tldr: Découvrez la fabrication de jus de fruits artisanaux dans une cave voûtée médiévale le long du GR62.

name: La Naucelloise
description: Here you are entering into the secrets of Aveyron's gastronomy. The canning factory, which is famous for its “tripous”, will demonstrate all its expertise during a delicious 45-minute tour. The video film about the company will act as an appetiser, then you'll follow the various stages in the manufacture of our products (subject to their being manufactured on the day of your visit). The company shop will give you a chance to buy some of our products so that you can share these local recipes with your family.
tldr: Découvrez les secrets de la fabrication des tripous aveyronnais lors d'une visite gourmande de 45 minutes.

name: La petite ferme natur'ailes
description:
The farm's educational objective is to introduce visitors to domestic animals through shared moments such as petting, grooming and feeding. It's also an opportunity to learn about animal welfare, physiology and needs. These activities are aimed at individuals, schools, leisure centers, etc.
The farm also welcomes structures catering for the disabled (EHPAD, MAS, IME, IEM...) for therapeutic activities.
tldr: Rencontrez des animaux de la ferme et apprenez leur bien-être en les brossant et nourrissant.

name: La petite ferme natur'ailes (groupes)
description:
At the farm, you can meet the various farm animals (cows, sheep, goats, rabbits, guinea pigs, chickens, geese, turkeys and ducks), brush them, feed them and cuddle them.


Activities await you during your visit.
For larger groups, a tour of the farm in small groups and workshops for other groups

Duration: 2 hours or full day on request
tldr: Interagissez avec vaches, chèvres et autres animaux lors d'une visite interactive pour petits et grands.

name: La Place du Vélo
description:
Bike store, we offer daily rental of muscle or electric bikes. We also repair all brands of bikes.
Sale of new bikes and accessories, everything you need to repair or maintain your bike

name: La plage du Mas de la Nauc
description: You will find a large sandy beach, as well as a bathing area, supervised every day of the summer from 3pm to 7pm, in the magnificent site of the Raspes du Tarn.on site: picnic area and barbecue, volleyball court, petanque, canoe, kayak and electric boat hire, bar/restaurant and summer entertainment, departure of a boat cruise on the Tarn with Le Héron des Raspes.
tldr: Profitez d'une plage de sable au bord des Raspes du Tarn, surveillée en été, avec barbecue et volley.

name: La Plaine des sports à Réquista
description: This multidisciplinary site, accessible to all, is located in a green and welcoming environment. The complex has multiple sports facilities: a tennis court, a multi-sports field with an athletics track, a skate-park, a petanque field, a fitness trail, a ping-pong table, a beach-volleyball court, two picnic areas as well as playgrounds for children. It's an ideal place to let off steam in complete tranquillity.
tldr: Pratiquez tennis, athlétisme ou football dans un cadre vert et accessible à tous près de Réquista.

name: La porte enchantée au Château de Montaigut
description: This family treasure hunt (ages 6 and up) starts at the château and takes you on a less-than-kilometre-long trail, where you'll have to solve 10 riddles.  Good shoes recommended. Children must be accompanied by an adult.
tldr: Résolvez 10 énigmes en famille autour du château de Montaigut sur un parcours de moins d'1 km.

name: La Presqu'île d'Ambialet, Petite Cité de Caractère
description: Ambialet: a unique town located on a peninsula naturally created by the meander of the Tarn, the narrowest meander in Europe!

name: La rivière Aveyron à l'aire de la Buobe
description:
Fishing is available all year round (2nd category). A beautiful "family trail" with a nearby biodiversity awareness trail and an area with all amenities for a pleasant day out (games, toilets, drinking water, shelter, picnic tables, etc.).
With a length of 290 km, the Aveyron river crosses many different landscapes, forming gorges in the Ségala region. However, some of the riverbanks are easy to access and offer magnificent views of the wilderness.
Fish: Gudgeon, minnow, barbel, carp, tench, trout, pike, perch.
tldr: Pêchez toute l'année ou promenez-vous sur un sentier familial avec parcours biodiversité à Brandonnet.

name: La Roselle
description: Transformation lait de vache
tldr: Découvrez la transformation du lait de vache en fromages artisanaux dans une ferme locale.

name: La spiruline du Mas de Fraysse
description:
Yes, you read that right, spirulina in the heart of Aveyron!
The essential ingredient to keep healthy all year round, whether you are a sportsman or curious about new things.
tldr: Découvrez la spiruline, super-aliment cultivé localement, et ses vertus santé au Mas de Fraysse.

name: LA TIEULE EN FETE
description:
Come join the La Tieule village festival and its "1,001 manouls"! 
On the schedule:
8 a.m.: Manoul breakfast
11 a.m.: Mass
2:00 p.m.: Pétanque tournament
3:00 p.m.: Theater
7:00 p.m.: Beef chuck dinner

name: La Triangulaire de Cransac
description:
"La triangulaire de Cransac" is the result of a long reflection on local history. This work of contemporary art, declined in three poles, is the answer to a commission given to the artist Joëlle Tuerlinckx between the city of Cransac, the Fondation de France and its New Sponsors program and the Ministry of Culture and Communication. 
The work is composed of a 34 m high 'Monument-Mémoire' erected on the old mine tile, near shaft n 1 (the monument is one tenth of its depth) and two poles designated by the artist as a Contemporary Showcase and a Historical Showcase (in the museum Les Mémoires de

name: La V.R.A.C
tldr: Explorez l'univers du vin naturel et des vins en vrac dans un lieu dédié à Millau.

name: La Vallée des Respirs - Les Raspes à Auriac
description:
Feel the gentle breeze wafting over the valley's peaks, the sunlight hitting your eyelids and the smell of heather caressing your nostrils. Listen to nature welcome you to her playground.
Take a seat on the zafu and yoga mat placed on the cliff side, your eyes in the emerald blue of the River and your body rooted in this land of character.
At sunrise or sunset, enjoy the calm of the Hameau d'Auriac, just a few steps away along the wooded path leading to St Rome de Tarn.
Site accessible all year round


Photo credit : ©LeProgrèsStAffricain

name: La Vallée des Respirs dans les sous-bois du Viala du Tarn
description:
The smell of humus, the sound of branches cracking under your feet and the warmth of the sun's rays coming through the dense foliage and caressing your skin. Let yourself be lulled by nature, which will invite itself and transport you for a few moments...
Site accessible all year round
Photo credit : ©PNRGC

name: La Voie Lactée - La ferme de Piquetalen du Larzac
description:
La Ferme de Piquetalen is Francis and Béatrice Arnal's farm in La Bastide Pradines, just off the Larzac plateau in Aveyron.
Its activities are particularly varied, with cows (and calves), ewes (and lambs), poultry for their eggs, and even free-range pigs
All this little world offers you its products. Some of the milk is transformed into ewe's milk ice cream. Pork, veal and lamb are offered in seasonal packages.

Certified organic.

Sales:
- at the farm in our new boutique
- to order

name: La zone humide de Maymac
description: On your way, you will discover the world of wetlands. Wetlands are environments marked by the presence of water in a temporary or permanent way. These are remarkable environments for more than one reason; They are formidable reservoirs of biodiversity, home to many species of flora and fauna, they are also true natural infrastructures and provide important services to the community by ensuring qualitative and quantitative management of water.

name: LAC DE BORN
description: Perched at an altitude of 1,260 meters, Lake Born is one of the four glacial gems of the Aubrac Plateau. With an impressive surface area of 151 hectares and a depth of up to 15 meters, it is distinguished by its fragile ecosystem, composed of remarkable wetlands and peat bogs. This site offers an iconic panorama of the wild Aubrac, but its exceptional biodiversity calls for caution: its marshy and spongy shores are as fascinating as they are delicate. A true must-see stop on the “Lake Route,” it invites visitors to contemplate and discover well-preserved flora and fauna, nestled in the heart o
tldr: Admirez le lac de Born, l'un des joyaux glaciaires de l'Aubrac, à 1 260 m d'altitude.

name: Lac de la Cisba
description:
Located near the medieval town and the castle of Sévérac, Lake Cisba is a popular spot for swimming, picnicking, and outdoor activities.

The site features a developed beach, a fitness trail around the lake, and picnic tables. A restaurant is open during the season for light meals
.
The lake’s water, fed by springs, reaches a depth of up to 5.80 m.
Supervised swimming: Tuesday, July 14, through Sunday, August 16, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m., Tuesday through Sunday
Fishing permitted with a license
Facilities: restrooms, volleyball court, picnic area
Free access (check on site for addition
tldr: Baignade, pique-nique et fitness trail au lac de la Cisba, près du château de Sévérac.

name: Lac de la Prade
description: This charming lake, welcomes you for a picnic, a walk or a sport course.

name: Lac de Pareloup-barrage
description: At an altitude of 805m, the Pareloup dam ("pare lou lop" means "protect yourself from the wolf") is built on the Vioulou stream. The lake collects water from the Pont de Salars, Bages and La Gourde lakes, which are linked by underground galleries. The water then flows into Lac de Villefranche and is channeled through a 3.5 m-diameter penstock to the Pouget hydroelectric power station at Le Truel. For more information on the hydroelectric complex, visit the EDF website: www.energies-levezou.com and the pages: https://bit.ly/41LMjcy
tldr: Visitez le barrage de Pareloup, symbole historique et technique au cœur de l'Aveyron.

name: Lac des Galens
description: In the commune of Soulages Bonneval, ten minutes from Laguiole, can be visited at any season. Bathing is permitted and supervised in summer. There are large and small bathing areas with aquatic games for children and adolescents. Pedalos and canoes can be hired. Picnic areas are available in several locations all year round on the edge of the lake and there is a marked pedestrian circuit the whole way round it. Fishing is also an option at the Lac des Galens but a permit is required. You will appreciate its accessible banks.

name: Lac du Val de Lenne
description:
If you like walking, running, mountain biking... then you're sure to find something
then you're sure to find what you're looking for on the trails around Lac de Lenne, whatever your level. Starting from the beach at the Centre de Loisirs, there are 4 circuits of varying length and gradient.
A swimming area supervised by 2 lifeguards includes a "petit bain" (under 6s) and a "grand bain" (swimmers). Sports activities available on reservation: Optimist, windsurfing, canoeing, kayaking, mountain biking, fishing, archery, Swin Golf, Kin Ball, Tchoukball, Ultimate, Theque, orienteering, Stand up Pad

name: LAC ET TOURBIÈRES DE SOUVEYROLS
description: Together with Lakes Salhiens, Born, and Saint-Andéol, Lake Souveyrols forms one of the most remarkable and striking natural landscapes on the Aubrac Plateau. The site’s major appeal lies in the presence of this glacial lake and the vast peat bog that surrounds it. As witnesses to ancient climatic history linked to the last ice ages, these fragile wetlands are home to remarkable habitats, such as mounds of red sphagnum moss (Sphagnum rubellum), green sphagnum grasslands, and peaty willow thickets. Extremely sensitive to hydrological disturbances, these unique biotopes constitute a precious ecol

name: LAC SAINT ANDÉOL
description: This lake gives off a very special atmosphere in low light, it connects us to the elements. Don't you already feel the breeze touching your cheek? He, his magic tree and his magisterial cross are among the unmistakable ones. Different and mystical in every season, his shoreline stands out in spring wearing a dress of daffodils.

name: Laguiole Equitation
description: Laguiole equitation, your equestrian center at 5 minutes from Laguiole. Leisure - competitions - rides - boarding - coaching - improvement - courses - pony baptisms. All levels, all ages.
tldr: Montez à cheval ou initiez-vous à l'équitation dans un centre équestre près de Laguiole.

name: Lake Val de Lenne Leisure Centre
description:
The leisure centre hosts groups (schools, leisure centres, sports clubs, works councils...) with sports and recreational activities all year long : optimist (small boat for initiation), windsurfing, canoe, kayak, mountain bike, fishing, archery, SwinGolf, Kin-Ball, Tchoukball, Ultimate, orienteering, Stand up Paddle, Mölkky, team sports...
During summer time (July and August), they also offer tent camps for groups of children & youngsters aged 6-18.
________________________________________________________________
Four our disabled visitors :
The beach is accessible thanks to a a gravel path. T
tldr: Initiez-vous à la voile, au windsurf ou au catamaran sur le lac du Val de Lenne toute l'année.

name: Landa's distillerie
description:
Following in the footsteps of his Grandfather and Uncle "bouilleurs ambulants", Mathieu relaunched the distilling business in 2018 by founding Landa's Distillerie with his cousins.
Based in Lestrade, Aveyron, the young distillery released its first Single Grains Whisky in July 2022 and still produces Petit Jaune and Félicia's Gin.
A total of four whiskies are produced at Landa's: two Single Grains, one Single Rye (2025) and one Single Malt (2026).
The distillery can be visited in summer, but also the rest of the year according to availability, which can be consulted on our website.
tldr: Dégustez des spiritueux artisanaux distillés selon des méthodes traditionnelles en famille.

name: Landa's distillerie (groupes)
description:
Following in the footsteps of his Grandfather and Uncle "travelling distillers", Mathieu relaunched the distilling business in 2018 by founding Landa's Distillerie with his cousins.
Located in Lestrade, Aveyron, the young distillery released its first Single Grain Whisky in July 2022 and still produces Petit Jaune and Félicia's Gin.
tldr: Découvrez la distillation ambulante et ses secrets lors d'une visite de groupe à Landa's Distillerie.

name: LE 107 - ELASTIC NATURAL BUNGEE
description:
Bungee jump from 107 m on a natural site above the Tarn.
World first, cliff jump ! The highest jump in the south of France!
Conditions required:
- Be over 14 years old
- More than 40 kilos
- No epileptics or heart patients allowed

Reservation required, see dates on our website or at the tourist office.
tldr: Sautez en bungee à 107 m au-dessus du Tarn, le plus haut saut naturel du sud de la France.

name: Le Baron des Jeux
description:
A leisure center for everyone.
* A bar with soft drinks, beers, wine, apéritifs and overall : local beers
* A boardgame shop (boardgames pour kids and adults, puzzles, brain-teasers, collectible card games, dices...)
* 1000 playable boardgames, for all kind of players of all ages (2€ for each people, mendatory drinking)
* A 8-pool table (red and yellow balls - 2€ a game)
* An american pool table (red and yellow balls  OR numbered balls OR pétanque - 7€ for 30min, 12€ for 1 hour)
* A Snookball : a giant pool table (5,5mx3,5m) where pool-balls are replaced with small footballs you must push into
tldr: Boire un verre et jouer à des jeux de société dans un bar-ludothèque convivial à Saint-Affrique.

name: Le Belvédère de Castelnau-Lassouts
description: With a remarkable view of the last meander of the lake, the dam and its power station, everyone is invited to discover the history of the construction of the structure, its role in the electrical system and water management. The proximity of the lake, renowned for its fishing resources and its biodiversity, invites visitors to contemplate or practice one of the many outdoor activities!
tldr: Contemplez le méandre du lac et découvrez l'histoire du barrage de Castelnau-Lassouts.

name: Le Bosquet Gourmand
description:
Organic crops and creations, worked simply, between permaculture, agro-ecology, agroforestry, respecting the environment, promoting biodiversity, crop associations, on covered soils therefore living soils.
Working with nature to provide fresh, natural, healthy, seasonal produce, presented as plants, fresh, dried, in jellies, syrups, salts, vinegar, oil or sauce... to vary the pleasures on your plate!
free admission.
tldr: Dégustez des produits bio et locaux issus de permaculture et d'agroécologie au Bosquet Gourmand.

name: Le canyon de Bozouls
description:
This unique geological site, known as the "Trou de Bozouls", is a natural cirque, a horseshoe-shaped canyon carved out of the limestone of the Causse Comtal. This meander is the result of the erosive action of water and the successive stages of river incision. Modest as it is now, it was the Dourdou that shaped this astonishing natural feature over thousands of years.

Classified as a sensitive natural area, the canyon is home to a remarkable range of natural habitats, flora and fauna. Take a stroll along the trails, guided by educational panels, and discover all this richness, sometimes hidde
tldr: Marchez autour du canyon de Bozouls, ce cirque naturel en fer à cheval sculpté dans le calcaire.

name: Le Chant de la Terre
description: Educational farm in peasant agriculture, the activities here are as varied as they are complementary.
tldr: Découvrez l'agriculture paysanne et ses animaux dans une ferme éducative au cœur de la nature.

name: Le Chaudron aux Bonnes Herbes
description:
I am Laurence Noyrigat "Coureuse des Bois", shepherdess by profession, living in contact with nature at the rhythm of the seasons.
Passionate about medicinal plants for a long time, I perfected my knowledge at the Lyon School of Medicinal Plants.
The products at your disposal have been elaborated by me from wild plants picked in part in Aveyron.
These herbal teas, oils and balms are the result of an ancestral knowledge of family formulas.
I propose you courses of wild cooking and discovery of the spirits of the nature. Open all year round by appointment.
Do not hesitate to contact me by phone
tldr: Rencontrez une bergère passionnée de plantes médicinales et explorez ses savoirs ancestraux en pleine nature.

name: Le Cinq Foot Salle
description: Indoor soccer with family or friends. Hiring of ground for the practice of indoor football and BUBBLE FOOT.
tldr: Jouez au foot en bulle ou en salle, une expérience déjantée et conviviale pour tous les âges.

name: Le Cirque de St-Paul des Fonts
description:
Did you know that?
This natural cirque is a high place of European botany, marked by the presence of Hippolyte Coste, nicknamed "the priest of flowers" who lived 30 years in Saint-Paul des Fonts. This eminent botanist is known for his "Descriptive and Illustrated Flora of France". The former presbytery of Canon Coste is now a free museum since 2008. The Hippolyte Coste space is dedicated to the life of this specialist and allows to measure the richness of the local flora. Botanical routes around the village have been set up to allow young and old to appreciate the fragility of this natural her

name: Le Clos d'Edouard
description: Curiosity and desire for sugar? We offer the discovery of our jams made thanks to our fruit and vegetable production using old local varieties, wild flowers and berries. Taste them at the farm (visit + tasting by appointment only from 4pm to 6pm). Meet us on the local markets in the southern Aveyron (particularly on Saturday mornings at Saint Affrique).

name: Le Clos des Légendes
description:
Under the impulse of the association "La Pierre des Causses", this timeless place was born
A tower with a stained glass window recalling the legend of Saint Germaine, a kiosk where graceful fadarelles fly, fabulous animals: dragon, raven, famished cat, wolf, desadieu, tamarou, the unfortunate Gloriande de Thémines; the duke of Arpajon rushing to the castle, the horned sorcerer straight out of the tumulus of Villeplaine, all carry us through local legends and tales
tldr: Plongez dans les légendes locales à travers une tour aux vitraux et des fadarelles, un lieu poétique et méconnu.

name: Le Corps mémoire - Massage bien-être
description: This resourcing centre is located in the village of Castelnau-Pégayrols with a magnificent view of the Vallée de la Muse. Lodging on site. Equipment provided. If necessary, we will pick you up at the train station of Millau. Introductory courses in wellness massage are also available.
tldr: Offrez-vous un massage bien-être avec vue sur la Vallée de la Muse, dans un cadre ressourçant et calme.

name: Le Dépanneur du Viala
description:
Le Dépanneur is a multi-service grocery store (grocery, bakery, press) offering conventional and organic convenience goods, as well as a wide selection of local produce (cold meats, cheeses, yoghurts, honey, drinks, etc.), all produced using short distribution channels.
There's also a special section for hikers.
Farmers' markets are held regularly.
tldr: Achetez des produits locaux et bio dans une épicerie conviviale, au cœur d'un village authentique.

name: Le Duel
description: Make 2 teams of several players and challenge each other to a Duel! You'll have 1 hour to try out 5 games chosen by a Game Animator, who will also act as referee to ensure the success of the session. Organize several sessions to discover as many of the 40 games on offer as possible.
tldr: Participez à un duel ludique avec 5 jeux animés, une activité originale pour groupes et familles.

name: Le Duel (Groupe)
description: Make 2 teams of several players and challenge each other to a Duel! You'll have 1 hour to try out 5 games chosen by a Game Animator, who will also act as referee to ensure the success of the session. Organize several sessions to discover as many of the 40 games on offer as possible.
tldr: Participez à un duel ludique avec 5 jeux animés, une activité originale pour groupes et familles.

name: Le ferme des Armayrols
description: We are breeders of lambs and poultries in the open air, in the heart of the natural park of Grands Causses in the south Aveyron, on the commune of St Izaire.
tldr: Visitez une ferme d'élevage de moutons et volailles en plein air, au cœur du Parc des Grands Causses.

name: Le Fermier Gourmand
description:
On their family farm, Gaec de Nogardel, Fabien, Nicolas, Gorges and Emmanuel raise dairy cows and dairy ewes (PDO Roquefort). They also have a herd of suckler cows.  
The farm is located in Nogardel in the foothills of Aubrac.
Le Fermier Gourmand (Fabien and his partner Clémence) produces ewe's milk and cow's milk ice creams in jars and tubs (individual, 500 ml and 2.5L), bottled milk, dairy desserts...
Frozen desserts for all occasions (birthdays, family meals, christenings, weddings and parties) by prior arrangement.
Part of the ewe's milk is used for Roquefort société and part of the cow's
tldr: Dégustez des produits laitiers de Roquefort et fromages fermiers, issus d'une exploitation familiale engagée.

name: Le Goût du Vélo
description:
Le Goût du Vélo invites you to discover Aveyron through guided cycling experiences where the joy of riding meets the pleasure of local gastronomy.
Ride a gravel bike or an electric bike in a small group and explore the breathtaking landscapes of the Larzac plateau, the Tarn Valley (Raspes) and the surroundings of the iconic Millau Viaduct. Along the way, you'll discover local heritage, hear fascinating stories about the region and meet passionate local producers. Each ride ends with a tasting of carefully selected local products, including wines, cheeses, cured meats, artisan bread and seasona
tldr: Explorez l'Aveyron à vélo entre paysages et gastronomie, avec des guides passionnés.

name: Le Grenier de Capou
description:
The Mémoire de Capou Association opens the doors to the Grenier, a unique 1,000 m² exhibition space, inviting you on a journey through time to the heart of rural life in Aubrac. Passionate about this tradition-rich region, the Capoulade family offers you the chance to discover or rediscover an exceptional collection of over 12,000 unusual objects.
Each visit is an opportunity to explore various themes tailored to your interests: transportation, winemaking, life in the burons (traditional mountain huts), agriculture, trades of the past, and much more.
The guided tours, lasting about an hour, ar

name: Le grenier de Capou (groupes)
description:
Visit the impressive "Grenier de Capou" (Capou's attic) of 1200m2 housing several thousand wooden objects from our attics and farms and villages... (vintage cars). A visit commentated by the owners with humour, love and passion. 

reservation in 05 65 44 31 63, duration 1h.

name: Le Héron des Raspes - croisière découverte sur le Tarn
description:
A 1-hour-15-minute guided tour off the beaten track, taking you into gentle tranquility to discover grey herons, black kites, and beavers, along the magnificent meanders of the Raspes du Tarn.
A cruise that will take you to the Barrage hydroélectrique de Pinet, retracing the history of an entire valley. A Natura 2000 site.
Every week in summer, join our Sunset Apéro Walks to discover the Cascade des Baumes at sunset while enjoying an aperitif with a tasting of local cured meats and cheeses.
The nautical base also offers:
“Le Petit Héron” – a license-free electric boat. Spacious and comfortable
tldr: Observez herons, milans noirs et castors lors d'une croisière tranquille sur les Raspes du Tarn.

name: Le Héron des Raspes - croisière découverte sur le Tarn (groupes)
description: Cruse depart from  Mas de la Nauc, and aboard the "Héron des Raspes" you will navigate through the wild Raspes. Down through the Gorge Cristalline until the Pinet dam and return to the pontoon. Duration 1 hour 10 minutes. Commentated cruise.
tldr: Naviguez en groupe dans les gorges sauvages du Tarn, entre nature préservée et paysages grandioses.

name: Le Héron des Raspes - E-foil
description:
A 1-hour-15-minute guided tour off the beaten track, taking you into gentle tranquility to discover grey herons, black kites, and beavers, along the magnificent meanders of the Raspes du Tarn.
A cruise that will take you to the Barrage hydroélectrique de Pinet, retracing the history of an entire valley. A Natura 2000 site.
Every week in summer, join our Sunset Apéro Walks to discover the Cascade des Baumes at sunset while enjoying an aperitif with a tasting of local cured meats and cheeses.
The nautical base also offers:
“Le Petit Héron” – a license-free electric boat. Spacious and comfortable
tldr: Glissez sur l'eau en E-foil pour une balade originale et immersive sur les Raspes du Tarn.

name: Le Jardin de Flauzins
description:
Welcome to the Jardin de Flauzins.
We look forward to welcoming you on site this summer (times and days to be confirmed) to show you around our orchard and vegetable garden, grown using natural methods under the fruit trees. We'll be happy to talk to you about the different techniques we've put into practice, such as hillside cultivation, mulching and biodynamics.
Our main products are vegetables, apples, pears, apple and apple/pear juices, as well as a variety of jams and chestnut creams. Everything is homemade, and our fruit juices are pressed on site in our own press.
You'll find our produc
tldr: Découvrez un potager et verger cultivés naturellement, avec des ateliers pour apprendre les méthodes douces.

name: Le Jardin de Veillac - compositions florales
description: Our philosophy: agriculture on a human scale. We offer you freshly cut flowers on the summer markets. Present on the markets of Rodez on Saturday morning.
tldr: Achetez des bouquets de fleurs fraîches coupées, cultivées à petite échelle et vendues sur les marchés.

name: Le Jardin des Bêtes - Parc animalier et d'attractions
description:
Welcome to our animal and amusement park : Le Jardin Des Bêtes!
Located just 15 minutes from Rodez, our animal and amusement park offers you a unique 2 in 1 concept to spend a fun day with the family! The entrance ticket gives you unlimited access to our two parks all day long!
You will also discover our sound and light show, our plant labyrinth, several play areas, an aquatic platform and much more!
tldr: Alliez parc animalier et attractions familiales pour une journée ludique et pédagogique près de Rodez.

name: Le Jardin des Bêtes - Soigneur d’un jour
description:
Your child will enjoy a fully immersive experience behind the scenes at the park, accompanied exclusively by an animal caretaker for 4 hours.
Please make sure your child wears appropriate clothing (sneakers or rain boots, a hat, etc.) and brings a bottle of water and/or a snack. A short break will be included.
Reservations are available every day the park is open—except Sundays—throughout the current season.
tldr: Votre enfant devient soigneur d'animaux le temps d'une demi-journée, une expérience unique et immersive.

name: Le Jardin des plantes de Mourot
description:
A 1h30 visit is what Marie-José Desblats offers you in her private garden "We can talk about addiction. We love, then we are passionate about it for our own pleasure but above all to share it with everyone"
Each month its bloom. Marie-José chooses her plantings according to their hardiness and flowering: May for tulips, geraniums, peonies; June for old roses, poppies, bellflowers; July for clematis, daylilies, geraniums; August for hibiscus, dahlias, hydrangeas and September for sage, begonias, asters. An English garden where scents and colours mix. The mineral is not to be outdone with its dr
tldr: Découvrez un jardin privé de 1h30 où Marie-José Desblats partage sa passion botanique avec enthousiasme.

name: Le laboureur du Ségala
description: Potato producer in the cradle of the potato, 60 ha of which 5ha in production.

name: LE LAC DE SAINT-ANDÉOL
description: At 12 hectares, Saint-Andéol is the largest lake in the Aubrac region, nestled in the heart of an ancient volcanic crater in the town of Marchastel. An unmissable and easily accessible stop for pilgrims on the Way of St. James, this fascinating site captivates visitors as much with its remarkable geology as with its history steeped in mystery. As early as the 6th century, Gregory of Tours described pagan rites here, during which thousands of pilgrims cast offerings (coins, wool, cheese) in the hope of receiving miraculous healings. Between the famous legend of a sunken city and its tall granit
tldr: Baladez-vous autour du plus grand lac de l'Aubrac, niché dans un cratère volcanique, idéal pour une pause nature.

name: LE LIEU DIT DE VOLCÉGUR
description: The abandoned place of Volcégur is located at the end of the Méjean Causse and near the gorges of the Tarn. This place surely offers us one of the most sumptuous Lozerian photographs mixing cultural and natural heritage.

name: Le Miel de Manon Dalac
description: Honey and its derivatives.
tldr: Dégustez des miels artisanaux de Manon Dalac, primés en concours nationaux, pour une expérience gourmande authentique.

name: Le Miel de Papé
description: Enjoy the sweetness of the fruit of the work of our beautiful bees who work to offer you the flavors of the land in a miracle ingredient!

name: Le Miel du Pays de Conques
description:
DESCRIPTIVE
My favorite honey ? the traditional multi-flower honey, awarded several times in national and departmental contests. Taste it alone or in your favorite recipes and enjoy its dominant aromas of bramble, lime and chestnut.
As a beekeeping consultant, I will share with you my knowledge of the fascinating world of bees, their life, reproduction cycle and health.
This insect, essential to pollination and biodiversity, will no longer have any secrets for you! I will also make you discover the fascinating job of beekeeper.
Labels :
- Welcome to the farm
- Made in Aveyron
- Vignobles & Déc
tldr: Goûtez le miel multi-fleurs primé du Pays de Conques, aux arômes dominants, parfait pour sublimer vos recettes.

name: Le Moulin de Coudoustrines
description:
The Moulin de Coudoustrines delicatessen offers over 4,000 products to suit all budgets and tastes. The mill's team is on hand to advise you or help you put together your own gourmet boxes.
Come and discover a wide range of local, artisanal and international products. From condiments to jams, culinary aids to tinned fish, chocolates, honeys, syrups, cocktails, potato chips, coffee and tea, pasta, pastry items... not forgetting the sweets and bread, pizza or cake preparations prepared and/or packaged at the mill!
tldr: Explorez une épicerie fine de 4000 produits au Moulin de Coudoustrines, avec des conseils personnalisés pour vos coffrets gourmands.

name: Le Panier Paysan
description: Local AB or GMO-free products from several farms in Aveyron are on offer at this sales outlet. A producer will be on hand to advise you. You'll find everything: meat, poultry, vegetables, cheeses, honey, jams, wines, beer, bread, charcuterie, cakes...
tldr: Achetez des produits locaux AB ou sans OGM au Panier Paysan, conseillés par des producteurs de la région.

name: Le Petit Marcheur
description:
Would you like to discover Aveyron in a different way?

Le Petit Marcheur can help you create experiences that combine nature and local discovery, with the desire to visit the region with as little car use as possible.

For a day out, try a Resto-rando, a friendly outing that combines walking with a gourmet break, or a Mystère Gourmand, a fun activity combining puzzles, exploration and tasting of local specialities.

For longer stays, we offer self-guided itinerant or star-led tours, so you can discover the region at your own pace. Depending on your preferences, you can choose an economical fo
tldr: Parcourez l'Aveyron autrement avec Le Petit Marcheur, des randonnées mêlant nature et découvertes locales.

name: LE POINT SUBLIME
description: Nestled at an altitude of 870 metres, the Point Sublime offers an exceptional panorama of the Tarn Gorges, 400 metres lower down. In summer and autumn, thermal inversions producing seas of clouds are frequent and observable in the morning.
tldr: Admirez un panorama exceptionnel sur les Gorges du Tarn depuis le Point Sublime, surtout lors des inversions thermiques.

name: Le pont de Belcastel
description:
Built in the early 15th century by Alzias de Saunhac, this magnificent bridge is a remarkable example of medieval architecture.
Originally, it enabled the inhabitants of the right bank to more easily reach the church of Sainte-Madeleine, built at the same time. But beyond its religious function, it played an essential role in facilitating exchanges between the two banks of the Aveyron, once naturally separated by the river.
With its elegant arches and typical structure, it perfectly illustrates the characteristics of medieval bridges.

name: Le pont du Cayla à La Bastide l'Evêque
description:
This Gallo-Roman bridge over the River Aveyron was part of the road from Rodez to Cahors and before that of the old Roman road which was used to transport minerals from the mines of La Bastide. It was guarded by the nearby castle, occupied by the English during the Hundred Years' War. A round tower, part of the outside walls, is still visible. Close by were implanted three mills since the XVIe century. The church dedicated to the saints Abdon and Sennen is nowadays demolished. According to the legend, the bell tower was thrown in the river during the English wars…

SWIMMING IS PROHIBITED
tldr: Traversez un pont gallo-romain sur l'Aveyron, témoin historique de la route antique Rodez-Cahors.

name: Le Puech Monseigne et ses coccinelles
description:
At Saint-Laurent-de-Lévézou take the road towards Mauriac until the junction indicating Monseigne. Park there and take a gentle slope but not shaded path for 30mn-1h (2km). Orientation table, typical vegetation of the region with heather, broom and eagle fern.
On this site there is a Celtic enclosure dating back to the 5th century BC. Despite the excavations, the exact function of this place remains enigmatic.  
You will also see ladybugs hidden between the stones of the orientation tables and the clapas (piles of stones). The Monseigne serves as a refuge for them. You will find a panel explai
tldr: Randonnez 2 km jusqu'au Puech Monseigne pour observer des coccinelles et profiter d'une vue dégagée sur le Lévézou.

name: Le Rajal del Gorps
description:
As you drive along the road between La Cavalerie and Millau, the Rajal del Gorps, a site of rocky chaos, immediately catches your eye. Emblematic of the Larzac region for its history linked to the Larzac Struggle of the 70s and 80s (a major rally took place here), it is above all a natural area shaped by water and wind over 240 million years.
On foot, you'll enter the heart of typical Causse landscapes: vast expanses of dry grassland populated by boxwood and juniper, "ruiniform" rocks, a wide variety of flora, including many that only grow on the Causses, such as angel's hair, cardabella and s

name: Le Randonneur - Canoë Kayak
description:
We offer different courses to discover the Gorges du Tarn gently with family, or go for something more demanding.You will go down the Tarn River at your own rythm and will be able to admire the landscapes  or take the time to swim. 
Take appropriate clothes. Van transport.
tldr: Descendez les Gorges du Tarn en canoë à votre rythme pour admirer des paysages préservés et sauvages.

name: Le Randonneur - Via ferrata
description:
via ferrata, different courses for beginners or experienced will allow you to enjoy the magnificent landscapes of our beautiful region. 
We rent the complete equipment: helmet, harness + lanyard and pulleys.
tldr: Grimpez une via ferrata dans les Gorges du Tarn, avec des parcours adaptés aux débutants comme aux experts.

name: Le Repaire de la Ferme des Beaux Renards
Le Roc d'Anglars et Le Lourdou
description:
Just 900 meters upstream from the village of Belcastel, perched above the Lourdou cave, lie the remarkable remains of an ancient fort probably dating from the 5th century. This little-known historic site is one of the few examples of fortifications from this period still visible in the region.
Set 50 meters above the Aveyron river, this defensive system, some 20 meters in diameter, was composed of several compartments, platforms and ditches, forming a veritable rampart against invasion. It guarded and protected the valley long before the construction of the famous Belcastel fortress, which it

name: LE ROCHER DE CAPLUC
description: The rock of Capluc is fantastic because of the number of photographic possibilities it offers: Tarn gorge, Jonte gorge, the village of Peyreleau, as well as a view of the Tarn valley of Aveyron. It is a 360° not to be missed and which also offers the possibility to observe the vultures nesting in the Jonte gorges.

name: Le Safran du Domaine de Montarsès
description:
Passionate producer of AB-certified saffron and French crocus sativus bulbs.
Production of by-products: syrup, jelly, etc.

Syrups made from flowers, plants, fruit and jam
Honey
tldr: Découvrez le safran bio du Domaine de Montarsès et ses dérivés (sirop, gelée) pour une touche d'originalité culinaire.

name: Le Saloir
description:
The 1st mission is to preserve and inventory archives, objects, interviews, iconography, books: this part cannot be visited.

The 2nd mission is to make these funds available to people who wish to do research on the Roquefort sector: of course, it is preferable to book in advance during the opening hours of Le Saloir. 

The 3rd mission is to promote these heritage collections in different formats (visits, exhibitions, etc.).
Upon reservation, we can provide guided tours of the village on different themes.

name: Le sentier des plantes
description:
Open to the public during the season (mid-May to mid-October) by reservation only on Thursdays: Guided tour of the aromatic and medicinal plant production gardens or the processing workshop (weather permitting), discovery of the Paysan-Herboriste profession and practices, product tasting, boutique...
 Please bring suitable gardening clothing.
On-site parking, outhouse and boutique.
Thematic workshops available, please contact me.
Farm located 2 km from Cransac les Thermes town center
tldr: Visitez des jardins de plantes aromatiques et médicinales à Firmi, sur réservation, pour une immersion sensorielle.

name: Le Trinquero - Bar à Jeux
description:
Right in the heart of Millau, in a pedestrian street, Le Trinquero is a friendly games bar where board game enthusiasts come together for a relaxing moment with family or friends.
 
With two rooms and a small terrace, our space invites you to discover a selection of games, from classics to playful novelties.
 
Enjoy gourmet platters (meat, veg, vegan) and homemade softs, as well as local beers and artisan wines. In addition to the bar, discover our games accessories store, ideal for completing your collection with dice, dice tracks, classic and collectible card games and other accessories.
 
W
tldr: Passez un moment convivial au Bar à Jeux Le Trinquero à Millau, entre amis ou en famille, autour de jeux de société.

name: Le Verger de Conques
description: In Conques, in the Aveyron region, the chestnut tree is an integral part of the landscape and local history. Abandoned since the early 20th century, chestnut cultivation can regain its place and provide healthy, locally sourced food. Since this heritage is close to my heart, I didn’t hesitate to take over a chestnut orchard in 2021* and have become a chestnut grower in addition to my other paid job. This 2-hectare orchard, planted 50 years ago, consists mainly of the Marigoule variety: a large-sized chestnut (which can be called a “marron”), with very few partitions (the two skins peel off ver
tldr: Explorez un verger de châtaigniers à Conques, symbole d'un patrimoine local en pleine renaissance.

name: Le Viaduc du Viaur pour les déficients visuels
description:
Discover the Viaur Viaduct with a discovery booklet in Braille and relief, as well as a document in contrasting colors.
Borrow these booklets from the tourist office in Naucelle or Sauveterre-de-Rouergue and enjoy an adapted sensory visit.
Quite a project: the tour and booklets were produced jointly by the Pays Ségali tourist office and AcceSens.
tldr: Découvrez le Viaduc du Viaur avec un livret en braille et relief, accessible aux déficients visuels.

name: Le Viala du Pas de Jaux - carnet de visite enfants
description:
In the heart of Larzac, come and share an unforgettable family experience at this emblematic site steeped in history. Young and old are invited to immerse themselves in the medieval world of the tower through a fun and immersive visit. Disguised and equipped with their notebooks, children become real explorers: games, riddles and challenges mark out their route to discover the local heritage while having fun.
 
Two booklets adapted to different age groups (5-8 and 9-12) enable each child to enjoy the visit at his or her own pace. The ideal way to combine discovery, fun and immersion in the hea
address: Association de la Tour du Viala

name: Le Viala du Pas de Jaux - visite de la Tour Hospitalière
description: Living illustration of the Larzac's agro-pastoral vocation, the Tour du Viala du Pas de Jaux was built in 1430 next to the Logis of the Hospitaller Knights of Saint John of Jerusalem (in existence sine the 14th century) on the request of the inhabitants of the village to be able to take refuge in times of war and stock their cereal harvests. description:

I am Gauthier Patras, son of a merchant from Villefranche-de-Rouergue. This morning in 1496, my father sent me here because he was to receive an important order for copper pairols*. But it never arrived.
I need to find the martinaire (the man who makes these pairols).
Will you help me?"

*copper pieces to be transformed into cauldrons
tldr: Aidez Gauthier Patras à résoudre un mystère commercial dans le Bas Ségala en 1496.

description:
Chocolats de l'Abbaye de Bonneval are renowned for the quality of the products used, the care taken in their manufacture, and the unique flavor you'll appreciate as you taste each product in the range on offer, which has been enriched over the years.
Bonneval chocolates are made with great care in the Abbey's workshops. They are made using traditional methods: no preservatives or vegetable fats other than cocoa butter are added to the composition of these natural products. A wide range of products are available: bars, sticks, candies, bite-sized pieces...
What to see and do at Bonneval Abbey?
tldr: Dégustez des chocolats artisanaux fabriqués avec soin dans l'abbaye de Bonneval, un régal pour les papilles.

name: Maison canoniale
description: In the courtyard, you will notice a sandstone well from the 15th century decorated with the scallop shell and the bumblebee, symbols of pilgrims on their way to Santiago de Compostela. In the Middle Ages, Rodez was located on one of the many secondary roads of the Via Podiensis, which starts in Le Puy-en-Velay. The restored entrance door dates from the 15th century. It still preserves a small window, ancestor of our current peephole, as well as its knocker.

name: Maison d'Armagnac
description: Built in the first half of the 16th century, this house belonged to a rich merchant and banker, Hugues Daulhou. The Gothic and Renaissance styles are mixed on the façade: grotesques and corbelling are reminiscent of the Gothic style, but the symmetrical layout, the antique medallions and the dormers are Renaissance.

name: Maison de Benoît
description: It has a very beautiful inner courtyard with a balustrade of flamboyant gothic style. The tower houses a spiral staircase. At its top, a sculpture representing a winegrower recalls the commercial exchanges with the nearby Marcillac vineyard.

name: Maison de Guitard
description: Former property of a family of bankers (Guitard family), this house is one of the oldest preserved in Rodez. Its tower shape shows the social ascension of this family, which gave its name to a part of the rue du Touat, formerly called rue de la Guitardie.

name: Maison de l'Annonciation
description: Built in the middle of the 15th century, it was the property of a rich merchant, François Dardenne, and concentrated the functions of store on the first floor and dwelling in the floors. Built on 7 levels, it presents a Renaissance style with its symmetrical layout, its Corinthian capitals, its tempietto and its festooned turret. On the latter, a bas-relief representing a scene of the Annunciation can be seen.

name: Maison de l'Aubrac
description: A scenographic centre in which to learn about and take a journey over the Aubrac plateau, its landscapes, its people, its traditions and flavours. An invitation to explore every aspect of the aubrac plateau, including its gourmet secrets. The centre is not really a museum, nor a show - it aims to use sound and light to conjure up an image of the Aubrac through the four seasons using large screens, audio terminals and video screens. A place of freedom, this unique place takes you on a voyage through strong images of the Aubrac, from the Transhumance (cattle taken to and from summer mountain gra
tldr: Plongez dans l'Aubrac : paysages, traditions et saveurs au cœur de ce plateau emblématique.

name: Maison de la Châtaigne - Musée des arts religieux

description: Discover the "bread" tree and its fruit, the basic ingredient in bygone years for food in rural areas. You will follow all the cycles, from the maturity of the fruit to the final product, as well as the use of the wood. An exhibition of religious art in our campaigns before Vatican II, of which two chasubles are listed as Historic Monument, complete this site.

name: Medieval town of Sévérac-le-Château
description:
Labelled as a “Petite Cité de Caractère” (Small Town of Character – French heritage label), it is one of the largest medieval towns in the Aveyron region. Passing through one of its fortified gates is like stepping back in time. Once protected by ramparts, moats and four gates (two of which still remain), the town boasts remarkable architectural heritage: half-timbered houses, vaulted passageways, overhanging upper floors, spiral stair towers, and mullioned windows.
As you stroll through the narrow streets, you’ll discover the Romanesque fountain, the Church of Saint-Sauveur, the covered marke
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire médiévale en franchissant les portes fortifiées de cette cité classée.

name: Mélac castle
description: Mélac, "repaire" -fortified wealthy house- of the southern Rouergue built between the 14th and the 16th centuries by the feudal Gozon family. The castle forms a very contrasted ensemble because of its different architectural styles: exceptional interior courtyard with arcades supporting the galleries on two levels, 15th century watchtower with its original bombards, Renaissance round tower and its cupola storeys, vaulted guards room with rib tufa stone dating from the 14th century, large rougier sandstone fireplace, epic narrative about Dieudonné de Gozon, Grand Master of the Order of Saint Jo
tldr: Visitez ce repaire médiéval aux contrastes saisissants, entre tours défensives et architecture seigneuriale du Rouergue.

name: MÉLANIE ET GUILLAUME MILLAU ACTIVITES NATURE
description:
We are a couple of independent state-qualified instructors, from Millau, working in outdoor sports.
Come and share our passion with us, to discover the Grands Causses region in a different way, to climb, jump, crawl, slide, swim, have fun together! Our activities are adapted to all levels, from family discovery to major outings, from 5 years old for the easiest routes... We will choose your outing with you and we will go at your own pace.

name: Mescladis, naturellement pain
description:
Viennese pastries, cookies, cakes. The baker uses flour from wheat produced by neighboring farmers and milled on site, in the bakery, on a stone millstone.
The store is open in Comps la Grand Ville on Tuesdays and Fridays from 12 to 8 pm.

name: MICROPOLIS LA CITÉ DES INSECTES
description:
Here WAOUUH! is written in MINUSCULE.
New! In 2026, discover the invisible at Micropolis! Set off for an exceptional day out with your family in the heart of Aveyron, discovering insects, nature, and biodiversity.
Inside, meet over 40 living species from the four corners of the globe, watch the ballet of a thousand-colored butterflies in the tropical greenhouse, follow the parade of worker ants and witness the comings and goings of our foraging bees. Can you spot stick insects disguised as twigs, play with giant colorful insects and avoid the traps of carnivorous plants? Get ready for a change
tldr: Explorez l'univers fascinant des insectes dans un parc unique en Europe, idéal pour les familles.

name: MICROPOLIS LA CITÉ DES INSECTES (groupes)
description:
Nestled in the magnificent natural setting of Saint-Léons, Aveyron, the Insect City offers a unique adventure in Europe. It's the only place where parents and children can explore, marvel and enjoy a unique experience in the midst of MINUSCULES, animals that are full of surprises.
Let yourself be guided by one of our enthusiastic animators to better understand, love and protect these little creatures, often misunderstood but nonetheless indispensable to our planet.
Micropolis offers self-guided or guided tours, specially designed for groups of seniors, adults or children. A great opportunity t
tldr: Découvrez l'invisible avec une aventure exceptionnelle autour des insectes et de la nature.

name: Miel et essaims de Claire Labbé
description:
I raise bees that produce honey.
I practice transhumance. In other words, I move my hives according to the flowering season, sometimes over long distances. Transhumance allows me to harvest different types of honey.
The different varieties of honey are differentiated by the time of harvest, the place of harvest and the dominant plants on the spot.
I take my hives to Cantal, Aubrac for two types of mountain honey, Gard for lavender and Aveyron like Firmi for Acacia, Causse Comtal for causse honey and of course the Conques area for Chestnut honey.
 My aim is to ensure that my bees produce qualit

name: Miellerie du Val de Serre
description: Bee keeping: slide show on the life of bees, visit the miellerie (honey production), honey tasting, pollen, sweets, gingerbread, mead, soaps. Exhibition of old hives, educational panels, photos, glass backed hive allowing observation of the bees at work. Fabrication of candles for children.
tldr: Découvrez la vie des abeilles, goûtez du miel et explorez des ruches anciennes dans une miellerie.

name: Miellerie du Val de Serre (groupes)
description: Apiculture : diarama on the life of bees, visit of the honey factory, tasting of honey, pollen, sweets, gingerbread, hydromel, soaps. Exhibition of old hives, educational panels, photos, hive with window to observe the bees at work. Candle making for children.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Canyon
description:
Canyoning or aquatic trekking consists of descending a canyon or river using a variety of fun methods such as jumps (never compulsory), slides, swimming, abseiling?

We offer you a selection of the most beautiful canyons in our region, accessible to anyone (FROM 4 years of age) who is at least sporty, willing and motivated, and has no "uncontrollable" fear of water.

Safety, solidarity, pedagogy, cohesion... these are just some of the factors that will enable you to surpass yourself and achieve this exceptional adventure. Together, we'll choose your canyon or aquatic tour according to your lev
tldr: Descendez des canyons en sautant, glissant et nageant dans des paysages naturels spectaculaires.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Escalade
description:
Climbing is one of the main activities in our region with world famous sites. The gorges of the Tarn, Jonte and Dourbie rivers will allow you to spend a sportive day in exceptional places and landscapes.

The activity is adapted to beginners in initiation cliffs (from 5 years old).

For the more adventurous, we are lucky enough to be able to offer you a large number of big routes of all levels (from beginner to expert) which will make you take the height (140 meters maximum)!

Come and discover our region in a different way, become a climber for a day or more, to progress and/or become autonom
tldr: Grimpez sur des sites mondialement connus dans les gorges du Tarn, Jonte ou Dourbie.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Rando Rappel
description:
Two courses are available:
A Family route at Verrières (easy level) from age 4 in a very small, dry canyon with abseils of around 4 meters and a small rope zip line.
A discovery route in the village of Les Vignes (medium level) from age 8 upwards, with abseils of up to 30 meters, leading directly to the impressive boulder chaos of the Pas de Soucis in the Tarn gorges.


Ideal for discovering the region in a different way, venturing into unusual places that are inaccessible on foot, learning to abseil and enjoying the view from a great height
tldr: Parcourez des canyons familiaux avec petites tyroliennes et rappels faciles dès 4 ans.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Spéléo
description: The Grand Causses region is a large limestone area where caving can be practiced in numerous caves. The caves or avens of our region are particularly suitable for learning caving in a natural environment: easy access, moderate depth, absence of extreme narrowness. It will be up to you to decide if you want a sporting outing, with abseils and rope climbs, or simply a fun and scientific discovery, for a half-day or a full day. There is something for everyone! From 6 years old, we will choose together your outing and we will go at your pace!
tldr: Explorez des grottes et avens naturels pour apprendre la spéléologie dans un cadre préservé.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Via Ferrata
description:
A via ferrata is a course built into a rock face, equipped with zip lines, cables, ladders, monkey bridges, footbridges...  The course is entirely secured by cable lifelines

More fun than hiking and less difficult than climbing, the via ferrata is ideal to test your apprehension of the void, to begin the practice of climbing gently, and especially to have fun together, with friends or family, on a playful course in an exceptional setting!

We propose 4 Via ferrata : Le boffi, Liaucous, La Canourgue, and those of Les Rousses next to the unavoidable canyon of the Cevennes, the Tapoul.
tldr: Grimpez sur une paroi équipée de ponts de singe, tyroliennes et échelles pour une aventure sécurisée.

name: Millau Aventure - Les Bateliers du Viaduc
description:
Get on board and discover the valley of the Tarn from the river as you would have imagined ...
All along the river, your guide tell you the history of the country, its traditions and curiosities, its geology, fauna and flora.
The boat trip starts in Creissels, a small medieval village of character near Millau.
Your boatman takes you on an 8 km adventure full of surprises! A beaver hut, a gray heron flight, shivering rapids, and you are under the two highest pillars in the world for a breathtaking and exclusive view of the Millau Viaduct.
At the end of the tour, you sail to the troglodyte villa
tldr: Découvrez l'histoire et les traditions locales en naviguant sur le Tarn avec des bateliers guides.

name: Millau Aventure - Paddle
description: The first activity is all about relaxing, unwinding, and having fun on our lake, located within our leisure park. This peaceful setting allows you to enjoy paddleboarding along 800 meters of calm, current-free river. Many animal species also come here to rest, making it a serene and natural environment. Along the way, you can discover beautiful spots such as a waterfall and a beach, both easily accessible by Stand Up Paddle—much more conveniently than by swimming! We offer SUP boards for one or two people, as well as a large paddleboard that can accommodate up to six people, making it perfect
tldr: Pagayez en toute sérénité sur un lac de 800 mètres, idéal pour se détendre en famille.

name: Millau Aventure - Trottinettes Electriques Tout Terrain
description: A fun activity accessible to everyone, allowing you to explore outstanding landscapes in complete freedom. Join a guided tour for a unique experience combining nature, adventure, and excitement. Helmet, gloves, and scooter are provided. With a range of up to 50 km and a speed limited to 25 km/h, enjoy a comfortable and safe ride.

name: Millau Aventure- Canoë
description:
3 routes are available:

The Tarn Route and its Viaduct!
Estimated distance: 8 km, approximately 1 hour 30 minutes of paddling without breaks. Allow 2 to 3 hours if you're enjoying the trip at a holiday pace!
As you drift downstream, discover the Larzac cliffs, the troglodyte village of Peyre, and paddle beneath the famous Millau Viaduct.
Explore the Tarn Valley at your own pace by canoe or kayak!

The Dourbie Route and its Rapids!
Estimated distance: 12 km, approximately 2 hours 30 minutes of paddling without breaks. Allow 3 to 4 hours if you're taking your time and enjoying the scenery!
Navi
tldr: Pagaiez sous le Viaduc de Millau en 1h30 ou profitez d'une balade plus tranquille de 3h.

name: Mille Ans de Traces en Aubrac
description:
The exhibition is divided into 4 spaces :
1 - Learn about the lives  of cervids on the Aubrac plateau with photos and detailed comments. Introduced for 40 years, the deer became king of the forest of Enguilhens.
2 - The resistance movement, during the Second World War.
3 - A farm in the XIth century, unique site in Europe, was reconstituted through a model.
4 - The former sacristy built on the vestiges of the  first church of the village.
tldr: Découvrez l'histoire des cerfs sur l'Aubrac à travers photos, commentaires et expositions immersives.

name: Mine de vin
description:
Small vineyard on slopes and terraces in the communes of Cransac and Aubin, organically farmed.
The atypical soil (schist and coal naturally present) and the varieties grown give rise to singular wines.
Particular care is taken with the vines and soil to ensure that the grape varieties express themselves to the full.
Red, white (dry) and atypical wines produced under IGP Aveyron and Vin de France.
Grape varieties: Merlot, Mansois, Mouyssaguès and forgotten
tldr: Dégustez des vins uniques cultivés sur des sols atypiques de schiste et de charbon.

name: Minér'Aubrac
description: A guided visit commentated by the owner of all the mineralogical pieces, the fruits of 25 years research and exchange. You will discover mineralogical secrets and the fabulous stones that can be admire in this museum. Aragonite, calcite, fluorite, quartz, ... all their secrets will be unveiled to you.

name: Mini Ferme Découverte de La Salette
description:
The visit takes place in a private home. You'll share his or her knowledge of the animals, and have the chance to stroke them or feed them
Depending on the season, you can see new animals: births, arrivals.
maximum 6 people per visit.
Closed from September 30 to October 9 inclusive.
tldr: Rencontrez et nourrissez des animaux de la ferme dans un cadre intime et chaleureux.

name: Miramont Rock - Viewpoint and its indicator
description:
A strategic spot for Humans for millenia...

The Rock is at the heart of a huge celtic oppidum - dated back to the 2nd century BC - and built by the Rutènes, major people belonging to the free Gaul and allied to the all-powerful Arvernes. This oppidum is around 2000m long, and 1000m wide as a maximum. This dominant spot with steep slopes had control over the area, precisely where the Viaur and Ceor valleys meet.
Its location helped it become the settlement of one of the 12 baronies in the Rouergue during the Middle Age, with its castle - it still existed in early 15th century. It was protected

name: MOB 12
description:
Come and discover the most beautiful corners of the region on a vintage moped, Gorges du Tarn, Gorges de la Dourbie, Larzac, Vallée du Cernon, Pays de Roquefort, Lake Villefranche de Panat, de Pareloup.... We offer tours free or routed, we can also support you.


Our Mob grannies have been completely restored by us. We provide the obligatory equipment (helmet and gloves) as well as an anti-theft device. Insurance and fuel are included in the rates. Our fleet is made up of 7 Motobécane mopeds.

Alone, as a couple or in a group, treat yourself to an unforgettable stroll.

name: Monastère et Cloître des Augustins
description:
Around 1347, the Augustinians, driven out of Ste Eulalie d'Olt, settled in St Geniez and established a church, monastery and cemetery there. From then on, the buildings developed into a vast space around which the houses of the new town were built (the old town being built on the right bank, near the castle and the parish church)
At the end of the 16th century, the ravages of the Huguenots left the monastery in a very bad state. The repair of the buildings would have been carried out by Jean Parate, around the middle of the following century

name: Monument aux morts de la guerre franco-prussienne de l'arrondissement de Millau
Monument Talabot
description:
The life of Marie Talabot :
Born in 1822, Marie Savy, an orphan from a modest family, left Saint-Geniez to work for some notables in Marseille. She met the engineer Paulin Talabot, builder of railway lines throughout the Mediterranean basin and founder of the P.L.M. line (Paris - Lyon - Mediterranean). A sentimental relationship develops between them, despite their great age difference (she is 19 and he 42). Paulin, for professional reasons, has to move to Paris. Marie frequented high society there, held a salon, and also made regular donations to the good works of Saint-Geniez.
