name: Motte Castrale (IXième siècle)
description: Motte castrale de l'époque Mérovingienne (IXième siècle) nommé aujourd'hui "Le Castellas". Château utilisé jusqu'au XIIième siècle.
tldr: Découvrez une motte castrale mérovingienne du IXe siècle, vestige d'un château médiéval oublié.

name: Moulin de Couffinhal à Couesques
description: It is equipped with two pairs of flour millstones (under restoration) and of one oil millstone. During the visit, its owner (descendent of millers) will explain you the functionning of the milling and sieving systems for flour as well as the walnut oil fabrication with the millstone, the pan and the press. You will see operate the millstone dragged along thanks to the energy of the water, by the "roudet" (horizontal turbine). You will also see the additional developments : canal, pond, sluice gate and you can enjoy the banks of the creek "le Palefer".

name: Moulin de Couffinhal à Couesques (groupes)
description:
This water mill, which has existed since the late 16th century, was used to produce walnut oil and flour. After contributing to the local economy for centuries, it ceased to operate in 1970.

All its original equipment remains in place, and some of it has been restored to working order.

The owner, a descendant of millers, will explain how it works. You'll see the oil millstone, driven by the power of water, and all the ancillary equipment: canal, pond, sluice gates, etc.
By appointment only

name: Moulin Méjane (Huile de noix, noisettes, farines bio)
description: Walnut oil, hazelnut oil (guaranteed 100% natural with no additives or preservatives). Artisanal production according to ancestral methods, these 1st pressing virgin oils are extracted in a mechanical press then naturally decanted into barrels.
tldr: Dégustez des huiles de noix et noisettes bio, pressées à l'ancienne dans un moulin artisanal.

name: Moulins de Roupeyrac - Maison d'Ecrivain François Fabié
description: Discovery day for school groups and leisure centres with tailor-made programmes: From wheat to bread - Hydroelectric energy and gearing - Nature and writing
tldr: Ateliers ludiques sur la meunerie, l'énergie hydraulique et l'écriture pour petits et grands.

name: Moulins de Roupeyrac. Maison natale du poète François Fabié - Maison d'Ecrivain.
description: Birth place of the poet François FABIÉ (1846-1928) "bard of Rouergue", whose house where he was born has been arranged as a museum where the poet's souvenirs have been conserved in an interior rouergat from the last century, and a remarkable hominoid statue-menhir . Workings of the sawmill, bread oven and flour mill. Renovated museum.

description: The museum exhibits the archaeological past of Banassac, in particular the life of the Chasens, the sigillated ceramics and the history of the coins minted in the Merovingian period. You can also see objects discovered in the remains of a mausoleum during excavations before the construction of the A75 motorway.
tldr: Plongez dans l’Antiquité : sigillées, monnaies mérovingiennes et vie des Chaséens à travers des objets archéologiques.

name: Musée Au fil du Rail
description:
Guided tour of 1 hour. Sound and Light and various animations.
Au fil du rail is the passion of its creator, trains that run through several settings. It moves, makes noise, special effects ... a whole world that will delight children and certainly their parents.
Here a model representing a village crossed by the railroad, we see the lumberjack who cuts a tree with the sound of the chainsaw, the smoke escapes from the steam locomotive.
There, it is the flashing lights of the fire trucks, the rooster crowing and the cows mooing. At nightfall, the network lights up and there are many other surpr
tldr: Voyage immersif dans un monde miniature où trains et effets spéciaux animent des décors variés.

Au fil du rail features the passion of its creator, trains that run through a variety of settings. It moves, makes noise, features special effects... a whole world that will enchant children and certainly their parents too.
Here, a model of a village on the railroad, a lumberjack cutting down a tree with a chainsaw, smoke billowing from a steam locomotive.
Here, the flashing beacons of fire engines and the crowing of roosters mingle with the bellowing of cows. At nightfall, the layout lights up, and there are many more surprises to discover.

name: Musée Cavaignac Gladin
description: Cavaignac-Gladin Museum of ancient earthenware and Chinese art, in the premises of the mill of culture.

name: Musée Cavaignac Gladin (groupes)
description: Museum of Chinese art and ancient earthenware. In this museum you can find ancient earthenware, silk and paintings. A real treasure to discover at the Moulin de la Culture.

name: Musée Charles de Louvrié à Bes-Bédène
description:
Two exhibition rooms are dedicated to Charles de Louvrié, the French engineer who pioneered the jet engine (patents registered in 1863). Among the exhibits, models bring his inventions to life.
Other attractions include
the museum, which simulates a classroom from the 30s/60s, with magnificent school objects on display.
the ogival-style church built in 1112 (2 altarpieces from the 16th and 18th centuries and an exhibition of priestly vestments). The visit can be followed by a pleasant stroll to the "Pierre Branlante" or to the Roman granite bridge (13th century).

name: Musée de la Dragonnière
description:
Do you know the history of the village of Costes-Gozon? Push the doors of this small museum which will make you discover the legend of Dieudonné de Gozon, 27th Grand Master of the order of the Hospitallers of St. John of Jerusalem in the 14th century. Discover the history of the village through objects full of history that will guide you to the various archaeological sites of the village.

Admire the painting of "Dieudonné de Gozon's fight against the dragon", the original Menhir de Caumilhou statue, the inventory of the crosses of the village and many others!
Continue your escapade in Costes-

name: Musée de la forge et de l'ancienne vie rurale
description: Located in the old smithy, the museum contains many different blacksmiths tools as well as the traditional tools of the rural world. In the past the smithy would have resonated with the clear hard sound of steel on steel while harrow and fork tines glowed in the fire; now, anyone who wants to appreciate the blacksmiths skills and admire the huge stock of tools which he needed to ply his trade can admire his craft. The smithy which contains the museum was itself built on the site of one of the two towers of the former castle of Lescure, which dated from the 11th century. After the French Revolu

name: Musée de la forge et des anciens métiers de Belcastel
description:
A documented and attractive visit to share with the youngest.

The old forge, a 3 storey building each floor of about 45m2. First level: the forge master. Level 2: the craft of the blacksmith and the visit of an old furnished house. Level 3: the craft of fisherman and clog-maker and an exhibition of of wooden sculptures by the artist Pierre LERON LESUR.
tldr: Visite interactive de l'ancienne forge, avec démonstrations de métiers disparus pour toute la famille.

name: Musée de la forge et des anciens métiers de Belcastel (Groupes)
description:
Situated in the village, the house, once Fernand Moly's forge and the home of his entire family, is now houses all the old tools of the farrier, the blacksmith, the clog maker and the fisherman. Three trades practiced in Belcastel at the beginning of the twentieth century those disappeared today. Also, a collection of "sylvistructure" donated by Pierre Leron-Lesur, a naturalist artist, completes the visit of this old house.
Duration: 30 minutes (all year round by reservation). 

Price: 2 €/person (guide free)
Possibility of combining it with a visit to the village (total price €5/person).

Accompanied by a guide you will discover the men at the origin of the industrial revolution, the major events of these 150 years of mining and steel industry, the reality of the working conditions of the miners, the different jobs that men, women and sometimes even children had, and how they fought many times to obtain rights. Traditional miners' equipment, numerous tools, corporate flags and banners, archival documents, and an attractive museography invite you to relive this great ind
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire minière du bassin de Decazeville avec un guide, à travers des machines et récits authentiques.

It is composed of two distinct parts: a large room representing the viticulture and the material of a clog maker and an annex room regrouping an old reconstituted mine.

You'll learn about the different knife-making trades, which are presented in the form of workshops of the time. There's an exhibition of thousands of cutting tools and forged objects used in former trades. A unique exhibition of our collection of Laguiole knives from their origin. Thanks to stage settings, you can see how rye, chestnuts & potatoes were grown, & how "cantou" (traditional fireplace in South West of France) were built.
To keep the elders' memory alive!

You can only enter the museum by visiting the wildlife park.

On the boat, you will be able to enjoy sunbathing, hammocks, and chairs to spend a good time with your family or friends! Let's change the energy together!

No special license required to drive the boats.
A deposit check will be required.
Buoyancy vests provided.
possibility to reserve a picnic.
Meeting point at La Grave or Cabanac, depending on water levels
tldr: Parcourez le lac de Castelnau-Lassouts-Lous en bateau électrique, au cœur d’une nature préservée et sauvage.

name: O'Paddle d'Olt : canoé, kayak, Stand Up Paddle
description:
Canoeing down 7 km or walking on the lake of Castelnau-Lassouts-Lous,
Rental and supervision in Stand up Paddle
Drink, hammock and picnic baskets and aperitif (on reservation).
tldr: Descendez le Lot en canoë ou pagayez sur le lac, avec location et encadrement pour une sortie nature complète.

name: O'Paddle d'Olt : canoë, kayak, Stand Up Paddle, bateaux électriques (groupes)
description:
O'Paddle d'Olt offers a wide range of services, from 1-hour activities to full-day events. Tribes, leisure centers, vacation camps, companies - we'll tailor-make a program to suit your needs.
To serve you, we have 35 Stand Up Paddle (introductory equipment), 50 canoe-kayaks (from 1 to 4 places), 3 electric boats (6 to 8 people per boat).
O'Paddle d'Olt also organizes orienteering races, obstacle courses, regional quizzes and many other fun activities.

By reservation only
tldr: Organisez une sortie sur mesure en groupe : canoë, kayak ou bateau électrique, adapté à vos envies et besoins.

name: O'Paddle d'Olt : Paddle Bivouac
description:
Try bivouacking, in complete autonomy on new generation paddles. Sensations guaranteed! Discovery of the Lot over 2 days with equipment (2 waterproof bags, tent, fishing gear hooks).
Possibility of picnic basket on request. And for the amateurs, don't forget your fishing rod!
Meeting point at the beach of La Grave, every day, from 9am to 6pm.
tldr: Dormez en autonomie sur un paddle pour une aventure insolite de bivouac sur les eaux du Lot.

name: Observatoire du lac de la Gourde
description:
Inside you can observe the birds through the retractable windows placed at different heights. Interpretation panels explain the species that you can observe and their periods of presence.  It is accessible all year round. Round trip of 3km from the camping of the Retenue. Follow on foot the arrow "lac de la Gourde".

Access 

Large parking lot at the beach of Pareloup-Arvieu (Notre-Dame d'Aures) 1km away connected by a beachfront path

Other access: park at the trailhead parking lot (4 sites) by taking the small narrow road to the right of the Retenue campsite

It is possible to make a loop on
tldr: Observez les oiseaux depuis un observatoire discret, avec des panneaux pour identifier les espèces locales.

name: Oenologie souterraine
description:
An introduction to caving, an unusual and unforgettable way to discover the natural and culinary riches of our region!

Take to the depths of the Salles-la-Source delta for a unique experience: taste local produce and Marcillac wines during this caving initiation. You'll be accompanied by professionals in a safe environment throughout the experience. Abseil down 12 m (not compulsory) and discover the underground world.


Accessible to all motivated adults.
Please bring sportswear.
(Equipment, supervision and tasting included in the price)



Reservations required on 06 81 30 79 22.
tldr: Dégustez des vins dans une cave souterraine après une exploration spéléologique des richesses locales.

name: ORCA Coaching
description:
32m2 air-conditioned coaching studio for 1 to 2-person sessions and 50m2 room for 3 to 6-person sessions.
Functional bodybuilding equipment: high-quality elastics, dumbbells, kettlebells, Olympic bar.
Changing room with shower.
Reception area
As I'm on my own, and to ensure quality sessions, I don't accept unannounced visits.
Thank you for your understanding.

name: OSP un oeil sur le passé. Découverte de technologies anciennes
description:
In an air-conditioned, PRM-accessible 180 m2 building, 220 everyday objects have been brought together. Music, photos, cinema, radios, printing, small technologies, "What's it for, how does it work, history", the answer on a guided tour. Everything works.
With more than 220 objects, from 40 donors/lenders, mainly representing means of communication, measurement and small-scale domestic manufacture, there's something for everyone, whether it's acquiring knowledge, admiring the ingenuity of our elders or contemplating noble objects with a touch of nostalgia... Enthusiastic guides accompany visit

name: Packrafting - rando aqua insolite Espace Rivières
description:
Open year-round by reservation
Water hike through the underground canals of La Canourgue (ages 7 and up) (1 hour 30 minutes): starting at 25 ?
Packrafting in the Lot Gorges for ages 14 and up (half-day or full day): starting at 55?
Train and packrafting on the Colagne and Lot rivers for ages 14 and up (1 day): starting at 78 ?
Kayaking or packrafting on other rivers upon request: contact us
tldr: Randonnez en packraft dans des canaux souterrains ou les gorges du Lot, une aventure aquatique hors norme.

name: Padel
description:
Straight from Spain, Padel is a racket sport derived from tennis, squash and badminton. Padel is sure to win you over, thanks to its conviviality, accessibility and playful spirit.

The town of Saint-Affrique provides two padel tennis courts. This is your chance to try out this trendy new sport.

name: PAIN À L'ANCIENNE
description:
Every Tuesday in July and August, from 11am to 5pm, Jean-Baptiste, a trained baker, enjoys working with flours to produce authentic, tasty breads. With flours from the nearby Moulin à Vent de la Borie, our ancient wood-fired oven will sublimate his work and produce exceptional bread.

Depending on when you arrive, you can help him knead the dough, heat the oven, put the bread in the oven or take it out. In all cases, he'll be happy to discuss his work and his breads with you.

You can come for the whole day, alternating visits with the major stages in the bread-making process, or go out to tas
tldr: Venez pétrir et cuire du pain traditionnel chaque mardi d’été, avec des farines locales et un savoir-faire artisanal.

name: Pains et farines de La Roquecanude
description:
Welcome to Ferme de Roquecanude!

Here you'll find a wide range of quality products!
Our small, organic, free-range pig farm enables us to offer you fresh meat parcels, terrines in a variety of flavors, as well as our dried meats, sausages, coppa and lonzo.

Our young herd of free-range Highland Cattle will soon enable us to offer you meat of excellent nutritional quality, similar to that of bison, low in cholesterol and rich in omega fatty acids.

In the bakery, you'll find a number of different organic breads, made by us from ancient cereals grown on our land and transformed into flour on th
tldr: Découvrez des produits fermiers bio et artisanaux, issus d’une exploitation porcine en plein air et locale.

name: Pampa ride / Draisiennes électriques
description: sessions are organized on our dedicated track. Bumps, banked turns, slalom ... everything is in place for our future champions. Duration: 30 minutes
tldr: Testez des draisiennes électriques sur un parcours ludique avec virages et bosses pour un défi fun.

name: Pampa ride / Randonnée moto circuit causses et forêts
description: motorcycle license required for drivers, suitable clothing (closed shoes, long pants). Bring your own motorcycle. Duration 1 day.
tldr: Parcourez les causses et forêts en moto sur un circuit dédié, pour une journée sportive et immersive.

name: Pampa ride / Randonnée quad
description: driving license required for drivers, suitable clothing (closed shoes, long pants). Choice of duration: 2 or 3 hours
tldr: Quad sur terrain dédié : sensations fortes garanties pour pilotes confirmés, paysages préservés.

name: Pampa ride / Stage moto et quad enfant
description: Courses are organized on our dedicated quad and motorcycle terrain. All levels, from 7 to 16 years old.
tldr: Stage moto/quad pour enfants : initiation ludique et encadrée sur terrain sécurisé, de 7 à 16 ans.

name: Panorama de la Confluence à Entraygues sur Truyère
description: Access from the Route d'Aurillac: Park at the lookout, then take the footpath that starts in the woods.

name: Panorama depuis la Vierge de Vermus à Espalion
description:
It takes a bit of effort to reach the Madonna, which culminates after an hour's walk and an ascent of around 200 metres. But what a view from up there!
Situated on the route of Saint Jacques de Compostelle, you can reach the summit by taking the small tarmac road that leaves the Espalion canoe-kayak base in the direction of Saint Côme d'Olt.
Start on foot from the Perse church parking lot in Espalion.

name: PANORAMA DU POINT SUBLIME
description:
Located at 870 m of altitude, the classified site of the "Point Sublime" is one of the places in the gorges of the Tarn the most frequented. Located on the Causse de Sauveterre, the Point-Sublime is a belvedere which offers to the visitors the spectacle of these marvellous ochre cliffs plunging in the emerald waters of the Tarn.
At the foot, more than four hundred meters below, the Tarn makes a right angle turn and this 'caprice' allows the visitor to take in the gorges in enfilade, and towards the east, and towards the south. Opposite, the steep ledges of the Méjean causse give the final touc
tldr: Point de vue à 870 m d'altitude : panorama exceptionnel sur les gorges du Tarn, classé parmi les plus beaux sites.

name: PANORAMA DU ROC DES HOURTOUS
description:
In a pastoral and wild environment, the owners of the site open the doors of the Roc des Hourtous and offer you an exceptional landscape.
On the edge of the Causse Méjean, the viewpoint is drawn below the narrowest part of the Gorges du Tarn : Les Détroits.

You will be able to observe the flight of the vultures, to admire the splendid sunsets around a good small dish on the terrace of the Rock.
tldr: Admirez un panorama à couper le souffle depuis le Roc des Hourtous, entre Causse Méjean et Gorges du Tarn.

name: Panorama over the Viaur Viaduct
description:
Let this construction of genious carry you away...

Between Aveyron & Tarn, in the heart of the Ségala, the Viaur Viaduct & its 3,800 tons of steel, seems to lay down, as light as a feather, on the hillsides of the Viaur Valley. 

It is a remarkable metal work of the engineer Paul Bodin : steel girders, arches, a million of rivets... This aerial lace is 166m high & 460m long, with a 220m-wingspread central arch.

You will be amazed by the harmony between technique & nature.
... & its innovative technique!
The Viaur Viaduct was subject to an architecture competition in 1887, open to engineers:
tldr: Viaduc du Viaur : géante structure métallique suspendue, vue vertigineuse sur les vallées du Ségala.

name: Panorama sur Estaing et les gorges du Lot depuis Las Combes
description: At the first bend after the hamlet of Las Combes, on the D97, stop to admire the valley with this panoramic view.

name: Panorama sur la vallée du Lot depuis le château de Roquelaure
description:
A platform behind the Romanesque chapel of Château de Roquelaure offers a panoramic view of the area.
Recommended access via the D664 road from Le Clapas de Thubiès.
For those wishing to reach this panorama as part of a longer hike, we recommend this one: 21-Le-clapas-de-Thubies.pdf

name: Panorama sur la vallée du Lot depuis Notre Dame des Hauteurs à Golinhac
description:
Stop to admire the panorama from this sanctuary, built in the last century on the Puech de Regault.
Parking at the foot of the hill and picnic tables available.

name: Panorama sur les gorges du Lot depuis Fombillou au Nayrac
description:
In addition to the spectacular view of the gorge, you'll find a beautiful landscape that takes on a variety of colors depending on the season. A great place to return to time and again!
To get there, follow the hiking trail "Le chemin des vignes depuis Crussac" (info on the Nayrac commune website) - Distance: 13.21 km - D+: 411 m / D-: 417 m.

name: Parc  de loisirs de Vabre
description: Activities : tennis, athletics, football, basketball, rugby. If you wish to go for a walk with the family you will discover the superb arboretum.

name: Parc Accrobranche Du Haut des Arbres
Parc animalier Le Saint Hubert
description:
Parc animalier du Saint-Hubert: wildlife immersion near Rodez
Just a few minutes from Rodez, the Parc animalier Le Saint Hubert offers a unique wildlife experience in an unspoilt natural setting. Located in Montrozier, on the edge of the Palanges forest, this park invites visitors to experience a close-up immersion with the animals in an authentic, verdant environment.
The park extends over almost 28 hectares of meadows and woods, home to over 150 European wild animals in semi-liberty: European stags, Japanese deer, Asian fallow deer, Corsican mouflons and wild boar. Here, the animals evolve i
tldr: Parc animalier Le Saint-Hubert : immersion en forêt pour observer cerfs, sangliers et rapaces en semi-liberté.

name: Parc AquaVagues Millau
description:
The Parc AquaVagues Millau, white water stadium is an artificial river arm on which a team of specialists does everything possible to offer you customized experiences.
Discover the white water !

We develop with our instructors of the training courses of discovery, improvement, challenges multi supports: rafting, hydrospeed, kayak, dragon boat, stand up paddle... Face the waves to the doors of Millau!
You can also go at your own pace by renting the equipment and accessing the white water stadium independently, always with our advice.

Duration of the activity : from 1h30 to 2h.
tldr: Parc AquaVagues : parcours en eaux vives artificielles, sensations de rafting sans risque pour tous niveaux.

name: Parc aventure Le Saint Hubert
description:
Parc aventure du Saint-Hubert: a fun activity in the trees near Rodez
Just a few minutes from Rodez, the Parc aventure du Saint-Hubert offers an original activity in the heart of nature, ideal for a family vacation or weekend outing. Located in the heart of a natural wooded estate in Montrozier, this park offers a fun experience accessible to all, combining tree games, sensations and moments of relaxation.
Unlike a traditional accrobranche course, the Saint-Hubert adventure park uses a system of giant suspended nets, enabling visitors to move through the trees without the need for a harness. V
tldr: Parc aventure en forêt : parcours accrobranche avec tyroliennes et ponts de singe, idéal pour familles.

name: Parc de Loisirs des Bouscaillous (groupes)
description: On a woody domain of several dozens of hectares, the park offers activities with great added value: national go-carting track, initiation and training for Quad driving. Exlusive: the guided visit of the big Viaduct of Millau in Quads for 1/2 day - mountainbiking - archery, buggy, paintball ... sports products presented either as separate activity or in a package (choice of packages).

name: Parc de loisirs des Bouscaillous - Paintball
description: Situated in a 77 acre leisure park, you can play paintball in the countryside (adults and children). Make the most of the park and its activities too: go-karting, quad biking, restaurant snack bar. Target shooting course in the forest like a mini-golf. Children's paintball (8 to 12 years old). Adult's paintball: make a paint stain mark on your opponent before he or she gets you, guaranteed fun and adrenaline.
tldr: Paintball en pleine nature : stratégie et adrénaline dans un parc de 77 hectares, avec go-karts et quads.

name: Parc de Loisirs des Bouscaillous karting
description: Our circuit brings together all the ingredients necessary to satisfy your passion for driving: straights, fast corners, tight corners, chicanes, banking, at a constant width of  8 metres approved first category. A fleet of 30 karts, 270cc, ideal for an introduction, leisure or endurance, children's karts from 9 years, twin seater kart ideal for taster rides from 4 years and "two up" driving. For experienced drivers, Formula FFSA, 100 cc, competition karts.
tldr: Circuit de karting homologué : virages serrés et lignes droites pour défier vos limites sur 8 mètres de large.

name: Parc de Loisirs des Bouscaillous quad
description: Discovery trail on the Causses and around the Millau viaduct on quad bikes or buggies. "Millau viaduct special discovery trail": on quad bikes or buggies, 2 hours of fun and emotion, sensation and pleasure! Evening and night trips possible! Departures according to the season.
tldr: Balade en quad autour du viaduc de Millau : 2h d'exploration des Causses avec vue imprenable.

name: Parc de Loisirs des Bouscaillous Séminaire / Incentive Pleine nature
description: Exclusivity, guided and commentated visit of the Millau viaduct on quad bikes.
tldr: Visite guidée du viaduc de Millau en quad : découverte technique et panoramique de ce géant d'acier.

name: Parc du Château du Colombier
description:
Whether a military building or a castle of convenience, the Dovecote has undergone many changes over the centuries. It takes its name from the two dovecotes used to breed pigeons at the time. Today, Paul and Edmond de La Panouse open their estate to the public to share their history and pass on their knowledge of ancestral customs.
For thrill-seekers, book your Auto-Psy escape game here (not recommended for under-18s): https://escape.chateauducolombier.fr/auto-psy/

Need a refreshing gourmet break? The castle store offers drinks and snacks.
tldr: Château du Colombier : histoire médiévale et architecture unique, avec ses deux colombiers centenaires.

name: Parcours "Oreilles en balade" au Viaduc du Viaur
description:
This railway viaduct, inaugurated in 1902, is synonymous with a revolution in the Ségala region. It linked the departments of Aveyron and Tarn (between Tauriac-de-Naucelle (12) and Tanus (81)). The arrival of the train led to the development of trade and, in particular, the arrival of lime, which gave a major boost to Segali agriculture: wheat and corn replaced rye.
This technical feat (listed as a historic monument), designed by Paul Bodin, can be admired from three different vantage points, each equipped with QRcodes to be flashed, giving you access to some fascinating local anecdotes!
Don't
tldr: Parcours Oreilles en balade : balade sensorielle autour du viaduc du Viaur, avec écoute de sons naturels.

description: 13 beacons to look for, 3 possible routes : easy, medium and difficult. Orientation maps are available on request at the Tourist Office in Laguiole.
address: Station de ski de Laguiole - Le Bouyssou

adults and children alike, including baby carriages and

river. As you follow the markers, you'll plunge into the heart of the forest.

As part of the "Explorateurs du Tarn" program, set off on a treasure hunt on this trail designed for teenagers and adults, close to the yellow-marked forest path
which is marked in yellow.

name: Parcours d'orientation d'Arvieu
description: The permanent orientation course is adapted to children from 8 to 14 years old. Created by the children of the Arvieu school, it aims at practicing a physical and sportive activity in the open air with the whole family. 10 markers to look for on the paths of Arvieu.
tldr: Parcours d'orientation pour enfants : jeu sportif créé par des écoliers, entre arbres et landes.

name: Parcours d'orientation dans le Canyon de Bozouls
description:
Download the route maps and find the markers positioned at various points along the canyon. An original idea for a fun, sporting and outdoor activity for the whole family!
Three different routes are proposed, each with three levels of difficulty (a symbol to discover for level 1, a mystery word for level 2 and a punch for level 3).
Start at Place du Caminol (next to Espace Denys-Puech).
Maps are also available from the town hall reception and the Bozouls tourist information office.
tldr: Orientation dans le canyon de Bozouls : 3 parcours pour explorer ce cirque naturel en famille.

name: Parcours d'orientation de Camboulas
description:
Discover Camboulas, in Lévézou, differently..

Adaptable according to your level of sporting practice (easy or average), the permanent circuit of orienteering of Camboulas is addressed to the competitors who will try to carry out the best performance, or with the walkers who will benefit from the landscape surroundings and the local inheritance.

You will find on this course 15 markers. Each one is equipped with a clip which allows you to prove, within the framework of the activity, that you have found the right marker.



This practice requires to have an orientation map in your possession, w

name: Parcours d'orientation de la Nécropole wisigothe du Sabel
description:
In a frantic orienteering race, discover the Visigothic tombs and ancient habitats thanks to the QRcodes and explanatory panels of the orienteering course of the hamlet of Pinsac aux Costes-Gozon.
Ready to take up the challenge?

name: Parcours d'orientation de St-Beauzély
description:
On a 1.5 km family trail, initiated by Lou-Anne Czaplicki and the village leisure centre, follow the white arrows and go in search of the animals scattered around the village!
You can park on the Alain Peyrefitte square (grocery store square), the start is at the corner of the school, the route makes a loop allowing you to return to your vehicle
Count on about 45 minutes of fun discovery!
The leaflet of the route can be printed in order to fill in the boxes associated with the animals hidden in the streets of the village!

name: Parcours de l'ancienne voie ferrée Bertholène-Gabriac-Bozouls-Espalion
description:
This 22 km path between Bertholène and Espalion offers a variety of landscapes and views of our beautiful heritage, including the calvary at Gabriac, the château at Calmont d'Olt and Tholet, as well as panoramic views over the Causse and the Lot valley.
The final section, between Bozouls and Espalion (gently downhill in this direction, and uphill in the opposite direction), takes you through several tunnels and viaducts.
Distance between villages: Bertholène - Gabriac - Bozouls: 11 km / Bozouls - Espalion: 11 km.
Possible departure points: Parking de l'ancienne gare in Bozouls (at the equestri
tldr: Ancienne voie ferrée transformée en piste cyclable : 22 km de paysages variés entre villages et patrimoine.

name: Parcours de Santé de Coussergues
description: 12 apparatus over a distance of 1 km

name: Parcours ludique "Randoland à Camboulazet"
description:
What does the game involve?
The Randoland circuit cards are designed as a treasure hunt for families, and especially for children.
The clues collected along the way on architectural and natural heritage elements encourage children to observe and search to solve the enigmas suggested. In short, it's a fun way to get out and learn!
How to play the game?
Simply download the form corresponding to your child's age (4-6; 7-9; 10+) from the Town Hall website www.camboulazet12.fr or below.
A paper version is available from Camboulazet town hall (during office opening hours) or from the tourist office
tldr: Randoland à Camboulazet : chasse au trésor familiale pour découvrir le patrimoine local en s'amusant.

name: Parcours permanent d'orientation à la Tour de Peyrebrune
description: Your challenge: find the beacons that are hidden on the site of Peyrebrune: behind the rocks, near a tree... Punch the map and pay attention to the scale!

name: Parcours santé de Rignac
description: Nine apparatuses complete the possibilities of relaxation and leisure along the trail. Five benches have found their place in the shade of trees. The whole fits perfectly in the park.

name: Parcours sportif/ santé de Salmiech
description: On the banks of the Céor, a shady, refreshing trail with picnic tables and animal sculptures... For a pleasant, peaceful moment of relaxation for the whole family.
tldr: Parcours sportif santé : sentier ombragé avec sculptures animales et tables de pique-nique au bord du Céor.

name: Pareloup Pilot'
description:
Jet ski baptism.
Enjoy the thrills and, above all, have fun choosing the activity that's right for you: a supervised ride on a jet ski, with you piloting and leading your passenger? Or a thrill ride in a towed buoy? You can even take your boating license.
Excursions in a motorboat with a captain, or a trip in a luxury "Pontoon Boat" (without a boating license), be your own Captain! (8 berths)
The jet-skis and boat run on bioethanol. All activities are supervised by state-qualified instructors
+ 10 1-seater paddles
+ 5 2-seater kayaks (rental by the hour, half-day or day)

Individuals, families
tldr: Pilot' Pareloup : baptême de jet ski sur le lac, sensations fortes et pilotage encadré pour tous.

name: Pareloup Pilot' - Permis bateau Côtier, fluvial, hauturier, radio
description:
Take advantage of your vacations or weekends to get your coastal or river boat license! Training in 1 day in a classroom, 2 hours of individual boat driving (training without exam), e-learning via Codes Rousseau, and passing the theoretical exam on the day of your choice, in the post office of your choice (everywhere in France).
Easy and useful, from 16 years old, the boating license allows you to navigate freely on closed lakes and the sea (coastal license) and/or on lakes, rivers and streams (river license).
tldr: Permis bateau en 1 jour : formation accélérée pour naviguer en mer, rivière ou hauturier sans stress.

description:
All our activities are supervised by our DE instructors, fuel equipment and insurance included.

- Towed buoys: 10-minute sessions on the lake with our 2 x 4-seater sofas, or 2 x 4-seater round buoys (slide) lying down (soft or rod
tldr: Pilotez un jet-ski sur le lac de Pareloup, encadré par des pros, pour une aventure aquatique de 30 min à 1h.

name: Pareloup Pilot' Balade en bateau
description:
After having met the team and the participants, the captain explains the rules to be respected on board and the course of the trip.

You then get into the RIB, equipped with your life jacket (provided). The captain gives the last instructions and leaves the dock.

You are now on your way to discover the shores of Lake Pareloup: visit the impressive Retenue, the Snake Island and finally, the Bird Island, the most natural and wild of the islands of the lake. These islands are only accessible by boat!

The return to the pontoon can be done at high speed, to finish with the maximum of sensations o
tldr: Embarquez sur un RIB pour une balade guidée sur le lac de Pareloup, avec vue sur les paysages sauvages.

This activity is for everyone, families from 5 years upwards (sofa buoys), or for the more muscular, Slide 4-seater lying buoys. (Soft or rodeo mode)

tldr: Tractez en famille sur une bouée géante ou défiez-vous en mode rodeo sur le lac de Pareloup.

name: Pareloup Pilot' Jet ski

name: Plus on partage, plus on possède
Point de vue de la tour ornithologique
description:
The Puech de Flauzins observation tower overlooks the Viaur valley and is a major attraction for observing bird migrations, where numerous species can be seen (geese, cranes, bondreys, bee-eaters, etc.). The North-South migration runs from August 15 to the end of October, and the South-North migration from early March to around April 15.
The 12-metre-high tower also offers a 360° view of the Viaur valley and Ségala landscape, and a better understanding of how man has shaped this environment over time.

description:
In the village of Brousse-le-château, classified "Most Beautiful Villages of France", discover the old bridge of the village, of Romanesque inspiration.
It is part of a circuit dedicated to Romanesque art called: "Romanesque heritage along the valleys of the Muse, the Rasp of the Tarn and surroundings".

name: Pont de Comencau
description:
The bridge's name derives from "Combacaud", meaning "combe-chaude", a name given to well-exposed land in the hollow of the valley.
A solid architectural structure that has withstood the onslaught of the Aveyron River!
The forty-meter bridge is built of schist and rests on 4 semicircular arches. A separate arch on the left bank once spanned the old mill canal. Built in an unspoilt landscape, it displays a number of old-fashioned features: piers with triangular forebays and rectangular hindbays, the latter barely marked.
The piers appear to have been built in two phases. The first part, rising 1
tldr: Traversez ce pont médiéval solide, témoin historique nommé d'après une 'combe chaude'.

name: Pont du Port de la Besse
description: Visit this charming site ! Above the restaurant, admire the tall rock on which was built a medieval tower named “Tournemire”.
tldr: Admirez la tour médiévale 'Tournemire' perchée sur un rocher au-dessus du restaurant.

name: Pop Corn labyrinthe
description:
Every year, there's a new route and new activities!
For even more fun, there are also stages with wooden games and enigma courses. Don't wait any longer... Come and play and get lost!
Open daily from 10am to 5:30pm in July and August. Possibility of nocturnal visits on Tuesdays and Fridays, departing between 10 and 11 pm in July and between 9:30 and 10:30 pm in August. Don't forget your flashlight.
Special summer evenings!
Take advantage of the opportunity to taste the ice creams produced on the farm.

Dates and times subject to change: please consult the website.
tldr: Labyrinthe de maïs renouvelé chaque année avec énigmes et jeux en bois pour s'amuser en famille.

name: Porte
description: Symbole de solidité, d'amitié entre deux peuples et deux communautés, sous le signe de l'art et du jumelage entre Vitulano et Belcastel en marbre polychrome de Vitulano et le grès local

name: Porte de la plaine du temple
PR- vers St Pons (Hermitage) Ruines Château
Prieuré de Comberoumal
description: Ancient priory of the Order of Grandmont, founded at the end of the 12th century. Built according to the rules of the Grandmontains. The church has no belfry and posses a unique nave with a barrel vault, it is lit by four Romanesque windows in the semi-circular choir. the ensemble is composed of a cloister, a square chapter house with Romanesque vault and triple arched door, a common room and a dormitory.
tldr: Découvrez une église sans clocher, aux voûtes uniques, vestige mystérieux de l'ordre des Grandmontains du XIIe siècle.

name: Prieuré du Sauvage
description:
It was sold as national property during the Revolution. Part of it, including the church, was used as a stone quarry. The conventual part was used as a wine cellar until the end of the 19th century, and then collapsed. Since 1993, an association "Les amis du Prieuré du Sauvage" has partly restored it and tries to bring it back to life through visits and festive and cultural events.
This site is private. Visits are organized on request and during the Heritage Days.

Permanent photo exhibition on site.
tldr: Un prieuré transformé en carrière puis en cave à vin : histoire et pierres à explorer entre Révolution et traditions locales.

name: Private wellness area - Hotel restaurant du pont
description: Espace bien être privatisé à l'Hôtel restaurant du Pont at Ambialet!

name: Produits fermiers des Axous
description: The G.A.E.C. de La Cépède, ferme des Axous, produce numerous products according to traditional savoir-faire: foie gras, confits, magrets, ready-to-cook meals based on duck, chicken and guinea fowl, lamb and retail packs. Free farm visit and farm shop, situated between St-Rome de Tarn and St-Rome de Cernon. You can find us on the Wednesday morning market at Clermont l'Hérault, Friday morning in Millau and Saturday morning in St Affrique.
tldr: Dégustez foie gras, confits et plats cuisinés fermiers, fabriqués selon des méthodes traditionnelles dans une ferme des gorges du Tarn.

name: Puech de Buzeins
description:
A former volcano rising to 864 metres, the Puech de Buzeins offers a magnificent panorama towards Aubrac and Lévézou
To find your way around, use the orientation tables. A path from the village of Buzeins allows you to reach the top of this puech.

name: Puech du Kaymard
description:
The Puech du Kaymard culminates at 707 meters of altitude and offers a 360° panorama on the region of the valley of Marcillac and by clear weather up to the Mounts of Cantal, the plateau of Lévézou.
Accessible from Majorac by a path (1km)

description:
Accessible to all, young and old, whether on bike, scooter, rollerblade or skateboard.

-> Helmets must be worn by all users.
-> Minors using the mogul course are under the responsibility of their legal guardians.
tldr: Pumptrack ludique et sécurisé pour tous : roulez en famille sur des bosses et virages adaptés à tous les niveaux.

Pumptrack with a City Stadium, a real playground for young people. Near the soccer field and the village hall.
Rules :

tldr: Pumptrack convivial près du stade et de la salle des fêtes : idéal pour s'amuser en plein air avec trottinettes ou vélos.

name: Pumptrack
description:
Two pumptrack circuits installed on the Laubarède playground in Bezonnes, as well as a city-park and a leisure-sports course.
Rules and regulations:
-> Helmets must be worn by all users.
-> Minors using the moguls pitch are under the responsibility of their legal guardians.
tldr: Deux circuits de pumptrack et parcours sportifs à Bezonnes : défiez les bosses et les modules en plein air.

name: Pumptrack
description:
This track, which is over 180 m long, comprises a series of challenging humps and turns.
The name of this track featuring raised turns and humps refers to the “bending-pushing” movements carried out on the bike through the combined action of legs and arms. This pumping action performed on hollows and humps allows the cyclist to gain speed without pedaling. 
This facility is available with free access and is adapted to all levels of proficiency, from young children with their balance bikes to the most experienced riders.
This track is part of a plan aimed at the development of urban sporting ac
tldr: Piste de 180 m de bosses et virages relevés : sensations fortes garanties pour riders de tous niveaux.

name: Pumptrack - piste BMX/VTT
description:
Some points of the rules..:
the mogul field is open from 9am to 9pm, and is not supervised,
minors use the mogul field under the responsibility of their legal guardians,

it is advisable to respect the other users, the vegetation of the site and the quietness of the neighborhood, ?

name: Pumptrack Mathis
description:
On a surface of nearly 6,000 m², 3 levels of tracks are proposed:

> A 75-meter-long green run, accessible to beginners and totally independent,
> A 165-meter-long blue run for intermediate skiers,
> A 110-meter-long red run for advanced skiers.  
A 30-space parking lot is available in front of the facility.

name: Puy de Wolf
description: The slopes of the Puy de Wolf are home to rare and original plants because the rock itself is rare: its serpentinite formed in the earliest times on Earth and by nature not at all suited to plants. Certain species are endemic. At the summit, a viewpoint indicator and a beautiful panoramic view.
tldr: Sur serpentinite, une flore rare et primitive pousse sur ce volcan éteint : randonnée géologique et botanique unique.

name: Pymsports - Descente en Trottinette tout terrain
description:
A 2-hour ride in complete safety
Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, riding alone or in a group: explore the Causses region in Aubrac, starting from St. Geniez d’Olt, on an all-terrain scooter. There’s something for everyone!
You’ll be accompanied by a qualified instructor (BEES mountain biking certification)


From July 8 to July 26 and from August 3 to August 30: Wednesdays, departing at 9 a.m. and 2 p.m., 3-hour activity (1 hour for travel and setup + 2 hours of pure activity)
And from July 27 to August 2: Thursdays, departing at 9 a.m. and 2 p.m., 3-hour activity (1 hour for travel and
tldr: 2h de trottinette tout-terrain en Aubrac : explorez les paysages des Causses en groupe ou en solo, encadré et sécurisé.

name: Pymsports, accompagnement trottinette électrique
description: Mountain bike hire per half day, whole day or more/ hire of mountain bikes and children's trailer. Small repairs to bikes (punctures, changing a chain, adjustments...). Mountain bike guide.
tldr: Location de VTT et remorques enfants, avec réparations et guidage en montagne : explorez les sentiers du Nord-Aveyron.

name: Pymsports, accompagnement trottinette tout terrain
description:
Activity description
Whether you're a beginner or an expert, an individual or a group, discover the Nord-Aveyron region (from Entraygues or St Geniez) on an all-terrain scooter. Downhill scootering is practiced on trails. You'll be accompanied by a qualified instructor who will introduce you to this activity for the whole family. Mountain bikes available for hire on reservation.
Several formulas:
- Discovery/family formula: 10km ride, 1h30 to 2h downhill. Accessible to all, the only prerequisite being the ability to ride a bike. To find out more: see the PDF description.
- 3 sporting formulas
tldr: Descendez les sentiers du Nord-Aveyron en trottinette tout-terrain : paysages variés et encadrement adapté à tous.

name: Quartier de Combes et Eglise ND des Mines (groupes)
description: Brick faced, this church's choir contains mural paintings in orange and blue tones, paying homage to the difficult work of the miners. The stained glass windows were crafted by the monks from the abbey of En Calcat. Permanent recreated display of the baby Jesus in a manger originally built in a mine gallery. Listed Historic Monument.

name: Ranch du Lévézou -  Maison d'hôtes Coeur de Bastié
description:
I offer 1h, 2h or half-day rides, with a maximum of 5 riders, the aim being to share an experience in the heart of nature. If you're comfortable at a walk, trot or canter, our paint horses will be delighted to show you their skills, both in the forest and across the plains and mountains that surround us: 360° panoramic views with Aubrac in the background or the Pyrenees Orientales. Not forgetting another walk along the Viaur to cool off. We make our way up and down the slopes, taking in a wide variety of panoramic views.
Whether you're a seasoned rider, a family or a group of friends, with or
tldr: Balades à cheval en petit groupe sur le Lévézou : partagez une expérience nature avec des paint horses dociles.

name: Rand'Oc Aventure
description: Hiking is a perfect balance between effort, observation of the natural environment and meetings at the crossroads. As a mountain leader, my challenge is to offer this balance, for a day, in a friendly and simple atmosphere. The mountain guide proposes an atypical hike with an itinerary adapted to his clients. Away from the crowds of tourists and guidebooks, the guide leads the hike on a chosen theme: fauna, flora, culture, orientation, night adventure... discovery, adventure, history, curiosity: Escape !
tldr: Randonnées guidées en montagne : équilibre entre effort, découverte des paysages et rencontres, encadrées par un professionnel.

name: Rando accompagnée en VTT électrique à quatre roues (quadbike)
description:
Discover Bozouls, its landscapes and heritage, on an AE 4-wheel mountain bike (Quadbike).
Electric assistance to limit effort. No noise to get closer to nature.
Innovative, supervised rides. Minimum 4 people, maximum 5.
Family outings (slow tourism). Various stops along the way to help you discover the site.
You can also follow the old railroad line from Bozouls to Espalion. A "return trip" that highlights the superb scenery, and the charm of passing under the tunnels and viaducts used by the hike.
Possibility of fitting a child seat (2/5 years) on the Quadbike
Possibility of following with an
tldr: Quad électrique silencieux pour explorer Bozouls et ses paysages : assistance électrique et balades innovantes.

name: Rando Semi-nocturne de Jouqueviel aux infournats
Randonnée : le circuit des pins
description:
From the village square, set off to explore the landscapes of the South Aveyron. After a few kilometers offering impressive views of the Raspes du Tarn, a first stop is necessary in the hamlet of Auriac to stroll among the remains of its castle.
After your short break, take the road on the edge of a pine forest and keep an eye out for the silhouette of the Millau Viaduct which will be revealed in the distance... Continue your way, intoxicated by the smell of pine trees, to the viewpoint of the village of St-Rome-de-Tarn before going back down to the village among the faïsses (name given to the
tldr: Boucle pédestre de Saint-Rome-de-Tarn : paysages des Raspes du Tarn et halte gourmande au hameau d'Auriac.

name: Randonnée à dromadaire - Ferme de la Blaquière
description: The nice and friendly dromedary caravan will lead you along the paths at a pace that lets you fully enjoy the Causse's varied attractions. It is possible to set up a bivouac camp making 2 day rides in the region possible. The farm offers different accommodation possibilities: natural campsite and gîte caussenard which makes the organisation of such activities easier for groups who want to visit the area. The rides are essentially within the Aveyron but would be possible elsewhere too.
tldr: Balade à dos de dromadaire sur le Causse : rythme lent pour profiter des paysages et bivouac possible en 2 jours.

name: Randonnée à dromadaires - Ferme de la Blaquière  (groupes)
description: The "Ferme de la Blaquière" is a family farm where the Castanier family will be happy to welcome you. In the heart of the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses, staying in our gîte or on our campsite, come and discover the activities of the  Ferme de la Blaquière: farm produced cheese sold, rides on dromedaries and numerous activities around the farm, the gîte or the campsite...
tldr: Randonnées à dromadaire pour groupes : explorez le Parc des Grands Causses en famille ou entre amis, avec hébergement possible.

name: Randonnée accompagnée d'un âne
description:
Discover the trails of the Bozoulais region on a guided group hike lasting about 2 hours in the company of the horses. 
Before departure, the animals will be prepared, groomed, and brushed.
It’s important to make a reservation, as the number of families is limited.
For more information, call 06.87.23.80.82.
Children over 5 years old are not allowed to ride the donkeys.
tldr: Randonnée de 2h avec un âne : découvrez les sentiers de Bozouls en compagnie d'un baudet préparé pour l'occasion.

name: Randonnée accompagnée en VTT électrique à 4 roues (quadbike) dans le canyon de Bozouls
description:
Discover Bozouls, its landscapes, and its heritage on a 4-wheel electric mountain bike (quad bike).
Electric assist makes the ride easier. No noise, so you can get as close to nature as possible.
Innovative, guided tours. Minimum of 4 people, maximum of 5 people.
Family-friendly tours (slow tourism). Along the route, there are various stops to help you better explore the area.
You can also ride along the old railway linethat runs from Bozouls to Espalion, on Saturdays at 2 p.m. (reservations required at 06 87 03 81 19). This “round-trip” highlights stunning scenery and the charm of passing thr
tldr: Quad électrique pour explorer le canyon de Bozouls : paysages spectaculaires et balade silencieuse en pleine nature.

name: Randonnée accompagnée en VTT électrique à 4 roues (quadbike) sur l'ancienne voie ferrée Bozouls-Espalion
description:
Activity supervised by a sports instructor.
With the Quadbike (a 4-wheel mountain bike with electric assist), you’ll be able to explore the entire length of the old railroad track between Bozouls and Espalion. It’s a different way to ride—more stable thanks to its four wheels and less strenuous thanks to its electric assist—allowing you to explore this area and take the time to observe its remarkable flora and fauna. Family tours, in groups of up to 5 people. With its %AB nearly reclined %BB seating position and %AB airplane-style handlebars %BB, you’ll enjoy riding down the descents, up the c
tldr: Quad électrique sur une ancienne voie ferrée : explorez le tracé entre Bozouls et Espalion en toute sérénité.

name: Randonnée en Quad
description: Explore the Tarn on a quad bike with MMT Rando: 3 packages to discover panoramic views, nature and relaxation. Sensations guaranteed, professional supervision, safety assured.
tldr: Explorez les paysages du Tarn en quad avec des vues panoramiques, encadré par des professionnels pour une expérience sûre et sportive.

description:
Affectionate, smart, and determined, the donkey is the ideal hiking companion. It carries your gear for the day and knows how to win everyone over: from the children it can carry to the teens it inspires, it adds a whole new dimension to your hikes!
* Poulguières–St. Etienne loop via Le Coudol, Ambias, and Le Grès, returning via the GR736 through Les Raspes
* Children ages 3 to 8 can ride on the donkey’s back under your supervision: please bring a riding or bicycle helmet (if possible)
* No technical difficulty, but everyone must wear closed-toe shoes. Please also bring your own picnic lunch a
tldr: Hissez-vous sur les Raspes avec un âne, compagnon malin qui porte vos affaires et séduit petits et grands lors de votre randonnée.

description: Thanks to her collection of household items dating back to the 20th century, Patricia has recreated a vintage atmosphere: come and discover her passion!
tldr: Plongez dans une épicerie d’autrefois grâce à une collection d’objets du XXe siècle, recréant l’ambiance d’un passé authentique.

Would you like to eat a good aligot at the Peyrouse farm inn?
Situated in the heart of an old cowshed, we open the doors of our farm inn with visits and menus made with products from our own or neighboring farms.
tldr: Dégustez un aligot maison à la ferme de Peyrouse, dans un cadre rustique, avec des produits locaux et des visites de l’exploitation.

Nathalie, a graduate of a Brevet d'Etat d'Accompagnatrice Moyenne Montagne, will take you to discover her region on foot, by bike or snowshoe.
The hikes are possible by the day, half-day or in star stay with accommodation in gîte.
tldr: Partez en randonnée, à vélo ou en raquettes avec une accompagnatrice moyenne montagne pour découvrir la région autrement.

Nathalie, who holds a state diploma as a mid-mountain guide, will take you on a tour of the region on foot, bike or snowshoe.
Hikes are available by the day, half-day or as a star-rated tour with accommodation in a gîte.
tldr: Explorez les paysages de Sévérac-d’Aveyron en groupe, encadré par une guide diplômée, à pied, à vélo ou en raquettes.

name: Rêve et Rando - Randonnée pédestre
description:
Nathalie, a graduate of a Brevet d'Etat d'Accompagnatrice Moyenne Montagne, will take you to discover her region on foot, by bike or snowshoe.
The hikes are possible by the day, half-day or in star stay with accommodation in gîte.
tldr: Découvrez la région à pied avec une accompagnatrice moyenne montagne, adaptant les randonnées à vos envies et votre niveau.

name: Ricard Alice - Ferme d'Hermilix (groupes)
description: At the origin of Roquefort, before maturing of the cheese in caves, there's the sheep's milk and a whole process: that of the breeder. Six Pay de Roquefort breeders offer you the occasion to visit their farms. You will be able to visit their sheep barns, see their lambs, perhaps see them being milked and in any case taste Roquefort in their beautiful caussenard setting. It will also be the occasion to share their daily life at the pace of the sheep, between tradition and modernity. Here are three different ways of discovering their farm, their activity, their lives, ... and their passion for R

name: Rigna'Quizz
description:
Free treasure hunt available at the Rignac tourist office.
Public: children aged 6 to 12 (or younger, helped by parents).

Duration: 30 min to 1h
Reward: a diploma
tldr: Participez à une chasse au trésor gratuite pour enfants (6-12 ans) à Rignac, avec diplôme à la clé après 30 min à 1h de jeu.

name: ROC DU SERRE
description: The Roc du Serre reveals an incredible viewpoint over the village of La Malène, in the foreground of a landscape sinking into the Tarn gorges on the horizon.  When choosing your composition, keep the Tarn as a landmark, it shows the path to take.

name: Roc et Canyon (groupes)
description:
Roc & Canyon specializes in the design, organization, and execution of your trips and programs. Wide choice with our twenty or so activities.
Our strengths:
37 years of experience, in-depth local knowledge, expertise built on a passionate and certified team, and top-quality equipment.

name: Roc et Canyon - Canoë Kayak et Stand up paddle
description:
The Gorges de la Dourbie – a wild river, both family-friendly on the shorter routes or more thrilling with plenty of rapids.
5 km & 8 km routes (family-friendly)
13 km route (sporty)

The Tarn Valley – a calmer river, offering a scenic paddle through Millau with a passage under the famous Millau Viaduct.
9 km & 12 km routes (family-friendly)
17 km route (combining both rivers in one descent)
Different yet complementary, these routes let everyone find the “river to their paddle”, offering the chance to explore two stunning sites at your own pace.
Types of boats available:
Kayak: 1 seat
Canoe: 2
tldr: Descendez les Gorges de la Dourbie en canoë ou paddle : des parcours familiaux ou sportifs au cœur de paysages sauvages.

name: Roc et Canyon - Canyoning avec ou sans cordes
description:
River trekking (canyon without ropes or abseiling) offers all the fun of canyoning, but in a 100% playful and accessible version! Set off on an adventure through stunning natural landscapes.
👉🏼 Minimum age: 8 years
👉🏼 Minimum weight: 25 kg
👉🏼 Swimming ability required
👉🏼 Short hike to reach the start of the canyon (and walk back after the activity)
👉🏼 All obstacles (slides and jumps) can be bypassed along the riverbanks

name: Roman Fountain of Vors
description:

2000 years ago, the Romans had an aqueduct built to supply Segodonum (Rodez) with water from Vors catchment area.
It meandered over 30 km to avoid ravines and hills, and went up little by little on an arcade succession : remains of 133 piles were discovered, with the last one at 20 meters high.
Through gravity flow, a series of several small lead or terracotta pipes supplied fountains, wash-houses, thermae and even some inhabitants (with a fee of course!).

tldr: Découvrez un aqueduc romain de 2000 ans, vestige d'un exploit technique antique pour alimenter Rodez en eau.

description:
The Serre de Cougouille (serre meaning "summit" or "mound" in Occitan) dominates the valley of the Cernon and offers a breathtaking view of the Templar commandery of Ste-Eulalie de Cernon. Up there, an orientation table allows you to better understand the landscape that surrounds you.
Easily accessible from the road*, this site is located in a Natura 2000 zone (natural site with a high heritage value, due to the fauna and flora it shelters). The Serre de Cougouille is known for its richness in insect species (butterflies in particular) and for the presence of birds and natural habitats charact

Every year, at the ideal time for our bodies, nature offers us its Spring Elixir, birch sap.

description:
48 routes from level 3 to level 7
Topo-guide on sale at the Tourist Office of Saint-Amans-des-Côts, Sainte-Geneviève-sur-Argence or Mur-de-Barrez.
Other outdoor climbing sites: Paracol (Argences-en-Aubrac) and Bussière (Brommat).

description:
The 27 climbing routes are spread over 4 different sites. They have been completely renovated and are affiliated to the FFME. Difficulty levels range from 4c to 7a. Open to all free of charge, they are located close to a natural family area with sanitary facilities, picnic area and barbecue.
Climbers are entirely responsible for their activities.

name: Site d'escalade La Roche du Py
description: Climb at Roche du Py on the right bank of the Aveyron River. The routes are accessible by footpath, 5 minutes from the Roquenoubal bridge. The thirty or so equipped routes are of low to medium difficulty and range from 8 to 25 m.

name: Site de Bes-Bédène
description:
The priory was founded by Saint Gausbert in the 11th century. The ogival-style church was built in 1112. A 16th-century altarpiece, statues and priestly vestments are on display.
The granite bridge features a single semicircular arch. This bridge provided passage to a Roman road.
3 hiking trails from Bes-Bédène.
July and August: opening of the museum, which simulates a classroom from the 30s/60s, with magnificent school objects on display.

name: Site de Cassagnes-Comtaux, point de vue, table d'orientation et tables de pique-nique
description: Former chief town of the commune of Goutrens, formerly Cassagnes-de-Panadès (13th century) named after the castle of Panat which stands on a peak on the other side of the valley, above Clairvaux. Cassagnes is mentioned since the year 1000. The locality included three castles: the castelviel or castle of Comte, Saint-Félix above the village then that of Hebrard and Flars, at the bottom of the village (family Mancip, lord of Bournazel). These buildings were connected by an enclosure. Today it is a picturesque hamlet with a view of the vineyards of Marcillac which houses a chapel of the nineteent

According to tradition, the tomb of the old lords would have been located on the rock. It was there that the primitive castle (Xeme, XIeme centuries) was. We advise you not far from there: Visit of the Conservatory of chestnut, Visit and taste at the farm of Tessi.

description: Nearby there is an oratory dating from the 16th century. Legend: At the beginning of the Christian era, Saint George, pursued by the Saracens, ordered his horse to jump over the valley of the Viaur in order to flee his pursuers. The hooves of his horse left their marks on the rock under the church of Saint George. In the 12th century, the Christians had the church built very close to the place where the miracle took place. This building with a fortified bell tower was built on an old oppidum. Tympanum: According to a very probable hypothesis, the tympanum of Saint Georges would come from the p

name: Site de vol libre de parapente de Novis
description:
Located at the southern end of the Causse de Sauveterre, the free flight site of Novis promises you strong sensations in a breathtaking environment, at the doors of the Gorges of the Tarn.

Labeled by the French Federation of Free Flight, the takeoff area of Novis is one of the 4 takeoff sites of the Grands Causses, around Millau.

- Facing South / South-East, this site becomes the only one that can be used when the wind is moderate to strong. - Considered very playful and open by the paragliders, its gentle slope allows to play the game of "close to the ground".

name: Site du Fort et Vieil Aubin
description: What remains of this ancient feudal fortress are the church de la Cène and the defensive tower. Numerous stairways cut into the rock escarpment bear witness to the Romanesque presence and lead to the summit of the site where one discovers a superb panoramic view of the valley. At the entrance, the statue of the Virgin Mary and child welcome visitors. In the old centre of Aubin (Vieil Aubin) in the ancient market place, the14th century  "halle aux grains" cereal market and its 5 measuring weights and beautiful timber framed houses.

name: Site du Fort et Vieil Aubin (groupes)
description: From that ancient feodal fortress we have obtained the church of the Cene, the defence tower and the ruins of the lord's residence and a house. Accompanied by a guide, you will climb the many stairs sculpted in the rock and thus discover the role of the fort and how life was organised there. At the top of the site a superb panorama of the valley and the city of Aubin is unveiled...and that is the whole history of the municipality at your feet. When climbing down you will stop at the grain hall on the former market square where its 5 venerable grain measures witness the economic vitality of the

This verdant promontory, on which the ruins of the castle and a few houses, ovens and other traces of the past sit, is actually brimming with treasures. Treasures that the association "Les Amis de Jalenques" strives to find, decipher and preserve.

Spirulina des Grands Causses is an aquaculture farm located at the foot of Larzac, in the South Aveyron. Céline and Chantal cultivate spirulina: an aquatic bacterium with exceptional nutritional properties.


Naturally rich in proteins, iron, fibers, vitamins and essential amino acids, spirulina fortifies the immune system and brings tonus, balance and vitality to daily life.

name: St Geniez d'Olt, la Ville Lumière
description:
Saint-Geniez d'Olt is a small town of 2000 permanent inhabitants whose population quadruples in the summer season.
Built on both sides of the Lot river, the city benefits from a privileged situation between 2 natural regions : the Causses, in the South, and the Aubrac Mountains, in the North.
The visitor who discovers Saint-Geniez for the first time is struck by the architectural richness of this city. Since the Middle Ages, St-Geniez has taken advantage of the cloth industry to become, in the 18th century, one of the most important towns in Rouergue.
From its past, the city has preserved its

name: St Martin Romanesque church (located in the village of Plaisance)
description:
St Martin church was erected during the 12th century on a rocky promontory overlooking three meanders of the Rance River. The church dedicated to St Martin was for the most part built in the Romanesque style, namely the choir and the transept. In contrast, the original nave was later enlarged in a Gothic style. The building which has an octagonal bell tower is visible from a great distance, and you can't miss it from wherever you might come. This church appears like a watchdog supervising the Rance valley and its illumination at night makes it a landmark.
From the 19th century porch, one can a

description:
Built in the 15th century to protect the local population from the turmoil caused by the Hundred Years' War, the fort of Saint-Jean-d'Alcas remained until the French Revolution a symbol of the power of the Ladies of Nonenque, the neighbouring Cistercian nuns who had administered this territory since the 12th century. There are several ways to discover this monument.

description:
Next year will mark the 30th anniversary of the great discovery of Charles Chambert: a standing statue stone found under his ploughshare.

Monuments of this kind are numerous on the “Grandes Causses” of South Aveyron but the Rech standing stone was the only one discovered in West Aveyron to this day. It is a 5.2  almond shaped porphyroïde micaschiste sculpted to represent the traits of a warrior: a belt, a baldric, and a supposed wide dagger can be observed very well. More anthropomorphic details are harder to find. The head was partially shattered without any clues as to its recency. This at

During school vacation period the equestrian centre provides training courses from beginners to experienced riders. Short rides and long treks are also organized during July and August by the Rial leisure center.
All the supervisory staff are qualified instructors.

name: THE NOTRE-DAME CATHEDRAL OF RODEZ
description:
The edifice, made of pink sandstone, stands out thanks to its western façade, resembling a fortress, and which was once part of the town's ramparts, but also because of its bell tower. This delicately elaborated tower standing 87 metres high has been the town's symbol for centuries.
From its military architecture to the finesse of the stone lacework, it took three centuries (13th to 16th) to build what is now one of the most imposing cathedrals in the south of France. 
Inside, visitors are struck by the seven figurative stained glass windows by the artist Stéphane Belzère, where contemporary c

name: Tour de Clairvaux
description:
FORTIFIED PORTE village rampart
In May 1356, at the start of the Hundred Years' War, an English troop occupied the Clairvaux Sauveté for a few days. Four months later, in September, King Jean le Bon of France was defeated at Poitiers. It was around this time, probably later, that the inhabitants decided to surround themselves with ramparts. In addition to a postern to the north, the town would have two gates, one to the east, naturally protected by the river, and the other to the west. This gate, surmounted by a high tower, is both defensive and prestigious (the coat of arms that adorned it ca

At the same time, you will see the coat of arms of La Canourgue: a golden lily and a half on an azure background, associated with the greyhound dog which recalls the arms of the Canilhac family
This tower, which was originally the communal belfry used to watch the horizon, was probably built on the remains of the Saint-Etienne castle. In the 18th century, it was used (and is still used today) as the communal clock.

name: Tour de Peyrebrune
description: Seat of the Seigniory of Peyrebrune, this centuries old tower still proudly dominates the Alrance valley and its lake from the top of its 3013 foot high peak. Recently restored by volunteers from the "Amis de Peyrebrune d'Alrance" association, its visit starts with a video plunging you directly into the heart of the local history. You will appreciate its architecture while climbing the stairs to reach the summit. An exceptional panorama of the Lévézou and the Pyrénées awaits you at the top. Two viewpoint indicators complete the scene.
tldr: Grimpez à la tour de Peyrebrune, restaurée par des bénévoles, pour une vue panoramique sur la vallée d'Alrance et son lac.

name: Tour du château de Sénergues
description: The square tower dates from the late 14th century. It was the first of the castle's buildings to be erected. Standing 24 metres high, it offers a magnificent panoramic view of the village and the Pilgrim's Way to Santiago de Compostela below. Inside, 3 levels follow one another, all empty of any furniture, but still displaying the finest architectural traces of the period. A lovely stopover just a stone's throw from the magnificent village of Conques.

Restoration works have given this tower back its warrior physiognomy with its five storeys, its sentry walkway with machicolations and its adjoining buildings: the Knights' Logis (living quarters) and the Grange (barn). The commandery of the temple, joined to that of Sainte Eulalie du Larzac, was founded in 1234. There was already a fortified bastide with refuge lodges as in Vezins, and a castle which was completed in 1381 by a tower. The commandery was united with that of the Canabières (Order of Saint John of Jerusalem) after the suppression of the Order of the Temple (1302). The place depended on the parish of Saint Amans d'Escoudournac.

She'll show you around her organic, agro-forestry plot and the picking areas on the farm. Whether wild or cultivated, her "simples" will reveal some of their secrets, and you'll discover their properties and uses, as well as the main ways of extracting their active ingredients.

On-site, you'll also be able to buy products made by a Witch on the Roof from the plants you've discovered: jellies, hydrolats, mother tinctures, oils, salts, jams, etc.

It also ensures the safety of 15 neighboring communities through several interconnections, including the towns of Rodez and Villefranche-de-Rouergue and the SMAEP of Montbazens-Rignac. description:
Situated in the direct proximity of the Lot valley, this site is visible from the A75 motorway at La Canourgue. It consists of limestone slopes and natural caves.
It is one of the main wintering sites of the Great Rhinolophe with between 40 and 75 individuals. Only 4 main sites
are known in Languedoc-Roussillon.
Source: Muséum National d'Histoire Naturelles, Natura 2000 network, June 2006.

name: VANNERIE
description:
A club member for 10 years, Hubert, originally from the Causse Méjean, has learned to make basketwork. Today, he's passing on this know-how.
Whether you just want to watch, chat with him or try your hand at weaving, Hubert will welcome you with a smile and an infectious good mood every Wednesday in July and August at 1.30pm.

name: VASE DE CHINE
description:
On the footpath of the Cornice Trails, on the Causse Méjean, two astonishing monoliths can be seen: the Vase of Sèvres and the Vase of China. The latter overlooks the sumptuous Jonte gorges, enough to make you dizzy. Its size is impressive and offers a simply remarkable spectacle on the heights of the gorges.

Below the emptiness and the dizzying gorges of the Jonte; above the vultures describing circles; opposite, on the Causse Méjean, the magnificent Vase de Chine.

name: VASE DE SEVRES
description:
At the beginning of the Gorges de la Jonte, erosion has sculpted strange shapes on the limestone ledges. One of them became famous: the "Vase de Sèvres".

Numerous hikes starting from Le Rozier or Causse Méjean overlook the dizzying gorges of the Jonte. On the way, you will see a monolith in the shape of a vase, dominating the heights of this canyon. Certainly flown over by vultures, the Vase de Sèvres is a must during this breathtaking hike.

The castle appears in texts in the 12th century and successively belonged to various powerful families of Rouergue before being progressively abandoned from the 18th century.
Beaucaire is a remarkable example of the military architecture of the Middle Ages in Rouergue of which there are only few traces left. One can still admire part of the 14th century enclosure and the base of the keep tower.
